  prize_pool_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total monetary prize pool allocated for distribution to tournament participants and winners, expressed in the tournament\'s base currency. Used for financial planning, sponsor negotiations, and athlete contract compliance.']
  prize_pool_currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the prize pool amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency financial reporting and SAP S/4HANA FI integration.']

  social_media_hashtag varchar [note: 'Official social media hashtag designated for the tournament (e.g., #WorldCup2026, #NBAPlayoffs). Used for fan engagement tracking, UGC (User Generated Content) monitoring, and NPS (Net Promoter Score) sentiment analysis.']
  sport_type varchar [note: 'The sport or entertainment discipline associated with this tournament (e.g., \'Football\', \'Basketball\', \'Mixed Martial Arts\', \'Tennis\', \'Concert Series\'). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: football|basketball|baseball|ice_hockey|soccer|tennis|mma|golf|esports|concert — promote to reference product]']
  start_date date [note: 'Official calendar date on which the tournament competition begins (first match or opening ceremony). Used for scheduling, broadcast rights windows, and ticketing activation.']
  sustainability_certified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the tournament has achieved or is pursuing ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management System certification. Supports ESG reporting and sponsor sustainability commitments.']
  ticket_sales_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether public ticket sales are enabled for this tournament. When false, the tournament may be closed-door, invitation-only, or broadcast-only. Drives Ticketmaster/AXS inventory activation.']
  tiebreaker_rules varchar [note: 'Description of the rules applied to resolve tied standings or scores within the tournament (e.g., head-to-head record, goal difference, penalty shootout, sudden death overtime). Governed by the sanctioning body.']
  total_matches_scheduled varchar [note: 'Total number of matches or games scheduled across all rounds of the tournament (e.g., 64 matches for FIFA World Cup group + knockout stages). Used for venue scheduling, broadcast slot planning, and officiating resource allocation.']
  total_participants varchar [note: 'Maximum number of teams or individual athletes eligible to compete in the tournament (e.g., 32 teams for FIFA World Cup, 16 teams for NBA Playoffs). Defines bracket size and seeding structure.']
  total_rounds varchar [note: 'Total number of competitive rounds or stages in the tournament bracket (e.g., 7 rounds for NBA Playoffs, 6 rounds for FIFA World Cup knockout stage). Drives bracket generation and scheduling logic.']
  tournament_name varchar [note: 'Official full name of the tournament as sanctioned by the governing body (e.g., \'FIFA World Cup 2026\', \'NBA Playoffs 2025\', \'UFC Championship Series Season 3\').']
  tournament_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the tournament from announcement through post-event reconciliation. Drives operational workflows, ticketing availability, and broadcast scheduling.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to the tournament record. Used for change data capture, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance.']
  var_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether VAR (Video Assistant Referee) or TMO (Television Match Official) technology is deployed for officiating decisions during this tournament. Relevant for football, rugby, and other applicable sports.']
  variance_explanation varchar [note: 'Narrative explanation provided by the budget owner describing the reason for planned vs. actual variance for this specific tournament-budget allocation. Sourced from detection phase relationship data. Belongs to the allocation relationship as it contextualizes the financial delta at the tournament level.']
  wada_compliance_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether WADA (World Anti-Doping Agency) anti-doping testing protocols are mandatory for this tournament. Triggers PED (Performance Enhancing Drug) testing workflows and athlete eligibility verification.']

  Note: 'Master entity representing a structured competition format — knockout brackets, round-robin groups, double elimination, or multi-stage tournaments (e.g., FIFA World Cup, NBA Playoffs, UFC Championship Series). Captures tournament name, format type, number of rounds, seeding methodology, host region, prize pool amount, governing body, eligibility criteria, start/end dates, and tournament status. Distinct from season as tournaments have defined bracket structures and elimination logic.'
}

  margin_of_victory varchar [note: 'Absolute difference between the winning and losing team\'s final scores (e.g., 3 goals, 14 points). Null for draws. Used for strength-of-schedule analytics, WAR (Wins Above Replacement) calculations, and wagering handicap settlement.']
  match_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the match was played (local venue time). Used for fixture calendar reporting, standings date-range filtering, and broadcast scheduling alignment.']
  match_duration_minutes varchar [note: 'Total actual playing time in minutes from kickoff to final whistle, including stoppage time and overtime but excluding pre-match and half-time intervals. Used for broadcast scheduling, venue operations planning, and SLA compliance.']
  match_outcome varchar [note: 'Categorical result of the match from the perspective of home vs. away: \'home_win\', \'away_win\', \'draw\', or \'no_result\' (abandoned/forfeited). Primary field for league standings points allocation and wagering market settlement.']
  neutral_venue boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the match was played at a neutral venue (neither team\'s home ground). Affects home/away advantage analytics, standings point allocation rules, and ticket revenue attribution.']
  overtime_played boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the match required overtime, extra time, or additional periods beyond regulation to determine a winner. Drives standings point allocation logic (e.g., NHL OTL point) and broadcast scheduling overrun management.']
  period_scores_away varchar [note: 'Pipe-delimited string of away team scores by period, quarter, half, set, or inning (e.g., \'7|21|14|3\' for NFL quarters). Enables granular in-game momentum analytics and broadcast segment attribution.']
  period_scores_home varchar [note: 'Pipe-delimited string of home team scores by period, quarter, half, set, or inning (e.g., \'21|14|7|10\' for NFL quarters, or \'1|0|2\' for NHL periods). Enables granular in-game momentum analytics and broadcast segment attribution.']
  pitch_condition varchar [note: 'Official assessment of the playing surface condition at the time of the match. Used for player welfare analytics, venue maintenance scheduling, and governing body compliance reporting.']
  protest_reference varchar [note: 'Official reference number of any formal protest or appeal lodged against this match result with the governing body or CAS (Court of Arbitration for Sport). Null if no protest filed. Supports legal and compliance tracking.']
  result_confirmed_timestamp timestamp [note: 'UTC timestamp at which the governing body or league operations officially confirmed and locked the match result. Triggers downstream processes: standings updates, wagering settlement, broadcast highlights release, and fantasy sports scoring.']
  result_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for official notes or annotations related to the match result, such as protest grounds, abandonment reasons, score correction explanations, or governing body directives. Supports compliance documentation and operational context.']
  result_reference_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code assigned to this match result by the governing body or league operations system. Used for official reporting, wagering integrations, and broadcast metadata tagging. Example: \'NFL-2024-WK12-DAL-PHI-RESULT\'.']
  result_source_system varchar [note: 'Identifies the originating system or feed from which the match result data was ingested. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer quality validation. Values include SportsCode/Hudl performance analytics platform, governing body official data feeds, or manual entry.']
  result_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the match result record. \'official\' = confirmed by governing body; \'under_review\' = VAR/TMO or disciplinary review pending; \'protested\' = formal protest lodged by a participant; \'forfeited\' = awarded due to forfeit; \'abandoned\' = match abandoned before completion; \'postponed_result\' = result deferred pending replay. Drives league standings inclusion and wagering settlement eligibility.']
  shootout_played boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the match was decided by a penalty shootout or shootout format (e.g., FIFA penalty shootout, NHL shootout). Distinct from overtime_played — a match can have overtime without a shootout.']
  shootout_score_away varchar [note: 'Number of successful shootout attempts by the away team during a penalty shootout. Null if shootout_played is false. Used for detailed shootout analytics and historical records.']
  shootout_score_home varchar [note: 'Number of successful shootout attempts by the home team during a penalty shootout. Null if shootout_played is false. Used for detailed shootout analytics and historical records.']
  sport_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the sport discipline for this match result. Determines the applicable scoring schema, period structure, and governing body rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: football|basketball|baseball|ice_hockey|soccer|tennis|rugby|cricket|golf|mma — promote to reference product]']
  stoppage_time_minutes varchar [note: 'Total additional stoppage/injury time added by the referee across all periods. Relevant for soccer/football and rugby. Used for broadcast scheduling overrun management and officiating analytics.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'UTC timestamp of the most recent modification to this match result record. Tracks amendments such as score corrections, VAR overturns, or protest resolutions.']
  var_intervention boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a Video Assistant Referee (VAR) or Television Match Official (TMO) intervention occurred during the match that affected the official result (e.g., goal disallowed, red card issued, try awarded). Supports officiating quality analytics and governing body review processes.']
  var_intervention_count varchar [note: 'Total number of VAR (Video Assistant Referee) or TMO (Television Match Official) review incidents during the match. Supports officiating quality analytics and governing body compliance reporting.']
  weather_condition varchar [note: 'Prevailing weather condition at the venue during the match. Used for performance analytics (weather impact on scoring), venue operations reporting, and broadcast production context. \'indoor\' applies to enclosed arenas. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|cloudy|rain|snow|fog|extreme_heat|indoor — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']

  Note: 'Transactional entity capturing the official outcome of a completed sports fixture — final scores, scorelines by period/quarter/half/set, overtime/shootout results, winning team/athlete, margin of victory, result status (official, under review, protested, forfeited), VAR/TMO intervention flag, and result confirmation timestamp. Serves as the SSOT for competitive outcomes used by league standings, broadcast highlights, and wagering integrations. Distinct from fixture (which is the scheduled event) — this is the recorded outcome.'
}

  tiebreaker_rule varchar [note: 'Description of the tiebreaker criteria applied when teams or athletes are level on points or wins at the end of this round (e.g., head-to-head record, goal difference, away goals, points differential). Critical for standings and bracket resolution.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this competition round record was last modified in the Sports Entertainment data platform. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance.']

Captures round name, round number, stage type, parent season or tournament reference, scheduled start/end dates, and number of fixtures in the round. Enables fixture scheduling, standings calculation, and bracket progression logic.'

  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text operational notes for this broadcast window, capturing special production instructions, broadcaster-specific requirements, or scheduling exceptions not captured in structured fields.']
  platform_rights varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of platforms (e.g., linear_tv, ott, mobile, ppv) entitled to carry this specific fixture under this deal.   territory_region varchar [note: 'Sub-national or multi-country regional designation for the broadcast territory (e.g., \'Northeast US\', \'Western Europe\', \'APAC\'). Used when rights are granted at a regional rather than national level, particularly for RSN and international distribution.']
  window_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable label for this broadcast window assignment (e.g., \'Sunday Night Football - Week 12\', \'UEFA Champions League Final - Prime Slot\'). Used in scheduling dashboards and production briefs.']
  window_reference_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this broadcast window assignment, used for cross-system reconciliation with Dalet Galaxy and broadcast scheduling systems.']
  window_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the broadcast window assignment. Drives downstream production scheduling, rights enforcement, and fan communication workflows.']
  window_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the broadcast window by distribution modality. Linear = traditional TV; OTT = Over-The-Top streaming; PPV = Pay-Per-View; RSN = Regional Sports Network; International = cross-border rights slot; Delayed = tape-delay broadcast; Highlights = clip/summary rights only. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: linear|ott|ppv|rsn|international|delayed|highlights — promote to reference product]']

  Note: 'Association entity linking fixtures to their assigned broadcast windows and production requirements — capturing primary broadcaster, kickoff time constraints driven by broadcast, and territory-specific start times.'

  presale_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a presale window is activated for this pricing configuration, allowing select fan segments (e.g., CRM loyalty members, credit card holders, season ticket holders) to purchase before the general public on-sale.']
  presale_end_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The exact date and time at which the presale window closes. After this timestamp, remaining presale inventory rolls into the general public on-sale pool.']
  presale_start_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The exact date and time at which the presale window opens for eligible purchasers. Applicable only when presale_enabled is true. Drives CRM campaign scheduling in Salesforce and Adobe Experience Platform.']
  price_adjustment_ceiling_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Maximum percentage by which the dynamic pricing engine may increase the base ticket price (e.g., 50.00 means prices may rise up to 50% above base). Caps upward price movement to protect fan experience and brand equity.']
  price_adjustment_floor_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Minimum percentage by which the dynamic pricing engine may reduce the base ticket price (expressed as a negative-capable percentage, e.g., -20.00 means prices may drop up to 20% below base). Prevents excessive discounting.']
  pricing_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this pricing configuration. Draft indicates pending approval; Active indicates live and applied to ticket inventory; Suspended indicates temporarily halted; Expired indicates past effective window; Cancelled indicates permanently withdrawn.']
  pricing_tier varchar [note: 'Categorical tier classification for this pricing configuration. Tiers include General Admission (GA), Standing Room Only (SRO), Standard, Premium, Very Important Person (VIP), and Platinum. Drives seat manifest segmentation in Archtics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|premium|vip|ga|sro|platinum|hospitality|suite — promote to reference product]']
  revenue_share_pct decimal(6,4) [note: 'Percentage of gross ticket revenue from this pricing tier shared with the venue operator, league, or other contractual revenue-sharing partners. Feeds into SAP S/4HANA CO controlling and financial settlement processes.']
  rivalry_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this fixture is designated as a rivalry matchup (e.g., derby, classic, historic rivalry). Rivalry designation typically triggers a positive pricing multiplier uplift in dynamic pricing models.']
  season_ticket_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this event is included in season ticket packages. When true, season ticket holders receive access at their contracted rate rather than the general public pricing tier.']
  service_fee_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Fixed service or convenience fee charged per ticket in addition to the face value price. Represents ticketing platform processing charges passed to the consumer. Governed by PCI-DSS for payment processing.']
  strategy_type varchar [note: 'The overarching pricing strategy applied to this configuration. Fixed means a static price; Dynamic means algorithmically adjusted; Tiered means structured price bands; Variable means manually adjusted; Promotional means a time-limited discounted offer.']
  tax_rate_pct decimal(6,4) [note: 'Applicable tax rate percentage applied to ticket sales under this pricing configuration. Varies by jurisdiction and event type. Used for financial reporting and SAP S/4HANA FI tax determination.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which this pricing configuration record was most recently modified. Tracks the last change event for audit, reconciliation, and Silver layer incremental processing.']

  Note: 'Event-level pricing strategy and tier configuration linking fixture characteristics (rivalry, playoff, day-of-week) to pricing multipliers and dynamic pricing activation rules.'
}

Table venue.seat {
  seat_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each individual seat record within the venue seating inventory. Primary key for the seat data product, serving as the Single Source of Truth (SSOT) for seat-level inventory consumed by the ticketing domain.']
  facility_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the venue (stadium, arena, or concert hall) in which this seat physically resides. Links seat inventory to the venue master record.']
  seating_section_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the seating section that contains this seat. A section is a named grouping of rows within a venue bowl, stand, or level.']
  venue_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the venue (stadium, arena, or concert hall) in which this seat physically resides. Links seat inventory to the venue master record.']
  accessibility_features varchar [note: 'Free-text description of specific accessibility accommodations available at or near this seat, such as hearing loop proximity, assistive listening device availability, or transfer seat specifications. Supports ADA compliance documentation and fan service.']
  accessible_route_available boolean [note: 'Indicates whether an ADA-compliant accessible route (ramp, elevator, or level pathway) is available to reach this seat from the venue entrance. True = accessible route available; False = not accessible by compliant route. Critical for ADA compliance and fan service.']
  color_code varchar [note: 'Hexadecimal color code of the seat\'s upholstery or shell, used for venue mapping visualizations, brand compliance, and replacement procurement matching.']
  concourse_level varchar [note: 'The concourse or service level associated with this seat, indicating which food, beverage, and restroom facilities are nearest. Used for concessions planning, fan wayfinding, and event-day logistics.']
  condition varchar [note: 'Current physical condition of the seat hardware (frame, cushion, armrests, cup holder). Used for maintenance prioritization, capital expenditure planning, and fan experience quality management.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this seat record was first created in the system, representing the initial provisioning of the seat into the venue inventory master. Supports data lineage, audit trails, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.']
  elevation_m decimal(8,2) [note: 'Vertical elevation of the seat above the playing field or stage floor level, measured in meters. Used for sightline quality scoring, broadcast camera planning, and premium seat valuation.']
  entry_gate varchar [note: 'The recommended or assigned entry gate or turnstile through which a fan holding a ticket for this seat should enter the venue. Used for access control routing, crowd flow management, and fan experience optimization.']
  ga_area_code varchar [note: 'For General Admission (GA) or Standing Room Only (SRO) areas, the code identifying the GA zone to which this inventory record belongs. Null for reserved seating. Used to manage GA capacity and access control.']
  has_cupholder boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this seat is equipped with a built-in cup holder. True = cup holder present; False = no cup holder. Used for fan amenity reporting and concessions upsell targeting.']
  has_power_outlet boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this seat has an accessible power outlet or USB charging port. True = power outlet available; False = no power outlet. Relevant for premium and club-level seat differentiation and fan engagement platform connectivity.']
  hold_reason varchar [note: 'Reason code explaining why a seat is placed in \'hold\' operational status. Values: press (media/press allocation), production (broadcast/stage equipment), vip (Very Important Person hold), sponsor (sponsor contractual hold), operations (venue staff use), safety (OSHA/ADA safety clearance), tbd (To Be Determined). Null when operational_status is not \'hold\'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: press|production|vip|sponsor|operations|safety|tbd — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  install_date date [note: 'Date on which this seat was physically installed in the venue. Used for asset lifecycle management, warranty tracking, and capital expenditure depreciation schedules.']
  is_ada boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this seat is designated as an ADA-compliant accessible space (wheelchair space or transfer seat) per Americans with Disabilities Act requirements. True = ADA-designated; False = standard seat. Critical for regulatory compliance reporting and accessible inventory management.']
  is_aisle boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this seat is positioned directly adjacent to an aisle, providing easier ingress/egress. True = aisle seat; False = non-aisle seat. Used for premium seat selection, accessibility routing, and emergency egress planning.']
  is_companion boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this seat is designated as a companion seat immediately adjacent to an ADA accessible space, reserved for a companion of a wheelchair user. True = companion seat; False = not a companion seat. Required for ADA compliance inventory tracking.']
  is_kill boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this seat is permanently structurally unavailable and must never be sold or activated. Kill seats arise from structural obstructions, safety requirements, or permanent equipment installations. True = kill seat; False = not a kill seat.']
  is_obstructed_view boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the seat has a partially or fully obstructed sightline to the playing field or stage due to structural columns, equipment, or other physical barriers. True = obstructed; False = unobstructed. Must be disclosed on ticket sales per consumer protection standards.']
  is_premium boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this seat is classified as a premium inventory seat (club, loge, courtside, field-level, or VIP designation) commanding a premium price tier. True = premium; False = standard. Drives revenue management and sponsorship inventory reporting.']
  kill_reason varchar [note: 'Descriptive reason explaining why a seat has been permanently killed and removed from sellable inventory (e.g., structural column obstruction, permanent equipment installation, safety code violation). Null when is_kill is False.']
  last_inspection_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent physical safety and condition inspection of this seat, including structural integrity, fastener checks, and ADA compliance verification. Required for OSHA venue safety compliance and facility maintenance records.']
  manifest_code varchar [note: 'The Archtics manifest identifier that governs this seat\'s configuration, pricing, and availability rules for a given event or season. A venue may have multiple manifests (e.g., hockey vs. basketball configurations in a multi-sport arena).']
  next_inspection_due_date date [note: 'Scheduled date by which the next physical inspection of this seat must be completed to maintain OSHA and venue safety compliance. Drives preventive maintenance scheduling.']
  operational_status varchar [note: 'Current operational lifecycle state of the seat. active = available for ticketing; inactive = temporarily removed from inventory (e.g., renovation); hold = reserved for operational use (press, production, VIP hold); kill = permanently structurally unavailable and never to be sold.']
  price_zone_code varchar [note: 'The pricing zone designation assigned to this seat, used by the ticketing system (Ticketmaster/AXS, Archtics) to determine base ticket price tiers. Price zones group seats with equivalent market value within a venue manifest.']
  row_label varchar [note: 'Alphanumeric label identifying the row within the section in which this seat is located (e.g., \'A\', \'B\', \'12\'). Printed on tickets and used for fan wayfinding and access control.']
  row_sequence varchar [note: 'Numeric ordinal position of the row within the section, used for physical layout ordering and proximity-to-field calculations. Distinct from row_label which may be alphanumeric.']
  season_ticket_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this seat is eligible to be included in a season ticket package. True = eligible for season ticket sales; False = not eligible (e.g., event-only inventory, kill seats, or operational holds). Drives CRM and ticketing inventory allocation.']
  seat_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the seat within its section, as printed on a ticket or displayed on a seat placard. Corresponds to the Archtics seat identifier used in Ticketmaster/AXS ticketing workflows.']
  seat_number varchar [note: 'The seat number within the row, as physically labeled on the seat and printed on the ticket. May be numeric or alphanumeric depending on venue configuration.']
  seat_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the seat by its physical configuration and service tier. Drives pricing, accessibility compliance, and inventory allocation rules. Values: standard (general bowl seat), accessible (ADA wheelchair space), companion (adjacent to accessible space for a companion), premium (club/loge/VIP seat), stool (bar-height stool in standing/lounge areas), suite (private suite seat).']
  sequence varchar [note: 'Numeric ordinal position of the seat within the row, used for physical layout ordering and adjacent-seat grouping logic in ticketing systems.']
  sightline_quality varchar [note: 'Qualitative rating of the seat\'s sightline to the primary viewing area (field, stage, or court), derived from physical geometry and obstruction analysis. Used for pricing, fan experience design, and ticket disclosure requirements.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Identifies the operational system of record from which this seat record was sourced. Values: archtics (Archtics Venue Seating and Inventory Management), ticketmaster (Ticketmaster platform), axs (AXS ticketing platform), manual (manually entered). Supports data lineage and Silver layer provenance tracking.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this seat record, including status changes, inspection updates, or configuration changes. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit compliance, and Silver layer incremental processing.']
  x_coordinate decimal(10,4) [note: 'Horizontal Cartesian coordinate of the seat\'s physical position within the venue floor plan, measured in meters from a defined venue origin point. Used for venue mapping, sightline analysis, and digital twin applications.']
  y_coordinate decimal(10,4) [note: 'Vertical Cartesian coordinate of the seat\'s physical position within the venue floor plan, measured in meters from a defined venue origin point. Used for venue mapping, sightline analysis, and spatial analytics.']

  Note: 'Atomic seat-level inventory record for every individual seat within a seating section. Captures seat number, row identifier, seat type (standard/accessible/companion/premium/stool), physical coordinates (row-seat position), ADA designation flag, obstructed-view flag, aisle seat flag, kill-seat flag (structurally unavailable), current operational status (active/inactive/hold/kill), and last inspection date. Serves as the SSOT for seat-level inventory consumed by the ticketing domain.'
}

  broadcast_infrastructure_status varchar [note: 'Operational status of the venue\'s broadcast infrastructure including camera positions, cabling, production truck hookups, and Outside Broadcast (OB) connectivity as verified during the pre-event readiness check.']
  checklist_item_count varchar [note: 'Total number of checklist items included in the readiness assessment for this event and facility combination, as defined by the applicable checklist version.']
  checklist_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the operational readiness checklist template used for this assessment (e.g., v2.1.0). Enables tracking of checklist evolution and ensures assessments are compared against the correct standard.']
  concession_stands_ready boolean [note: 'Indicates whether concession stands and food service areas have been inspected, stocked, and confirmed ready for fan service prior to gates opening. True = concessions ready; False = not ready.']
  conditional_waiver_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes documenting the specific conditions, mitigations, or waivers applied when the readiness status is \'conditional\'. Captures the rationale for proceeding despite failed or waived items.']
  contingency_plan_activated boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a contingency or emergency operations plan has been activated for this event due to identified risks or failed checklist items. True = contingency plan activated; False = standard operations plan in effect.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this operational readiness record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.']
  critical_items_failed_count varchar [note: 'Number of checklist items classified as critical (life-safety, structural, or regulatory) that failed during the readiness assessment. Any value greater than zero typically triggers a \'rejected\' or \'conditional\' readiness status.']
  crowd_management_plan_confirmed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the crowd management and ingress/egress plan has been reviewed, staffed, and confirmed as ready for the expected attendance level for this event. True = plan confirmed; False = not confirmed.']
  emergency_lighting_status varchar [note: 'Operational status of the venue\'s emergency lighting and exit signage systems as verified during the pre-event readiness assessment. Required for safe evacuation under NFPA 101 and OSHA standards.']
  evacuation_plan_posted boolean [note: 'Indicates whether current evacuation plans and emergency exit signage have been posted and verified at all required locations throughout the venue prior to the event. True = posted and verified; False = not confirmed.']
  event_type_category varchar [note: 'Classification of the event type for which this readiness assessment is being conducted. Determines which checklist items are applicable and which may be waived. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sporting_event|concert|conference|mixed_use|private_event|other — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]']
  expected_attendance varchar [note: 'Projected number of attendees for the event at the time of the readiness assessment. Used to calibrate staffing levels, medical station requirements, crowd management plans, and concession readiness.']
  field_playing_surface_status varchar [note: 'Readiness status of the playing field or performance surface as assessed during the pre-event readiness check. Includes inspection for safety hazards, markings, and surface conditions. \'conditional\' may indicate weather-related concerns.']
  fire_suppression_status varchar [note: 'Operational status of the venue\'s fire suppression system (sprinklers, suppression agents) as verified during the pre-event readiness assessment. A non-operational status is a critical failure.']
  gates_open_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Scheduled date and time for public gates to open at the venue for this event. The readiness certification must be approved prior to this timestamp.']
  hazmat_inspection_completed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a hazardous materials inspection has been completed for the venue prior to the event, confirming no prohibited substances or unsafe storage conditions are present. True = inspection completed and cleared; False = not completed.']
  hvac_system_status varchar [note: 'Operational status of the venue\'s Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) system as assessed during the pre-event readiness check. \'degraded\' indicates partial functionality that may require mitigation.']
  items_failed_count varchar [note: 'Number of checklist items that did not meet the required standard during the readiness assessment, including both critical and non-critical failures.']
  items_passed_count varchar [note: 'Number of checklist items that were inspected and confirmed as fully compliant during the readiness assessment.']
  items_waived_count varchar [note: 'Number of checklist items formally waived for this assessment, typically due to inapplicability for the specific event type, venue configuration, or approved variance.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this operational readiness record was most recently modified. Tracks revisions to the assessment, status changes, or corrections made after initial creation.']
  medical_station_status varchar [note: 'Readiness status of on-site medical stations and first-aid facilities for the event. \'partial\' indicates some stations are staffed and equipped but not all required stations are fully operational.']
  osha_compliance_confirmed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether all applicable Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) requirements for venue operations have been verified as compliant during this readiness assessment. True = OSHA compliance confirmed; False = compliance not confirmed or deficiencies found.']
  parking_operations_ready boolean [note: 'Indicates whether parking lots, garages, and traffic management personnel are in position and operational prior to gates opening. True = parking operations ready; False = not ready.']
  pos_systems_ready boolean [note: 'Indicates whether all Point of Sale (POS) terminals at concessions, merchandise stands, and box offices have been tested and confirmed operational prior to gates opening. True = POS systems ready; False = not ready.']
  public_address_system_status varchar [note: 'Operational status of the venue\'s public address and emergency announcement system as verified during the pre-event readiness assessment. Critical for emergency communications and fan experience.']
  readiness_reference_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to this readiness certification record, used for audit trails, regulatory submissions, and cross-system traceability (e.g., OR-LAX001-20240915).']
  readiness_status varchar [note: 'The overall certification outcome of the pre-event operational readiness assessment. \'approved\' means all critical items passed; \'conditional\' means minor items failed but event may proceed with mitigations; \'rejected\' means critical failures prevent event execution; \'pending\' means assessment is not yet complete; \'in_review\' means assessment is under management review.']
  reassessment_deadline timestamp [note: 'The deadline by which a reassessment must be completed when reassessment_required is True. Typically set relative to the gates_open_timestamp to ensure sufficient time for remediation and re-inspection.']
  reassessment_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a follow-up readiness reassessment is required before the event can proceed, typically triggered by a \'conditional\' or \'rejected\' status with remediation actions underway. True = reassessment required; False = no reassessment needed.']
  rejection_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the primary reason(s) for a \'rejected\' readiness status. Required when readiness_status = \'rejected\'. Documents the critical failures that prevent the event from proceeding.']
  scoreboard_display_status varchar [note: 'Operational status of the venue\'s scoreboard, video boards, and digital display systems as verified during the pre-event readiness check. Impacts fan experience and broadcast production.']
  security_sweep_completed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the pre-event security sweep of the venue has been completed and cleared by the security team prior to gates opening. True = sweep completed and venue cleared; False = sweep not yet completed or venue not cleared.']
  weather_risk_level varchar [note: 'Assessed weather risk level for the event based on forecasts at the time of the readiness assessment. Influences conditional readiness decisions for outdoor or partially-covered venues. Values: low, moderate, high, severe.']
  wifi_network_status varchar [note: 'Operational status of the venue\'s fan-facing and operational Wi-Fi network infrastructure as verified during the pre-event readiness assessment. Impacts fan engagement, Point of Sale (POS) systems, and digital ticketing.']

  Note: 'Pre-event checklist and readiness certification record confirming that a facility has met all operational, safety, and compliance requirements before gates open for an event. Attributes include readiness assessment date/time, event reference, facility reference, checklist version, number of checklist items, items passed, items failed, items waived, critical items failed count, HVAC system status, fire suppression system status, emergency lighting status, medical station readiness status, security sweep completion flag, ADA access verification flag, overall readiness status (approved/conditional/rejected), and approving facility manager.'
}

Table venue.content_placement {
  content_placement_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the venue_content_placement association']
  asset_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking this placement record to the digital content asset being displayed at the facility.']
  facility_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking this placement record to the physical venue facility where the content asset is displayed.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'Identifier of the person or role who formally approved this content placement for the facility-zone-window combination. Supports audit trail and compliance requirements for in-venue content governance.']
  display_channel_type varchar [note: 'The AV delivery channel or system type used to push the content asset to the display zone. Drives technical routing and encoding requirements for the placement.']
  display_end_datetime timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the content placement window closes and the asset is deactivated from display in the specified zone at this facility. Used for rights expiry enforcement and AV system deactivation.']
  display_rights_status varchar [note: 'Current rights clearance state for this specific facility-asset placement combination. A single asset may be cleared for display at one venue but restricted at another due to territorial or contractual rights constraints. This status is distinct from the asset-level drm_status on the content.asset master.']
  display_start_datetime timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the content placement window opens and the asset becomes active for display in the specified zone at this facility. Used for scheduling, rights window enforcement, and AV system activation.']
  display_zone varchar [note: 'Identifies the specific physical AV zone within the facility where the content asset is scheduled for display. A single facility-asset placement is scoped to one zone; multiple records cover multiple zones for the same asset at the same venue.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the in-venue content placement event between a facility and a digital content asset. It captures the operational and rights management record governing which asset is displayed in which physical zone of which venue, for what display window, under what rights clearance status, and approved by whom. Each record links one facility to one asset and carries attributes that exist only in the context of a specific placement — they cannot reside on the facility master or the asset master alone. Serves as the SSOT for in-venue digital signage scheduling, sponsor display rights compliance, and AV channel assignment across all Sports Entertainment venues.. Existence Justification: A facility (stadium, arena, amphitheater) actively displays digital content assets across multiple physical zones — scoreboards, concourse screens, suite AV systems, LED ribbon boards — and a single content asset (video highlight, promotional clip, sponsor creative) can be licensed and scheduled for display at many facilities simultaneously. The business operationally manages each facility-asset placement as a distinct record with its own display window, zone assignment, rights clearance status, and approval workflow. This is not an analytical correlation but an active content operations and rights management process.'
}

  contract_end_date date [note: 'The date on which the vendor service agreement for this facility is scheduled to expire or terminate. Used by procurement teams to trigger renewal workflows and by finance for accrual planning. Belongs to the engagement, not the vendor master.']
  contract_start_date date [note: 'The date on which the vendor service agreement for this facility became effective. Used for contract lifecycle management, renewal forecasting, and audit compliance. Belongs to the engagement — the same vendor may have different start dates at different facilities.']
  engagement_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this facility-vendor service engagement. Enables procurement teams to filter active vs. expired contracts and manage renewal pipelines. Belongs to the engagement record, not the vendor master (vendor_status reflects vendor-level standing, not per-facility contract status).']
  primary_contact varchar [note: 'Full name or identifier of the vendor\'s designated operational contact for this specific facility engagement. May differ from the vendor-level primary_contact_name when the vendor assigns dedicated account managers per venue. Belongs to the engagement, not the vendor master.']
  revenue_share_pct decimal [note: 'The percentage of gross revenue generated at this facility that is shared with the vendor under the terms of this engagement (common in F&B and parking concession agreements). This rate is specific to the facility-vendor pairing and cannot reside on either the facility or vendor master record.']
  service_category varchar [note: 'The operational service category this vendor provides at this specific facility. Determines which operational team manages the engagement and which SLA framework applies. Belongs to the engagement, not the vendor (a vendor may provide different services at different facilities) and not the facility (a facility has many service categories from many vendors).']
  sla_tier varchar [note: 'The service level agreement tier governing response times, performance benchmarks, and penalty clauses for this specific facility-vendor engagement. A vendor may operate under different SLA tiers at different facilities depending on venue criticality and contract negotiation outcomes.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Contract between a physical venue facility and an external vendor providing services at that facility. It captures the operational service agreement governing which vendor delivers which service category at a given facility, including contractual terms, SLA commitments, and financial arrangements. Each record links one facility to one vendor for a specific service engagement, with attributes that exist only in the context of this facility-vendor service relationship. Serves as the SSOT for venue operator procurement teams managing the active vendor roster per facility.. Existence Justification: In sports-entertainment venue operations, a single facility (e.g., a stadium) is actively served by many vendors simultaneously — security firms, F&B operators, AV contractors, cleaning services, parking operators — each under distinct contractual terms. Conversely, a vendor (e.g., a regional security company) may hold active service agreements across multiple facilities in the same league portfolio. The business actively manages this relationship as a named operational concept — a vendor engagement or service contract — with its own lifecycle attributes (contract dates, SLA tier, revenue share, service category) that belong to neither the facility nor the vendor alone.'
}

Each record links one facility to one deal and carries attributes that exist only in the context of this specific facility-deal relationship — enabling multi-venue deals and multi-deal facilities to be modeled accurately.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment, a single facility (e.g., a stadium) genuinely hosts multiple concurrent sponsorship deals simultaneously — naming rights, pouring rights, digital board placements, and presenting sponsorships all coexist at the same venue. Conversely, a single sponsorship deal can span multiple facilities — a regional pouring rights deal or a multi-venue naming rights package covers several arenas or stadiums under one commercial agreement. The business actively manages these facility-deal pairings as operational records with placement-specific attributes (activation zone, asset type, placement location, contracted value per facility) that belong to neither the facility nor the deal alone.'

Table venue.facility_obligation_applicability {
  facility_obligation_applicability_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the facility_obligation_applicability association']
  compliance_obligation_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the compliance obligation that applies to this facility']
  facility_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the physical venue asset to which this compliance obligation applies']
  ada_accessible_seat_count varchar [note: 'Total number of wheelchair-accessible and companion seating positions certified under ADA requirements. Used in ticketing inventory allocation to ensure federally mandated accessible seat availability ratios are maintained. [Moved from facility: ADA-accessible seat count is evidence data supporting ADA compliance verification at this facility — it is the measurable output of the ADA obligation applicability, not an intrinsic physical characteristic of the venue independent of the obligation. It belongs to the ADA-specific applicability record.]']
  ada_compliant boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the venue holds a current ADA compliance certification confirming that accessible seating, entrances, restrooms, concessions, and wayfinding meet federal accessibility standards. In the fully normalized model, this status belongs to the facility_obligation_applicability record linking this facility to the ADA obligation, as compliance_status. Retaining it on facility creates a denormalized duplicate that diverges from the association record over time.]']
  applicability_end_date date [note: 'The date on which this compliance obligation ceases to apply to this specific facility, if applicable. May be set when a facility is decommissioned, sold, or when a regulatory exemption is granted for this location.']
  applicability_start_date date [note: 'The date on which this compliance obligation became applicable to this specific facility. May differ from the obligation\'s global effective_date if the facility was built, acquired, or activated after the obligation took effect.']
  compliance_status varchar [note: 'Current compliance status of this obligation at this specific facility. A single obligation may be compliant at one venue and in-remediation at another, making this a relationship-level attribute that cannot reside on either parent entity alone.']

It is relationship-level data that belongs on the applicability record, not on the facility master.]']
  iso_20121_certified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the venue holds a current ISO 20121 certification for sustainable event management practices covering energy, waste, water, and supply chain sustainability. It belongs on the applicability record linking this facility to the ISO 20121 obligation.]']
  last_verified_date date [note: 'The most recent date on which compliance with this obligation was formally verified and confirmed at this specific facility. Drives audit scheduling and remediation prioritization at the venue level.']
  osha_safety_rating varchar [note: 'Current OSHA safety compliance rating for the venue facility covering structural integrity, emergency egress, crowd management, and worker safety standards. It is a relationship-level attribute (OSHA obligation × this facility) and should live on the applicability record, not as a denormalized field on the facility master.]']
  responsible_owner varchar [note: 'The individual or business unit accountable for maintaining and evidencing compliance with this obligation at this specific facility. Differs by venue location and may differ from the obligation\'s global responsible_business_unit.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Compliance Applicability contract between a facility and a compliance obligation. It captures the operational record of which compliance obligations apply to which physical venues, including when applicability begins and ends, the current compliance status at that venue, who is responsible for maintaining compliance, and when it was last verified. Each record links one facility to one obligation and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific venue-obligation pairing — a single obligation may be compliant at one venue and in-remediation at another.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment operations, a physical venue (facility) is subject to multiple simultaneous compliance obligations — ADA Title III, OSHA safety standards, ISO 20121, local fire codes, and CBA venue requirements all apply concurrently to a single stadium. Conversely, a single obligation such as ADA Title III applies across every facility in the portfolio. The business actively manages this relationship through compliance programs that track per-facility obligation status, responsible owners, verification dates, and applicability windows — this is not derivable from transactional data but is an operationally managed compliance record.'

  era decimal(5,2) [note: 'Earned Run Average (ERA) — baseball-specific pitching metric representing the average number of earned runs allowed per nine innings pitched. Null for non-baseball records.   innings_pitched decimal(5,1) [note: 'Total innings pitched by a baseball pitcher in this statistical period, expressed in thirds of an inning (e.g., 6.2 = 6 innings and 2 outs). Null for non-pitcher or non-baseball records. Denominator for ERA and other rate-based pitching metrics.']

  points_scored varchar [note: 'Total points scored by the athlete in this statistical period. Applicable to basketball (NBA), American football (NFL touchdowns/field goals), and other point-based sports. Null for sports where points are not individually attributed.']

  sport_discipline varchar [note: 'The specific sport or discipline for which these statistics apply (e.g., American Football, Baseball, Basketball, Ice Hockey, Soccer, Tennis). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: american_football|baseball|basketball|ice_hockey|soccer|tennis|golf|mma|rugby|cricket — promote to reference product]']
  stat_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the game was played or the date representing the end of the aggregation period for season/career records. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd per enterprise data standards.']

  stat_period_start_date date [note: 'The start date of the window over which this performance stat record is considered a valid input to the KPI calculation. Scopes the contribution temporally without altering the stat record or the KPI definition.']
  stat_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the statistical record.   stat_type varchar [note: 'Classifies whether this record represents a single-game statistical line, a season-level aggregate, a career-level aggregate, a playoff period, or a tournament-specific accumulation.   steals varchar [note: 'Number of steals credited to the athlete. Primarily a basketball (NBA) defensive metric. Also applicable to baseball (stolen bases). Null for non-applicable sport/position combinations.']
  strikeouts varchar [note: 'Number of strikeouts recorded. For pitchers (MLB), this is the count of batters struck out. For batters, this is the count of times struck out. Null for non-baseball records. Key pitching and batting evaluation metric.']

  touchdowns varchar [note: 'Total touchdowns scored or thrown by the athlete in this statistical period. NFL-specific metric covering passing touchdowns, rushing touchdowns, and receiving touchdowns. Null for non-football records.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which this performance statistic record was last modified in the Silver layer lakehouse. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Tracks revisions, corrections, and re-certifications. Required for change data capture and audit compliance.']
  war decimal(6,2) [note: 'Wins Above Replacement (WAR) — a composite advanced metric estimating the total number of additional wins the athlete contributed to their team compared to a replacement-level player. Sourced from SportsCode/Hudl performance analytics platform. Each record represents a statistical line for one athlete in one game or aggregated period, enabling broadcast overlays, fantasy sports feeds, and league standings calculations.'

Critical for OSHA incident classification and injury prevention analytics.']
  injury_status varchar [note: 'Current roster and medical status of the injury record reflecting the athlete\'s availability. \'day_to_day\' indicates probable return within 1-2 days; \'injured_reserve\' (IR) indicates formal IR designation per league CBA rules; \'returned\' indicates the athlete has cleared return-to-play protocol; \'closed\' indicates the case is administratively closed.']
  injury_type varchar [note: 'High-level clinical classification of the injury or medical event. \'acute\' refers to sudden-onset traumatic injuries; \'chronic\' refers to long-standing conditions; \'overuse\' refers to repetitive stress injuries; \'concussion\' is tracked separately per league concussion protocol requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: acute|chronic|overuse|illness|concussion|fracture|laceration|dislocation|sprain|strain — promote to reference product]']

  ir_designation varchar [note: 'Formal league roster designation for the injured athlete per Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) rules. \'ir_standard\' = standard Injured Reserve placement; \'ir_return_designated\' = IR with designation to return (allows one return per season); \'ir_non_football\' = injury unrelated to sport; \'pup_list\' = Physically Unable to Perform list (pre-season). Drives roster count compliance and salary cap implications.']

Required for OSHA 300 Log annual reporting.']
  is_recurrence boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this injury is a recurrence of a previously documented injury to the same body part. Recurrent injuries are tracked separately for medical analytics, contract risk assessment, and insurance underwriting purposes.']
  is_wada_reportable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this medical event requires reporting to the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA), typically when treatment involves substances on the WADA Prohibited List requiring a Therapeutic Use Exemption (TUE). Critical for anti-doping compliance.']

  medical_staff_notes varchar [note: 'Confidential clinical notes from the team\'s medical staff including athletic trainers, physical therapists, and team physicians documenting daily progress, treatment adjustments, and rehabilitation milestones. Restricted to authorized medical personnel per HIPAA and CBA medical privacy provisions.']
  reported_date date [note: 'Date on which the injury was formally reported to team medical staff or league operations. May differ from injury_date for delayed-onset conditions or injuries initially unreported. Critical for OSHA recordkeeping compliance windows.']
  rtp_clearance_stage varchar [note: 'Current stage in the graduated Return-to-Play (RTP) protocol as defined by league medical standards and CBA.   severity_grade varchar [note: 'Clinical severity classification of the injury based on expected time loss and functional impact. \'minor\' = <7 days; \'moderate\' = 7-28 days; \'severe\' = >28 days; \'career_threatening\' = potential permanent impact on playing career.   source_system varchar [note: 'Operational system of record from which this injury record was ingested or originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.   selection_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for this draft pick in the format LEAGUE-YEAR-ROUND-PICK (e.g., NFL-2024-R1-P01). Used in league communications, broadcast graphics, and official records.']
  selection_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the draft selection. \'announced\' = pick made but contract not yet signed; \'signed\' = athlete under contract; \'unsigned\' = deadline passed without signing; \'voided\' = selection invalidated; \'traded_rights\' = negotiating rights traded post-draft; \'forfeited\' = pick forfeited due to league penalty.']
  selection_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time when the pick was officially announced and recorded during the draft event. Used for broadcast sequencing, official league records, and audit trail.']
  signed_date date [note: 'The date on which the athlete officially signed the rookie contract with the selecting team. Null if unsigned. Triggers salary cap activation and roster registration.']
  signing_deadline date [note: 'The CBA-mandated deadline by which the selected athlete must sign a rookie contract or forfeit draft rights for the current year. Critical for roster and contract management workflows.']
  signing_slot_value decimal(15,2) [note: 'The CBA-mandated signing bonus slot value in USD assigned to this pick based on its round and overall pick number. Governs the maximum signing bonus a team may offer without penalty. Critical for salary cap management and EBITDA reporting.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this draft selection record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Tracks status changes (e.g., unsigned to signed), contract updates, and data corrections.']
  wada_clearance_status varchar [note: 'Anti-doping clearance status of the athlete at the time of the draft per World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) and league anti-doping program requirements. \'cleared\' = no violations; \'pending\' = under review; \'suspended\' = serving ban; \'ineligible\' = permanently ineligible.']

  Note: 'Record of athlete selections made during league drafts (NFL Draft, NBA Draft, MLB Draft, MLS SuperDraft, etc.). Captures draft year, round number, overall pick number, selecting team, original team (if traded), draft class, pre-draft ranking, combine performance scores, and signing slot value per CBA. Tracks compensatory picks, traded picks, and conditional picks. Essential for league governance, salary cap management, and historical analytics.'
}

Tracks eligibility type, governing body (FIFA, NFL, NBA, WADA, CAS), effective/expiry dates, restriction details, suspension type and length (games, days, indefinite), financial penalties, issuing authority, reinstatement conditions, appeal status and outcomes, and chain of custody to originating doping test or incident. Every salary cap entry requires a GL account for proper accounting classification. sap_gl_acco']

  salary_cap_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to league.salary_cap. Business justification: Each salary_cap_entry (individual player cap hit) must be validated against the franchise\'s total salary_cap record for the season. Linking enables cap space remaining calculations, luxury tax liabili']
  team_franchise_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the team (franchise) against whose salary cap this entry is charged. Determines which team\'s cap space is consumed.']

  entry_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of this salary cap entry. \'active\' = currently counting against cap; \'restructured\' = contract has been restructured, new entry supersedes; \'voided\' = contract voided/nullified; \'dead_cap\' = player released but cap charge remains; \'cap_hold\' = restricted free agent tender hold; \'historical\' = prior year closed record.']
  entry_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the cap entry by contract category per CBA rules. Determines applicable cap calculation methodology. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|rookie_scale|veteran_minimum|franchise_tag|transition_tag|cap_hold|two_way|10_day|rest_of_season — promote to reference product]']
  incentive_earned_prior_year boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the athlete earned incentives in the prior cap year that were classified as \'unlikely\' at the time, triggering a cap charge carryover into this cap year. True = prior year unlikely incentive was earned and creates a charge in this year.']
  is_cap_hold boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this entry is a cap hold for a restricted free agent or unsigned draft pick rather than an active contract. True = cap hold; False = active contract cap entry.']
  is_dead_cap boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this entry represents a dead cap charge (athlete has been released or traded but remaining prorated bonuses still count against the team\'s cap). True = athlete is no longer on roster but cap charge persists.']
  is_restructured boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this cap entry reflects a contract restructure that converted base salary to prorated bonus, generating cap relief in the current year. True = restructure has been applied to this entry.']
  league_reported_date date [note: 'The date on which this cap entry was officially reported to and acknowledged by the league office. Required for compliance with league transaction reporting deadlines under CBA rules.']
  likely_incentive_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total value of performance incentives classified as \'likely to be earned\' per CBA rules based on the athlete\'s prior year performance. Likely incentives count against the current cap year. Per CBA definition, an incentive is \'likely\' if the athlete achieved the same threshold in the prior season.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for cap accountants and team finance staff to record contextual information about this entry, such as restructure rationale, league clarification notes, or special CBA provisions applied.']
  option_bonus_prorated decimal(18,2) [note: 'The prorated portion of any option bonus (e.g., option year exercise bonus, void year bonus) allocated to this cap year. Option bonuses are prorated over remaining contract years when exercised.']
  per_game_roster_bonus decimal(18,2) [note: 'Bonus amount earned on a per-game-active basis for each game the athlete is on the active roster. Common in NFL contracts. Total potential value for the cap year is tracked here for cap forecasting purposes.']
  prior_year_incentive_carryover decimal(18,2) [note: 'The dollar amount of incentives earned in the prior cap year (classified as \'unlikely\') that carry over as an additional cap charge in this cap year per CBA rules. Distinct from current-year incentive amounts.']
  restructure_date date [note: 'The date on which the contract restructure was executed, converting base salary to prorated signing bonus and generating cap relief. Null if no restructure has occurred for this entry.']
  roster_bonus decimal(18,2) [note: 'Bonus amount payable to the athlete for being on the active roster on a specified date in this cap year. Counts fully against the cap in the year it is earned per CBA rules.']
  signing_bonus_prorated decimal(18,2) [note: 'The portion of the total signing bonus allocated to this specific cap year after proration across the contract length per CBA rules. This amount is included in the cap hit calculation.']
  signing_bonus_total decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total signing bonus paid to the athlete at contract execution. This amount is prorated across the contract years for cap purposes per CBA rules. Stored as the full contract-level total for reference.']
  unlikely_incentive_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total value of performance incentives classified as \'unlikely to be earned\' per CBA rules. Unlikely incentives do NOT count against the current cap year but create a cap charge in the following year if earned. Per CBA definition, an incentive is \'unlikely\' if the athlete did NOT achieve the threshold in the prior season.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this salary cap entry record was last modified. Tracks restructures, corrections, and status changes for audit trail and data lineage purposes in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  void_year_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this cap year is a void year — a contract year that automatically voids, causing all remaining prorated bonuses to accelerate into the final non-void year. Common NFL cap management technique. True = this is a void year.']
  workday_plan_reference varchar [note: 'Reference identifier linking this cap entry to the corresponding cap forecast scenario in Workday Adaptive Planning. Enables reconciliation between actual cap accounting records and forward-looking cap projections.']
  workout_bonus decimal(18,2) [note: 'Bonus amount payable to the athlete for attending and completing mandatory off-season workout programs. Cap treatment varies by league CBA — may be fully or partially counted.']

  Note: 'Athlete-level salary cap accounting records tracking how each contract contributes to a team\'s league-mandated salary cap. Captures cap year, base salary cap hit, signing bonus proration, dead cap value, incentive escalators (likely/unlikely per CBA), cap relief from restructures, and cap hold for restricted free agents. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA FI/CO for financial reporting and Workday Adaptive Planning for cap forecasting. Distinct from the contract master — this is the annual cap accounting view.'
}

  fan_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the fan account type. Determines applicable business rules, pricing tiers, and service levels. \'family_account\' indicates a parent account with linked sub-profiles. \'vip\' denotes Very Important Person (VIP) status with premium service entitlements.']

  gdpr_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the fan is subject to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) requirements based on their country of residence (EU/EEA). Drives data processing rules, retention policies, and right-to-erasure workflows.']
  gender varchar [note: 'Self-reported gender identity of the fan. Used for demographic analytics, personalization, and inclusive marketing. Collected with explicit consent per GDPR and CCPA.']
  is_fan_club_member boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the fan is an active member of an official fan club. Fan club members receive exclusive content, early ticket access, and community engagement opportunities.']

  nps_score varchar [note: 'Most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) provided by the fan, ranging from 0 to 10. Used to measure fan loyalty and likelihood to recommend the brand. Drives CRM segmentation into Promoters (9-10), Passives (7-8), and Detractors (0-6).']

  preferred_language_code varchar [note: 'IETF BCP 47 language tag representing the fan\'s preferred language for communications, digital platform content, and customer service interactions (e.g., \'en-US\', \'es-MX\', \'fr-FR\').']
  preferred_sport varchar [note: 'The sport or sports property the fan most closely identifies with (e.g., \'NFL Football\', \'NBA Basketball\', \'MLS Soccer\', \'UFC\'). Used for content personalization, targeted promotions, and event recommendations. Free-text to accommodate multi-sport organizations.']
  registration_channel varchar [note: 'The channel through which the fan originally registered their account. Used for acquisition analytics, channel attribution, and Direct-To-Consumer (DTC) strategy reporting.']
  registration_date date [note: 'Date on which the fan first registered their account. Used to calculate fan tenure, cohort analysis, and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) reporting.']
  secondary_email varchar [note: 'Alternate email address for the fan, used as a fallback contact channel or for family account management. Subject to the same consent requirements as the primary email.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to any field in the fan profile record. Used for change data capture, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance.']

  Note: 'SSOT master identity record for every individual fan across all engagement channels. Captures core demographic data (name, DOB, gender, nationality), contact details, preferred language, communication preferences, accessibility requirements, and account status. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and Adobe Experience Platform. Serves B2C individual fans, family account holders, season ticket holders, VIP members, and fan club members. Used for fan satisfaction tracking, churn prediction, and experience improvement initiatives. Raw survey response — not a calculated aggregate.']
