  venue_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the venue where the in-venue activation was executed. Nullable for broadcast, digital, or social channel fulfillments.']
  verifying_employee_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Proof-of-performance verification: activation_fulfillment requires a traceable employee sign-off for sponsor billing, compliance audits, and make-good disputes. \'verified_by\' is a denormalized name; F']
  activation_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the brand activation format being fulfilled. Covers the full spectrum of sponsorship inventory types including naming rights, jersey sponsorships, broadcast integrations, digital banners, social posts, in-venue signage, VIP hospitality, and product placements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: naming_rights|jersey_sponsorship|broadcast_integration|digital_banner|social_post|in_venue_signage|vip_hospitality|product_placement|stadium_wrap|scoreboard — promote to reference product]']
  audience_demographic_target varchar [note: 'The contracted target demographic segment for this activation (e.g., \'Adults 18-49\', \'Males 25-54\', \'Households with income >$75K\'). Used to assess whether delivered impressions matched the sponsor\'s intended audience profile.']
  audience_reach varchar [note: 'Estimated number of unique individuals reached by this activation fulfillment, distinct from total impressions which may count repeat exposures. Used alongside GRP to calculate frequency and assess campaign effectiveness.']
  brand_safety_compliant boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the activation fulfillment met all brand safety requirements as defined in the sponsorship contract (e.g., no adjacency to prohibited content, correct placement context). Critical for broadcast and digital channel fulfillments.']
  broadcast_log_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise timestamp recorded in the broadcast transmission log (Dalet Galaxy) confirming the exact air time of the sponsored content or advertisement. Used for broadcast fulfillment verification and FCC compliance documentation.']
  cpm_contracted decimal(12,4) [note: 'The Cost Per Mille (CPM) rate contractually agreed with the sponsor, representing the cost per 1,000 impressions. Confidential commercial term used to calculate the monetary value of delivered impressions and assess ROI.']
  cpm_realized decimal(12,4) [note: 'The effective Cost Per Mille (CPM) achieved based on actual impressions delivered versus the contracted value. Calculated as (contract_value / impressions_delivered) * 1000. Used in ROI reporting and renewal pricing benchmarking.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this activation fulfillment record was first created in the system. Audit trail field supporting data lineage, SOX compliance, and GDPR data processing records.']
  duration_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration in seconds for which the activation was displayed or broadcast. Applicable to broadcast spots, digital display ads, LED board rotations, and video pre-rolls. Used to verify compliance with contracted exposure time.']
  fulfillment_channel varchar [note: 'The media or physical channel through which the brand activation was delivered to the audience. Broadcast covers linear TV/radio; OTT covers streaming platforms; digital covers web/app; social covers social media platforms; in_venue covers physical stadium/arena placements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: broadcast|in_venue|digital|social|ott|print|podcast|out_of_home — promote to reference product if additional channels are added]']
  fulfillment_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the brand activation was executed and delivered to the sponsor. Used as the principal business event date for ROI reporting and proof-of-performance documentation.']
  fulfillment_quality_rating decimal(3,1) [note: 'Numeric quality score (1.0 to 5.0) assigned to this activation fulfillment based on placement prominence, brand safety compliance, creative execution fidelity, and audience alignment. Used in sponsor satisfaction reporting and renewal scoring.']
  fulfillment_reference_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for this fulfillment record, used in proof-of-performance reports, sponsor invoices, and renewal negotiations. Format: ACT-FUL-YYYYMMDD-XXXX.']
  fulfillment_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the activation fulfillment record. \'Partial\' indicates some but not all contracted deliverables were met. \'Shortfall\' indicates a measurable gap against contracted impressions or GRP targets. Drives renewal negotiation and make-good obligations.']
  fulfillment_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time at which the activation was executed, including timezone offset. Used for broadcast log reconciliation, OTT stream timestamping, and in-venue display scheduling verification.']
  fulfillment_value_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'The monetary value attributed to this specific activation fulfillment in US Dollars, derived from the contracted rate and delivered impressions. Used for revenue recognition, sponsor invoicing, and EBITDA reporting under SAP S/4HANA FI/CO.']
  grp_achieved decimal(10,4) [note: 'Actual Gross Rating Points (GRP) delivered for this activation fulfillment as reported by the audience measurement provider. Compared against grp_contracted to determine fulfillment compliance and trigger make-good obligations.']
  grp_contracted decimal(10,4) [note: 'The Gross Rating Points (GRP) target contractually committed for this activation, representing reach multiplied by frequency against the target demographic. Used as the broadcast and media benchmark for fulfillment assessment.']
  impressions_contracted varchar [note: 'The number of audience impressions contractually obligated for this activation as specified in the sponsorship deal terms. Serves as the benchmark against which delivered impressions are measured for shortfall and make-good calculations.']
  impressions_delivered varchar [note: 'Actual number of audience impressions delivered for this activation fulfillment as measured by the relevant audience measurement system (Nielsen, Comscore, or venue attendance data). Core metric for CPM calculation and ROI reporting.']
  makegood_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a make-good (compensatory activation) is required due to under-delivery against contracted impressions or GRP targets. True triggers a make-good workflow in Salesforce CRM for scheduling a replacement activation.']
  placement_location varchar [note: 'Specific physical or digital location of the activation placement (e.g., \'North End Zone LED Board\', \'Halftime Show Stage Banner\', \'Homepage Hero Banner\', \'Pre-Roll Video Slot 1\'). Provides granular proof-of-placement detail for sponsor reporting.']
  proof_of_play_reference varchar [note: 'Unique identifier or URI pointing to the proof-of-performance artifact (e.g., screenshot filename, broadcast log timestamp key, photo asset ID in DAM, or OTT stream clip reference). Used to substantiate fulfillment claims in sponsor reporting and dispute resolution.']
  proof_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the proof-of-performance artifact submitted for this fulfillment. Determines the verification workflow and the level of evidentiary weight assigned during sponsor audit or dispute resolution.']
  shortfall_impressions varchar [note: 'The gap between contracted impressions and delivered impressions (impressions_contracted minus impressions_delivered). Positive values indicate under-delivery triggering make-good obligations. Zero or negative values indicate full or over-delivery.']
  shortfall_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text explanation of any under-delivery or fulfillment gap, including root cause (e.g., event cancellation, broadcast preemption, technical failure, weather). Used in sponsor communications, make-good planning, and renewal negotiations.']
  sponsor_acknowledged boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the sponsor has formally acknowledged and accepted this fulfillment record as proof-of-performance. True enables revenue recognition and closes the fulfillment obligation in SAP S/4HANA.']
  sponsor_acknowledgement_date date [note: 'Date on which the sponsor formally acknowledged and accepted the fulfillment proof-of-performance. Nullable until acknowledgement is received. Used as the trigger date for revenue recognition and invoice generation.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this activation fulfillment record. Supports audit trail requirements, change tracking, and Silver Layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.']
  verification_date date [note: 'Date on which the fulfillment record was formally verified and approved by the responsible party or third-party measurement provider. Marks the transition from \'pending\' to \'fulfilled\' or \'shortfall\' status.']

  Note: 'Transactional record capturing the actual execution and proof-of-performance for each brand activation. Records fulfillment date, fulfillment channel (broadcast, in-venue, digital, social, OTT), proof-of-play reference (screenshot, broadcast log timestamp, photo), impressions delivered, GRP achieved, CPM realized, fulfillment quality rating, and any shortfall notes. Feeds ROI reporting and renewal negotiations.'
}

  impressions varchar [note: 'Total number of times the sponsor\'s brand asset (logo, advertisement, naming rights mention) was served or displayed across all channels (broadcast, digital, in-venue) during the measurement period.']
  in_venue_dwell_time_seconds varchar [note: 'Average number of seconds fans spent in proximity to or engaged with in-venue sponsor activations (branded zones, experiential areas, digital signage) during the measurement period. Captured via venue analytics systems.']
  is_contracted_kpi boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this metric corresponds to a formally contracted KPI obligation in the sponsorship agreement (True) or is a supplementary/bonus metric tracked for additional insight (False). Drives fulfillment compliance reporting.']
  make_good_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a make-good (compensatory delivery of additional sponsorship inventory) is required due to under-delivery against the contracted KPI target. Triggers make-good workflow in sponsorship fulfillment operations.']
  measurement_methodology varchar [note: 'The methodology used to capture and validate this performance metric. Determines the reliability and comparability of the measurement. Examples: panel survey (Nielsen/Kantar), set-top box data, digital pixel tracking, AI image recognition for logo exposure, manual audit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: panel_survey|set_top_box|digital_pixel|manual_audit|ai_image_recognition|third_party_monitor|internal_analytics — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']

  measurement_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of this performance metric record. Tracks the workflow from initial capture through sponsor verification and final acceptance used in renewal negotiations.']

  metric_category varchar [note: 'High-level category grouping the metric type for reporting and ROI analysis. Enables aggregation across activation channels (broadcast, digital, in-venue, brand health, social media, print).']
  metric_reference_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for this performance metric record, used in ROI reports, renewal negotiations, and sponsor-facing dashboards. Format: PM-YYYYMMDD-XXXX.']
  metric_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the sponsorship KPI being measured. Covers broadcast, digital, in-venue, and brand health metrics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grp_delivered|cpm_realized|impressions|reach|frequency|brand_recall_score|nps_lift|social_engagement_rate|broadcast_airtime_seconds|in_venue_dwell_time|jersey_logo_exposure|naming_rights_mention|digital_banner_clicks|share_of_voice — promote to reference product]']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for capturing contextual notes, measurement caveats, methodology exceptions, or sponsor feedback related to this performance metric record. Used by sponsorship account managers during review and renewal negotiations.']
  nps_lift decimal(6,2) [note: 'Change in Net Promoter Score for the sponsor brand attributable to the sponsorship activation, measured via fan/consumer surveys. Positive values indicate brand sentiment improvement driven by the partnership.']
  reach_000s decimal(14,2) [note: 'Total unique audience reached by the sponsorship activation during the measurement period, expressed in thousands. Sourced from Nielsen or Kantar audience measurement panels.']
  reporting_period_type varchar [note: 'The cadence or granularity of the measurement reporting period. Aligns with contractual reporting obligations to sponsors (weekly, monthly, quarterly, seasonal, annual, or tied to a specific event).']
  social_engagement_rate decimal(8,4) [note: 'Percentage engagement rate for sponsor-related social media content during the measurement period ((likes + comments + shares + saves) / total impressions × 100). Sourced from Adobe Experience Platform social analytics.']
  sponsor_verified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the sponsor has formally reviewed and accepted this performance metric measurement as accurate. Required for final ROI reporting and renewal negotiation documentation.']
  sponsor_verified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the sponsor formally verified and accepted this performance metric measurement. Null if sponsor_verified is False.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'The unit in which the metric value is expressed. Examples: seconds (broadcast airtime), impressions (digital/broadcast), GRP points (Gross Rating Points), CPM USD (Cost Per Mille in USD), score (brand recall/NPS), percentage (engagement rate). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seconds|impressions|grp_points|cpm_usd|score|percentage|mentions|clicks|views|reach_000s — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this performance metric record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements, Silver Layer incremental processing, and SOX financial reporting controls.']
  variance_pct decimal(8,4) [note: 'Percentage variance of actual performance against the contracted target value ((actual - target) / target * 100). Used in sponsor ROI dashboards and renewal negotiation scorecards.']
  variance_value decimal(18,4) [note: 'Absolute difference between actual_value and contracted_target_value (actual minus target). Positive values indicate over-delivery; negative values indicate under-delivery against contracted KPI obligations.']

  Note: 'Transactional record capturing measured sponsorship performance data against contracted KPIs. Feeds ROI reporting and renewal negotiations.'

  quantity_per_event varchar [note: 'Maximum number of units that may be redeemed at any single event within the entitlement scope. Enforces per-event capacity limits distinct from the overall allocation.']
  quantity_redeemed varchar [note: 'Running total of units consumed across all redemption events to date. Updated upon each confirmed redemption line item. Used to compute remaining balance and utilisation rate.']
  quantity_remaining varchar [note: 'Current balance of unredeemed units available to the sponsor (quantity_allocated minus quantity_redeemed). Maintained as a stored field to support real-time balance checks in the sponsor portal without requiring aggregation.']
  redemption_channel varchar [note: 'The channel through which redemptions for this entitlement are processed. Supports channel mix analysis and digital adoption tracking for the sponsor self-service portal.']
  renewal_recommendation varchar [note: 'Account manager\'s recommendation for this entitlement at the next sponsorship renewal cycle, based on utilisation rate, satisfaction scores, and strategic value. Informs renewal package design.']

SFDC = Salesforce CRM; SAP_SD = SAP S/4HANA Sales and Distribution; ARCHTICS = Archtics Venue Seating; TM_AXS = Ticketmaster/AXS; MANUAL = manually entered.']
  special_access_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field capturing any bespoke access arrangements, VIP escort requirements, athlete appearance scheduling notes, or operational instructions specific to this entitlement that are not captured in structured fields.']
  transferable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the sponsor may transfer or reassign this entitlement to a third party (True) or whether it is restricted to named sponsor contacts only (False). Governs redemption eligibility validation.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this hospitality entitlement record. Used for change detection in ETL pipelines, audit trails, and data freshness monitoring.']

  Note: 'Master record for VIP hospitality benefits and entitlements included in sponsorship deals, with integrated line-item redemption tracking. Captures entitlement type (suite access, VIP tickets, field/pitch access passes, meet-and-greet packages, athlete appearance, executive box, travel and accommodation), quantity per event, event scope (all home games, playoffs, specific events), remaining balance. Includes redemption line items: redemption date, event, entitlement type redeemed, quantity used, sponsor contact who redeemed, redemption channel (online portal, account manager), and satisfaction rating. Supports sponsor relationship management, entitlement balance tracking, utilization reporting, and informs renewal package design.'
}

  negotiation_notes varchar [note: 'Confidential free-text field capturing key negotiation points, sponsor requests, concessions offered, and strategic context during the renewal process. Restricted to account management and commercial leadership.']
  nil_rights_included boolean [note: 'Indicates whether NIL (Name, Image, and Likeness) athlete partnership rights are included in the proposed renewal package. Relevant for athlete-linked sponsorship deals.']
  notice_deadline_date date [note: 'The calculated deadline date by which the sponsor must provide notice of intent to renew or decline, derived from the original term end date minus the notice period. Drives proactive outreach workflows.']
  notice_period_days varchar [note: 'The number of days of advance notice required by the original contract before the renewal window closes or auto-renewal activates. Critical for lapse risk management.']
  original_tcv decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total contract value (TCV) of the expiring sponsorship deal in the deal currency. Provides the commercial baseline for renewal uplift and ROI (Return on Investment) analysis.']
  original_term_end_date date [note: 'The end date of the expiring sponsorship deal term. Drives renewal window triggers and lapse risk identification.']
  original_term_start_date date [note: 'The start date of the expiring sponsorship deal term that this renewal is based upon. Provides baseline for term comparison and extension calculations.']
  outcome varchar [note: 'Final outcome of the renewal process. Renewed: new deal executed. Declined: sponsor opted out. Lapsed: renewal window expired without resolution. In Progress: renewal is still active.']
  payment_structure varchar [note: 'The proposed payment schedule structure for the renewed deal. Drives accounts receivable planning and cash flow forecasting in SAP S/4HANA.']
  probability_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Estimated probability (0.00–100.00%) that this renewal will be successfully concluded, as assessed by the account manager or derived from CRM scoring models. Used in weighted pipeline revenue forecasting.']
  proposed_annual_value decimal(18,2) [note: 'The proposed annualized sponsorship fee for the renewed deal, equivalent to ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue). Supports year-over-year revenue planning and ARR reporting.']
  proposed_tcv decimal(18,2) [note: 'The proposed total contract value (TCV) for the renewed sponsorship deal in the deal currency. Key commercial metric for revenue forecasting and renewal uplift tracking.']
  proposed_term_end_date date [note: 'The proposed end date for the renewed sponsorship agreement. Represents the effective-until date of the new binding term. Nullable for open-ended multi-year structures pending final negotiation.']
  proposed_term_start_date date [note: 'The proposed start date for the renewed sponsorship agreement. Represents the effective-from date of the new binding term being negotiated.']
  proposed_term_years decimal(4,2) [note: 'The proposed duration of the renewed deal expressed in years (e.g., 1.0, 2.5, 3.0). Supports multi-year extension analysis and pipeline forecasting.']
  reference_number varchar [note: 'Externally-visible alphanumeric reference code for this renewal, used in correspondence with the sponsor and in CRM/ERP systems. Format: RNW-YYYY-NNNNNN.']
  renewal_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the renewal mechanism. Auto-renewal indicates contractual automatic continuation; renegotiated indicates new commercial terms were negotiated; multi-year extension indicates a long-term commitment beyond the original term; early renewal indicates proactive renewal before expiry; short-term extension indicates a bridge period.']
  sponsor_intent varchar [note: 'Account manager\'s qualitative assessment of the sponsor\'s intent to renew, captured during the negotiation phase. Supports pipeline probability scoring and retention forecasting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: strong_renew|likely_renew|neutral|likely_decline|strong_decline|unknown — promote to reference product if additional intent categories are required]']
  stage varchar [note: 'Current workflow stage of the renewal lifecycle. Initiated: renewal process has begun. Under Negotiation: active commercial discussions in progress. Agreed: terms accepted by both parties. Declined: sponsor has chosen not to renew. Lapsed: renewal window expired without resolution.']
  target_decision_date date [note: 'The internal target date by which a renewal decision (agreed or declined) should be reached. Used for pipeline management and proactive outreach scheduling.']
  territory_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country or territory code indicating the primary geographic market of the renewed sponsorship deal. Supports regional revenue reporting and rights management.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this renewal record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  uplift_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'The percentage increase or decrease in the proposed TCV relative to the original TCV. Positive values indicate commercial growth; negative values indicate concessions. Supports renewal performance benchmarking.']
  value_in_kind_proposed decimal(18,2) [note: 'The proposed non-cash value-in-kind component of the renewed deal (e.g., complimentary tickets, hospitality, media inventory). Reported separately from cash TCV for accurate revenue recognition.']

  Note: 'Transactional record tracking the renewal lifecycle of expiring sponsorship deals. Captures renewal initiation date, renewal type (auto-renewal, renegotiated, multi-year extension), proposed new TCV, proposed term dates, renewal stage (initiated, under negotiation, agreed, declined, lapsed), key negotiation notes, and outcome. Enables proactive renewal management and retention rate tracking.'
}

Territory scope is negotiated per deal and may differ across a creator\'s multiple sponsor relationships.']
  contract_end_date date [note: 'Contractual end date of this specific creator deal. Belongs to the deal to support lifecycle management, renewal tracking, and exclusivity expiry monitoring per sponsor-creator pairing.']
  contract_start_date date [note: 'Effective start date of this specific creator deal between the sponsor and the creator. Belongs to the deal, not to the creator profile, as a creator may have overlapping deals with different sponsors starting on different dates.']
  deal_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this specific creator deal. Drives workflow routing, activation eligibility, and reporting. Belongs to the deal as status is managed independently per sponsor-creator pairing.']
  exclusivity_scope varchar [note: 'Defines the product or service category for which the sponsor holds exclusivity over this creator\'s content and endorsements under this deal. Belongs to the deal because exclusivity is negotiated per sponsor-creator pairing.']
  fee_currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the flat fee and revenue share amounts in this specific deal. Belongs to the deal as currency may differ by sponsor geography.']
  flat_fee_amount decimal [note: 'Fixed monetary fee agreed for this specific creator deal activation or content production commitment. Belongs to the deal because fee terms are negotiated individually per sponsor-creator pairing.']
  nil_agreement_reference varchar [note: 'Reference number or identifier for the NIL (Name, Image, and Likeness) agreement governing this specific sponsor-creator deal. Belongs to the deal, not to the creator profile, as a creator may hold multiple NIL agreements with different sponsors simultaneously.']
  partnership_tier varchar [note: 'Commercial tier assigned to this specific creator deal based on audience reach, deal value, and activation scope. Belongs to the deal, not to the creator profile globally, as the same creator may hold different tiers with different sponsors.']
  revenue_share_pct decimal [note: 'Contractually agreed revenue share percentage paid to the creator from monetization under this specific sponsor deal. Belongs to the deal because the same creator may have different revenue share terms with different sponsors.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Contract between a sponsor and a creator_profile in the Sports Entertainment ecosystem. It captures the commercial terms, exclusivity scope, NIL agreement linkage, content rights territory, revenue share, and contract lifecycle for each unique sponsor-creator partnership. Each record links one sponsor to one creator_profile and holds attributes that exist only in the context of that specific commercial agreement — not on the sponsor master record nor on the creator profile master record.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment, sponsors actively partner with multiple content creators (influencers, NIL athletes) for branded content campaigns simultaneously, and a creator works with multiple sponsors across different brands and categories at the same time. This relationship is operationally managed as a \'Sponsorship Deal\' or \'Creator Partnership\' — a recognized business contract with its own terms, exclusivity scope, NIL agreement references, revenue share percentages, flat fees, and contract dates that belong to neither the sponsor nor the creator alone. Business teams actively create, negotiate, amend, and terminate these agreements as distinct commercial records.'
}

  cpm_rate decimal(10,4) [note: 'Cost per thousand impressions negotiated for this deal on this specific channel. This rate varies by channel and is not a deal-level attribute — it belongs exclusively to the deal-channel activation record.']
  digital_partnership_type varchar [note: 'Sub-classification of the activation type on this specific channel. Moved from deal because the same deal may activate as different partnership types on different channels (e.g., OTT title sponsor on ESPN+ but social co-branding on Instagram).']
  exclusivity_category varchar [note: 'Industry or product category within which the sponsor holds exclusive rights on this specific channel. Exclusivity scope may differ per channel (e.g., exclusive in automotive on OTT but not on social), making this a relationship-level attribute.']
  impression_commitment varchar [note: 'Contractually guaranteed number of impressions for this deal on this specific platform channel. Moved from deal because the deal-level value is an aggregate; the per-channel breakdown is the operationally meaningful unit for delivery tracking and reconciliation.']
  territory_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 territory code for this specific channel activation. A deal may be activated in different territories on different channels, so territory is tracked at the activation level.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Contract between a sponsorship deal and a distribution platform channel. It captures the specific commercial activation terms — impression commitments, CPM rates, exclusivity scope, and territory — that apply to a single deal on a single platform channel. Each record is an operationally managed entity created when a deal is activated on a channel, updated as delivery metrics are tracked, and closed when the activation period ends.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment sponsorship, a single deal (e.g., a digital platform partnership or broadcast integration) is contractually activated across multiple distribution platform channels simultaneously — an OTT app, a social media channel, and a broadcast slot may all be covered under one deal with distinct impression commitments and CPM rates per channel. Conversely, a single platform channel (e.g., ESPN+ OTT) carries activations from many concurrent sponsorship deals across different sponsors and deal types. The business actively manages these per-channel activation records, tracking impression commitments, CPM rates, exclusivity scope, and territory at the deal-channel intersection — data that belongs to neither the deal nor the channel alone.'
}

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cpm|grp|reach|frequency|engagement_rate|click_through_rate|brand_lift|conversion_rate|roi — promote to reference product]']

  is_game_used boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the SKU is a game-used item (equipment or apparel actually used during an official game or event). True requires provenance documentation, chain-of-custody tracking, and premium authentication certification.']
  is_limited_edition boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the SKU is a limited edition release with a defined production run cap. True triggers limited edition pricing strategy, scarcity marketing, and edition size tracking.']
  launch_date date [note: 'Planned or actual date on which the SKU was first made available for sale across authorized channels. Used for product lifecycle management, seasonal planning, and marketing campaign alignment.']
  license_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this SKU requires an active licensing agreement to manufacture, distribute, or sell. True for all officially licensed league, team, or athlete-branded merchandise. Drives compliance checks in the licensing workflow.']
  license_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the licensing arrangement governing this SKU. \'league\' = league-wide IP license; \'team\' = team-specific marks; \'athlete_nil\' = individual Name Image and Likeness (NIL) rights; \'event\' = event-specific (e.g., Super Bowl, World Series); \'co_branded\' = joint brand partnership; \'unlicensed\' = generic merchandise without IP.']
  lifecycle_status varchar [note: 'Current state of the SKU within its product lifecycle. \'active\' = available for sale across channels; \'discontinued\' = no longer produced or sold; \'draft\' = pending approval before activation; \'seasonal\' = available only during defined seasonal windows; \'archived\' = retained for historical reference only; \'blocked\' = temporarily suspended from sale (e.g., IP dispute, quality hold).']
  material_composition varchar [note: 'Fabric or material composition of the product (e.g., \'100% Polyester\', \'60% Cotton 40% Polyester\', \'Genuine Leather\'). Required for product labeling compliance, customs declarations, and consumer transparency regulations.']
  msrp decimal(10,2) [note: 'Manufacturer\'s Suggested Retail Price in the base currency (USD) for this SKU. Serves as the reference price point for all sales channels including Shopify Plus e-commerce, venue POS, and third-party retail. Does not represent actual transaction price.']
  product_description varchar [note: 'Detailed marketing and operational description of the product including materials, features, fit, and intended use. Used for e-commerce listings, catalog publishing, and digital asset management.']
  product_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable commercial name of the merchandise product as displayed on sales channels, e-commerce storefronts, and POS systems (e.g., \'Los Angeles Lakers City Edition Jersey – LeBron James #23\').']
  product_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the SKU represents a physical tangible good, a digital product (e.g., digital collectible, downloadable content), or a bundle of multiple items. Drives fulfillment routing and revenue recognition treatment.']
  requires_authentication boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this SKU requires a certificate of authenticity (COA) or third-party authentication (e.g., PSA/DNA, JSA) before sale. Applies to autographed memorabilia, game-used items, and high-value collectibles.']
  royalty_rate decimal(5,4) [note: 'Contractual royalty rate expressed as a decimal fraction of net sales revenue payable to the licensor (league, team, or athlete) for each unit sold. For example, 0.1500 = 15% royalty. Used in royalty tracking and financial reporting per licensing agreements.']
  sales_channel_availability varchar [note: 'Pipe-delimited list of sales channels where this SKU is authorized for sale (e.g., \'shopify_online|venue_pos|third_party_retail|dtc_app\'). Drives omnichannel availability logic and channel-specific pricing rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shopify_online|venue_pos|third_party_retail|dtc_app|wholesale|international — promote to reference product]']
  sap_material_number varchar [note: 'SAP S/4HANA Materials Management (MM) material number (MATNR field) for this SKU. Enables reconciliation between the merchandise catalog and SAP procurement, inventory valuation, and financial reporting modules.']
  shopify_variant_code varchar [note: 'Native variant identifier from the Shopify Plus e-commerce platform used for system-of-record reconciliation, API integration, and omnichannel order management. Enables traceability between the Silver Layer catalog and the Shopify Plus source system.']
  size_code varchar [note: 'Standardized size designation for the SKU variant (e.g., XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL, 3XL, 7, 7.5, 32x30). Null for non-sized items such as collectibles or accessories. Aligns with Shopify Plus variant option for size.']
  sku_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies a specific product variant (team, style, size, color combination) across all sales channels including Shopify Plus, POS, and third-party retail. Serves as the SSOT business identifier for omnichannel product lookup.']
  taxable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this SKU is subject to sales tax. Drives tax calculation at POS and e-commerce checkout. Certain memorabilia or resale items may have different tax treatment depending on jurisdiction.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to the SKU record in the merchandise catalog. Supports change data capture (CDC), data lineage tracking, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  weight_grams decimal(8,2) [note: 'Physical weight of the SKU in grams used for shipping rate calculation, customs documentation, and carrier SLA compliance across e-commerce fulfillment and third-party retail distribution.']

  Note: 'Master product catalog for all official merchandise SKUs including team apparel, memorabilia, accessories, and licensed goods. Serves as the SSOT for product identity, descriptions, brand classifications, league/team associations, and product lifecycle status across all sales channels (Shopify Plus, POS, third-party retail). Tracks SKU codes, product names, categories, sizes, colors, materials, MSRP, and licensing requirements.'
}

  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the unit_cost and inventory_value fields (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-market merchandise operations across global venues.']
  in_transit_qty varchar [note: 'Units of the SKU currently in transit to this location from another storage location (warehouse, venue, or third-party). Included in inventory planning but not yet physically received.']

  max_stock_qty varchar [note: 'Upper capacity limit for this SKU at this storage location. Prevents over-stocking and supports space planning for venue stores and warehouse zones.']
  on_hand_qty varchar [note: 'Total physical units of the SKU currently present at the storage location, including reserved and blocked stock. Sourced from Shopify Plus inventory sync or warehouse management system.']
  pos_location_code varchar [note: 'Identifier for the POS terminal or venue store location as registered in the POS system. Used to reconcile POS transaction-driven inventory deductions with Shopify Plus and SAP inventory records.']
  position_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the inventory position record. \'blocked\' indicates stock held for quality inspection or compliance review; \'pending_audit\' indicates a physical count discrepancy under investigation.']
  reorder_point_qty varchar [note: 'Stock level threshold at which a replenishment order should be initiated for this SKU at this location. Accounts for lead time and safety stock. Used by merchandise operations for automated reorder triggers.']
  reorder_qty varchar [note: 'Standard replenishment order quantity for this SKU at this location when the reorder point is reached. Reflects economic order quantity or vendor minimum order quantity.']
  reserved_qty varchar [note: 'Units of the SKU at this location that are committed to open orders, event-day allocations, or transfer requests and are not available for new sales. Sourced from Shopify Plus committed inventory.']
  safety_stock_qty varchar [note: 'Minimum buffer stock level for the SKU at this location below which a replenishment alert is triggered. Set by merchandise planners to prevent stockouts during peak event periods.']
  shopify_inventory_item_code varchar [note: 'External identifier assigned by Shopify Plus to the inventory item for this SKU. Used for real-time inventory sync between Shopify Plus and the lakehouse silver layer.']
  shopify_location_code varchar [note: 'External identifier assigned by Shopify Plus to the fulfillment location. Used to reconcile Shopify inventory levels with SAP and POS system records across omnichannel operations.']
  shrinkage_qty varchar [note: 'Cumulative units of the SKU lost at this location due to theft, damage, or unrecorded consumption since the last physical count. Used for loss prevention reporting and inventory reconciliation.']
  sku_code varchar [note: 'Human-readable alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the merchandise SKU, sourced from Shopify Plus or SAP material master. Used for omnichannel inventory reconciliation and POS scanning.']
  snapshot_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time at which this inventory position record was captured or last refreshed from the source system (Shopify Plus, POS, or warehouse management). Represents the as-of time for all quantity fields.']
  transfer_completion_date date [note: 'Date on which the most recent stock transfer to or from this inventory position was completed and receiving confirmation was recorded.']
  transfer_qty varchar [note: 'Number of units involved in the most recent or active stock transfer for this SKU-location. Captured to support transfer reconciliation and event-day stocking verification.']
  transfer_reason varchar [note: 'Business reason for the most recent stock transfer affecting this inventory position. Supports event-day logistics planning and omnichannel inventory optimization reporting.']
  transfer_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow status of the most recent stock transfer associated with this inventory position. Drives in-transit quantity calculations and fulfillment center receiving workflows.']
  unit_cost decimal(18,4) [note: 'Standard or moving average cost per unit of the SKU at this location used for inventory valuation. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA material ledger. Confidential as it reflects supplier pricing and margin data.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this inventory position record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports incremental data processing, change data capture, and audit trail requirements.']
  valuation_method varchar [note: 'Accounting method used to value inventory for this SKU at this location. Determines how unit_cost is calculated and reported on financial statements. Must align with SAP material ledger configuration.']

  Note: 'Real-time inventory management record tracking on-hand stock quantities, reserved quantities, available-to-sell units, and stock movement history for each SKU across all storage locations — venue stores, warehouse fulfillment centers, and third-party retail consignment. Captures current position (reorder points, safety stock levels, inventory valuation per location) and transfer activity (origin, destination, quantities moved, transfer reason such as rebalancing or event-day stocking, transfer status, completion date). Sourced from Shopify Plus inventory sync, POS systems, and warehouse management. Supports omnichannel inventory optimization, event-day venue stocking, and inventory reconciliation.'
}

  sku_code varchar [note: 'Human-readable alphanumeric Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) code identifying the specific product variant (e.g., team, size, color) at the time of purchase. Denormalized for auditability and reporting without requiring a join to the product catalog.']

  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for capturing additional contractual terms, special conditions, amendments, or operational notes relevant to this licensing agreement that are not captured in structured fields.']
  product_category_scope varchar [note: 'Comma-delimited list or narrative description of the merchandise product categories covered by this license (e.g., apparel, headwear, memorabilia, footwear, accessories).   royalty_rate_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'The contractually agreed royalty rate expressed as a percentage of net sales that the licensee must remit to the licensor for each unit of licensed merchandise sold.']
  royalty_reporting_frequency varchar [note: 'The contractually required frequency at which the licensee must submit royalty statements and remit royalty payments to the licensor.']
  sell_off_period_days varchar [note: 'Number of calendar days after agreement expiration or termination during which the licensee is permitted to sell existing inventory of licensed merchandise before all sales must cease.']

  supplier_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the manufacturer, brand partner, or third-party retailer receiving the IP license.']
  termination_date date [note: 'The actual date on which the agreement was terminated early, if applicable. Null if the agreement expired naturally or is still active.']
  termination_notice_days varchar [note: 'Number of calendar days of advance written notice required by either party to terminate the agreement for convenience, as specified in the contract.']
  termination_reason varchar [note: 'Reason code for early termination of the licensing agreement. Populated only when termination_date is set.']
  territory_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code defining the primary geographic territory in which the licensee is authorized to produce and sell licensed merchandise. Use \'WLD\' for worldwide agreements.']
  territory_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the authorized sales and distribution territory when the territory spans multiple countries or requires specific regional clarification beyond the primary territory code.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this licensing agreement record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and change tracking.']

  Note: 'Master record for IP licensing agreements with manufacturers, brand partners, and third-party retailers authorizing production and sale of officially licensed merchandise. Supports NIL (Name Image and Likeness) tracking for athlete-branded merchandise.'

  shipped_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time when the shipment was confirmed as dispatched and handed to the carrier. Used for SLA measurement and fulfillment lead time analytics.']
  shipping_address_line1 varchar [note: 'Primary street address line of the fan delivery destination. Required for carrier label generation. Classified as PII per GDPR and CCPA.']
  shipping_address_line2 varchar [note: 'Secondary address line (apartment, suite, unit number) for the fan delivery destination. Classified as PII per GDPR and CCPA.']
  shipping_city varchar [note: 'City of the fan delivery destination. Used for geographic delivery analytics and carrier zone determination. Classified as PII per GDPR and CCPA.']

  shipping_postal_code varchar [note: 'Postal or ZIP code of the fan delivery destination. Used for carrier zone assignment, delivery time estimation, and geographic analytics. Classified as PII per GDPR and CCPA.']
  shipping_state_province varchar [note: 'State or province of the fan delivery destination. Used for carrier zone pricing, tax jurisdiction determination, and regional fulfillment analytics.']
  shopify_fulfillment_code varchar [note: 'External fulfillment identifier assigned by Shopify Plus at the time the fulfillment record is created. Used to reconcile shipment records with the Shopify Plus e-commerce platform and DTC fulfillment workflows.']
  sla_breach boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this shipment breached the committed delivery SLA (True), meaning actual_delivery_date exceeded estimated_delivery_date. Used for DTC fulfillment SLA KPI reporting and carrier performance management.']
  tracking_number varchar [note: 'Carrier-assigned tracking number provided at the time of shipment handoff. Used by fans and operations teams to monitor parcel transit status via the carrier portal. Supports DTC SLA tracking.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this fulfillment shipment record was last modified. Used for change data capture, incremental loads, and audit trail compliance.']
  weight_kg decimal(8,3) [note: 'Actual weight of the packaged shipment in kilograms as measured at the time of dispatch. Used for carrier billing reconciliation, dimensional weight calculations, and logistics cost modeling.']

  Note: 'Outbound shipment record for merchandise orders fulfilled from warehouse or venue store to end customer. Captures carrier name, tracking number, ship date, estimated delivery date, actual delivery date, shipment status, shipping cost, package dimensions/weight, and origin location. Supports DTC e-commerce fulfillment SLA tracking and fan delivery experience management via Shopify Plus fulfillment workflows.'
}

Table merchandise.promotion_sku_inclusion {
  promotion_sku_inclusion_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the promotion_sku_inclusion association']
  promotion_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the promotional campaign that includes this SKU.']
  sku_catalog_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the specific SKU in the merchandise catalog that is included in this promotion.']
  applicable_discount_value decimal [note: 'The effective discount value applied to this specific SKU within the promotion. May differ from the promotion-level discount_value when a per-SKU override is in effect. Interpreted according to the parent promotion\'s discount_value_type.']
  applicable_sku_list varchar [note: 'Comma-delimited list of Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) codes to which this promotion is restricted when applicable_scope is \'specific_skus\'. Populated from the merchandise SKU catalog managed in Shopify Plus. Null when scope is broader than individual SKUs. [Moved from promotion: This comma-delimited STRING on promotion is a denormalized encoding of the M:N relationship between promotions and SKUs. Once the promotion_sku_inclusion association table exists, individual SKU inclusions are represented as rows in that table, making this field redundant and harmful to referential integrity. It should be removed from promotion and replaced by querying promotion_sku_inclusion.]']
  channel_restriction_override varchar [note: 'Per-SKU channel restriction that supersedes the promotion-level channel_restriction for this specific SKU inclusion. Specifies the sales channel(s) through which this SKU is eligible for the promotion (e.g., online_only, in_venue_only, all_channels). Null if the promotion-level channel_restriction applies without override.']
  inclusion_end_date timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this SKU\'s eligibility within the promotion expires. May be equal to or earlier than the parent promotion\'s end_date, allowing early removal of specific SKUs from an active campaign.']
  inclusion_start_date timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this SKU becomes eligible within the promotion window. May be equal to or later than the parent promotion\'s start_date, allowing phased SKU inclusion within a single campaign.']
  sku_specific_discount_override boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the applicable_discount_value on this inclusion record overrides the promotion-level discount. When true, the applicable_discount_value on this record takes precedence over the parent promotion\'s discount_value for this SKU.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Contract between sku_catalog and promotion. It captures the operational record of which specific SKUs are included in a promotional campaign and under what per-SKU terms. Each record links one SKU to one promotion and carries attributes — discount overrides, channel restrictions, and effective date windows — that exist only in the context of this specific SKU-promotion pairing and cannot be stored on either the SKU catalog or the promotion campaign alone.. Existence Justification: In sports merchandise retail, promotions are explicitly multi-SKU campaigns (e.g., \'all championship gear 30% off\', \'BOGO on team jerseys\') where a single promotion applies to many SKUs simultaneously, and a single SKU participates in multiple promotions across a season (e.g., a jersey SKU is included in a championship launch promo, a fan loyalty redemption promo, and an event-day discount promo). The current model stores applicable_sku_list as a denormalized STRING on the promotion record, which is a textbook normalization deficiency signaling an unmodeled M:N. The business actively manages which specific SKUs are included in each promotion, with per-SKU discount overrides, channel restrictions, and effective date windows that belong to the inclusion record itself — not to either the SKU catalog or the promotion campaign.'
}

  checksum_md5 varchar [note: 'MD5 hash checksum of the asset version file used to verify file integrity during ingest, transfer, and archival operations. Enables detection of file corruption or unauthorised modification across the content supply chain.']
  closed_caption_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this asset version contains an embedded closed-caption or subtitle track meeting ADA and FCC accessibility compliance requirements. True = closed captions present; False = no closed captions. Required for broadcast and OTT regulatory compliance.']
  codec varchar [note: 'Video codec used to encode this asset version (e.g., H.264, H.265/HEVC, ProRes 422, DNxHD, VP9, AV1). Determines compatibility with broadcast playout systems, OTT streaming platforms, and CDN delivery pipelines. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: H.264|H.265|ProRes_422|DNxHD|VP9|AV1|MPEG-2|XDCAM — promote to reference product]']
  container_format varchar [note: 'Media container format wrapping the encoded video and audio streams for this asset version (e.g., MP4, MOV, MXF, TS). Determines compatibility with broadcast ingest systems, OTT platforms, and CDN delivery infrastructure.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this asset version record was first created in the Dalet Galaxy DAM system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage, compliance reporting, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.']
  dalet_version_reference varchar [note: 'The native version identifier assigned by the Dalet Galaxy Digital Asset Management (DAM) system. Used for cross-system reconciliation and traceability back to the source system of record.']
  delivery_status varchar [note: 'Current distribution status of this asset version across its target delivery channels (CDN, OTT, broadcast). Indicates whether the version has been successfully pushed to downstream distribution endpoints or is pending, failed, or recalled.']
  drm_scheme varchar [note: 'Digital Rights Management (DRM) encryption scheme applied to this asset version for rights protection during OTT and digital distribution (e.g., Widevine for Android/Chrome, FairPlay for Apple, PlayReady for Microsoft). \'none\' indicates unencrypted internal/proxy versions.']
  duration_seconds decimal(12,3) [note: 'Total playback duration of this asset version in seconds, expressed to millisecond precision (e.g., 90.500 for a 90.5-second highlight clip). Used for broadcast scheduling, OTT metadata, and rights clearance duration validation.']
  encoding_profile_code varchar [note: 'Reference to the encoding profile configuration used to transcode this asset version, defining the target codec, bitrate ladder, resolution, and container format parameters. Links to the encoding profile reference product.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Date on which the distribution rights for this asset version expire, after which the version must be recalled from active delivery channels. Drives automated rights expiry workflows and CDN takedown processes.']
  file_size_bytes varchar [note: 'Total file size of this asset version in bytes. Used for storage capacity planning, CDN egress cost estimation, and transfer time forecasting across distribution channels.']
  frame_rate decimal(6,3) [note: 'Video frame rate in frames per second (fps) for this asset version (e.g., 23.976, 25.000, 29.970, 50.000, 59.940). Critical for broadcast playout compatibility, sports slow-motion replay quality, and OTT streaming optimisation.']
  hdr_standard varchar [note: 'High Dynamic Range (HDR) standard applied to this asset version (e.g., HDR10, HLG for broadcast, Dolby Vision for premium OTT). \'SDR\' indicates standard dynamic range. Determines compatibility with premium broadcast and OTT delivery tiers.']
  is_primary_version boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this version is designated as the primary/canonical version of the parent asset for a given rendition type. True = primary version used for default delivery; False = alternate or superseded version. Supports version selection logic in delivery workflows.']
  language_code varchar [note: 'Primary audio language of this asset version expressed as an IETF BCP 47 language tag (e.g., \'en\', \'es\', \'fr\', \'pt-BR\'). Used for OTT platform metadata, broadcast scheduling, and international distribution routing.']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this asset version record was last updated in the Dalet Galaxy DAM system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance.']
  published_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this asset version was published and made available on its target distribution channel (OTT platform, CDN, broadcast playout, social media). Represents the business event time of content going live.']
  rendition_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the version rendition purpose within the content delivery chain. Proxy: low-resolution review copy; Mezzanine: intermediate editing master; Broadcast Master: broadcast-quality final; Social Cut: platform-optimised social media version; Thumbnail: still image preview; Audio Only: audio-only extract.']
  resolution_height_px varchar [note: 'Vertical pixel dimension of the video frame for this asset version (e.g., 1080 for Full HD, 2160 for 4K UHD, 720 for HD, 360 for proxy). Used alongside resolution_width_px to fully qualify the frame resolution for delivery channel routing.']
  resolution_width_px varchar [note: 'Horizontal pixel dimension of the video frame for this asset version (e.g., 1920 for Full HD, 3840 for 4K UHD, 1280 for HD, 640 for proxy). Used for delivery channel qualification and broadcast compliance.']
  rights_clearance_status varchar [note: 'Current Intellectual Property (IP) rights clearance status for this specific asset version, indicating whether the version is cleared for distribution, pending rights review, restricted to specific channels, expired, or under dispute. Governs delivery eligibility.']
  rights_territory varchar [note: 'Geographic territory or territories for which this asset version holds cleared distribution rights, expressed as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or regional groupings (e.g., \'USA\', \'GBR\', \'WORLDWIDE\', \'EU\'). Drives geo-blocking and CDN routing decisions.']
  storage_tier varchar [note: 'Storage tier classification for this asset version based on access frequency and retention requirements. Hot: active production use; Warm: recent but less frequent access; Cold: infrequent access; Archive: long-term retention. Drives storage cost optimisation decisions.']
  storage_uri varchar [note: 'Full storage path or URI pointing to the physical location of this asset version file (e.g., s3://sports-ent-dam/content/2024/highlights/v2/file.mxf, or NAS/SAN path). Classified confidential as it reveals internal infrastructure topology.']
  subtitle_language_code varchar [note: 'Language of embedded or associated subtitle/closed-caption track for this asset version, expressed as an IETF BCP 47 language tag. Supports ADA closed-captioning compliance and international OTT distribution requirements.']
  transcoding_completed_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the transcoding job for this asset version was successfully completed. Used alongside transcoding_started_timestamp to calculate transcoding duration for SLA compliance and capacity planning.']
  transcoding_error_message varchar [note: 'Error message or failure reason captured when the transcoding job for this asset version fails (transcoding_status = \'failed\'). Used for operational troubleshooting, SLA breach root-cause analysis, and automated retry logic.']
  transcoding_started_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the transcoding job for this asset version was initiated in the Dalet Galaxy transcoding workflow. Used for SLA monitoring, job queue performance analysis, and delivery timeline tracking.']
  transcoding_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the transcoding workflow for this asset version. Tracks the progression from pending job submission through active transcoding to completion, failure, or cancellation. Critical for CDN and OTT delivery readiness monitoring.']
  version_label varchar [note: 'Human-readable label identifying this version rendition (e.g., \'v1-broadcast-master\', \'v2-social-cut-instagram\', \'v3-proxy-review\'). Supports editorial workflow communication and delivery tracking.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Sequential integer version number for this rendition of the parent asset, incremented each time a new version is created (e.g., 1, 2, 3). Supports version lineage tracking and rollback workflows.']
  watermark_type varchar [note: 'Type of watermarking applied to this asset version for content protection and piracy detection. \'Visible\': on-screen branding watermark; \'Forensic\': invisible forensic watermark for leak tracing; \'Both\': both types applied; \'None\': no watermark.']

  Note: 'Tracks every versioned rendition of a content asset — proxy, mezzanine, broadcast-quality, social-cut, thumbnail — including codec, resolution, bitrate, file size, storage location, and transcoding status. Supports multi-format delivery across CDN, OTT, and broadcast channels.'
}

Rights agreements may restrict distribution to SD or HD quality on certain platforms or territories. SD=Standard Definition, HD=High Definition, FHD=Full HD 1080p, 4K=Ultra HD, 8K=Super Hi-Vision.']
  revenue_share_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'The percentage of platform revenue attributable to this content that is shared back to the rights holder under the terms of this distribution window. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 25.00 = 25%). Null if a flat fee model applies.']
  rights_clearance_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the rights clearance process for this distribution window. \'cleared\' = all rights have been verified and approved for distribution; \'pending\' = clearance in progress; \'rejected\' = clearance denied; \'expired\' = clearance previously granted but now lapsed; \'under_review\' = flagged for legal or compliance review.']
  rights_fee_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The contracted rights fee amount payable for this distribution window, expressed in the currency specified by rights_fee_currency_code. Represents the financial consideration for the license grant. Classified as confidential due to commercially sensitive contract terms.']
  rights_fee_currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the rights fee amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency rights agreements across global markets.']
  rights_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional rights conditions, special contractual provisions, or legal annotations specific to this distribution window that are not captured in structured fields. Classified as confidential due to commercially sensitive contract details.']
  rights_window_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for the rights window, sourced from Dalet Galaxy DAM or the rights management system. Used for cross-system reconciliation and rights clearance tracking.']
  rights_window_end date [note: 'The date on which the distribution rights window closes for this asset on this specific digital touchpoint. After this date the asset must be suppressed from the channel.']
  rights_window_start date [note: 'The date on which the asset becomes available for distribution on this specific digital touchpoint. Varies per asset-channel combination and cannot reside on either parent entity alone.']
  sublicensing_permitted_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the rights holder has authorized sublicensing of this content to third-party distributors within this window. True = sublicensing allowed; False = sublicensing prohibited. Critical for IP and rights chain management.']
  territory_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the primary geographic territory for this rights window. Used for rights enforcement, GDPR/CCPA compliance scoping, and league territory governance.']
  watermarking_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether digital watermarking must be applied to content distributed under this rights window for piracy detection and rights enforcement purposes. True = watermarking mandatory per contract or DRM policy.']
  window_end_datetime timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time (exclusive) at which this content rights distribution window expires and content distribution must cease. Null indicates an open-ended window with no defined expiry. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.']
  window_start_datetime timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time (inclusive) at which this content rights distribution window becomes effective and content may be distributed on the specified platform and territory. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.']
  window_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the content rights window. \'active\' means the window is currently in effect; \'scheduled\' means it is approved but not yet started; \'expired\' means the window end datetime has passed; \'suspended\' means temporarily halted pending review; \'cancelled\' means permanently revoked; \'pending_clearance\' means awaiting DRM rights clearance approval.']
  window_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the rights window by broadcast/distribution run type. \'first_run\' = initial broadcast/distribution; \'repeat\' = subsequent re-broadcast; \'archive\' = historical/library content; \'live\' = live event distribution; \'near_live\' = delayed live (e.g., same-day replay); \'catch_up\' = post-broadcast catch-up window.']

  Note: 'Defines time-bounded distribution windows for content rights — specifying platform, territory, start/end datetime, exclusivity flag, blackout rules, and associated rights clearance. Enables scheduling of content availability across OTT, RSN, PPV, and social channels within contracted rights periods.'
}

  storage_tier varchar [note: 'Storage tier classification assigned to the ingested content based on access frequency and retention policy. Hot tier for active production assets, warm for recent archive, cold for long-term retention, archive for compliance-only storage.']

  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Audit timestamp recording when this ingest job record was last modified in the DAM system. Supports change tracking and incremental Silver layer processing.']

  Note: 'Transactional record for each content ingest event into the DAM — capturing source system (OB truck, camera card, social feed, UGC upload), ingest timestamp, file manifest, quality check status, metadata extraction results, and destination storage path. Sourced from Dalet Galaxy DAM rights metadata.']
  effective_end_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the license agreement expires and content distribution rights are revoked. Null for perpetual or open-ended agreements. Triggers renewal workflow when approaching.']
  effective_from_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the vendor\'s rights under this license agreement become active and the vendor may begin using the asset. Used for distribution window enforcement and rights scheduling.']
  effective_start_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the license agreement becomes legally binding and content distribution rights are activated. Aligns with contract execution date or agreed commencement date.']
  effective_until_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the vendor\'s rights under this license agreement expire. After this date the vendor must cease use of the asset. Triggers automated rights-expiry workflows in the DAM and DRM systems.']
  exclusivity_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this license grants the vendor exclusive rights to the asset within the defined territory_scope. When true, no other vendor may hold a concurrent license for the same asset in the same territory. Critical for rights conflict detection.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Date on which the asset\'s distribution rights or licence window expires and the asset must be withdrawn from active distribution channels. Critical for DRM (Digital Rights Management) enforcement and rights clearance compliance. [Moved from asset: expiry_date on the asset master conflates the asset\'s overall distribution window with the expiry of individual vendor licenses. A single asset may have licenses expiring on different dates for different vendors. The per-license expiry belongs on content_license.effective_until_date; the asset-level expiry_date should represent the latest possible distribution window across all licenses, not a specific vendor\'s term.]']
  fee_amount decimal [note: 'Agreed monetary consideration paid by the vendor to Sports Entertainment for the rights granted under this license. Expressed in the currency defined by license_fee_currency. Belongs to the license agreement, not to the asset or vendor master.']
  fee_currency varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the license_fee_amount is denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required to support multi-currency rights deals with international broadcasters.']
  fee_structure varchar [note: 'Commercial model governing how the licensee compensates Sports Entertainment: flat_fee (fixed one-time or periodic payment), royalty (per-use or per-unit fee), revenue_share (percentage of licensee revenue), cpm_based (Cost Per Mille impression-based), subscription (periodic access fee), free (no monetary consideration, e.g., promotional or editorial). Drives invoicing logic in SAP S/4HANA SD.']
  feed_frequency varchar [note: 'Cadence at which content is delivered to the licensee under ongoing syndication or broadcast feed arrangements: real_time, hourly, daily, weekly, on_demand (licensee-initiated pull), event_triggered (delivery upon specific event occurrence). Null for one-off licenses.']
  flat_fee_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Fixed monetary amount payable by the licensee for the license term when fee_structure is flat_fee or subscription. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code. Null for royalty or revenue_share structures.']
  last_compliance_review_date date [note: 'Date on which the most recent compliance audit or review of the license was conducted. Used to schedule periodic compliance checks and track regulatory adherence timelines.']
  license_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable descriptive name of the license agreement (e.g., \'ESPN NFL Highlight Syndication 2025\', \'UEFA Champions League Photo License — Getty Images\'). Used in reporting and partner communications.']
  license_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric reference code for the license agreement, used in partner correspondence, invoicing, and legal documentation. Format: LIC-{DOMAIN}-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}.']
  license_scope varchar [note: 'Defines the permitted scope of use for this specific IP asset within the license agreement (e.g., broadcast_only, merchandise, digital_streaming). Scope may differ per IP asset within the same license.']
  license_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the license agreement: draft (being negotiated), active (in force), suspended (temporarily halted due to breach or dispute), expired (past end date without renewal), terminated (cancelled before end date), pending_renewal (auto-renewal under review).']
  max_usage_count varchar [note: 'Maximum number of times the licensee is permitted to use, broadcast, or distribute the licensed content within the license term. Null indicates unlimited usage. Enables usage cap enforcement and royalty calculation.']
  payment_frequency varchar [note: 'Cadence at which the licensee is invoiced or remits payment: one_time (single payment), monthly, quarterly, semi_annual, annual. Drives billing schedule generation in SAP S/4HANA SD.']
  renewal_notice_days varchar [note: 'Number of calendar days prior to effective_end_date by which either party must provide written notice of intent not to renew. Drives automated renewal notification workflows.']
  renewal_term_months varchar [note: 'Duration in months of each automatic renewal cycle. Applicable only when auto_renewal_flag is True. Used to project future effective_end_date upon renewal.']
  revenue_share_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of licensee-generated revenue remitted to Sports Entertainment under a revenue_share fee structure (e.g., 30.00 = 30%). Used in ARPU and ARR revenue forecasting and partner settlement calculations.']
  rights_clearance_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the inbound Digital Rights Management (DRM) clearance record that authorizes Sports Entertainment to sub-license or distribute this content outbound.']
  rights_territory varchar [note: 'Geographic territory or territories in which the asset is licensed for distribution, expressed as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or a named territory group (e.g., USA, GBR, WORLDWIDE, EU_EXCL_UK). Enforced at CDN distribution layer for geo-blocking compliance. [Moved from asset: rights_territory on the asset master represents a default or aggregate territory, but the actual licensed territory is specific to each vendor-asset license agreement. When the same asset is licensed to multiple vendors across different territories, a single rights_territory field on the asset cannot represent all concurrent license scopes. The per-license territory belongs on content_license.territory_scope.]']
  royalty_rate decimal(8,4) [note: 'Per-use or per-unit royalty rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 = 5%). Applicable when fee_structure is royalty. Used to calculate royalty invoices based on reported usage volumes.']
  signed_date date [note: 'Date on which all parties executed the license agreement. May differ from effective_start_date when agreements are backdated or have a future commencement.']
  sport_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code identifying the sport associated with the licensed content (e.g., NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA, UFC, ATP). Populated when content_scope is sport, league, event, or season. Enables sport-level rights analytics.']
  sublicense_permitted boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the licensee is contractually permitted to sublicense the content to third parties. True = sublicensing allowed (subject to conditions); False = sublicensing prohibited. Critical for IP chain-of-title integrity.']
  territory_exclusivity varchar [note: 'Defines whether the licensee holds exclusive rights in the specified territory (exclusive), shares rights with other licensees (non_exclusive), or holds first-window broadcast priority before other licensees (first_window). Directly impacts RSN and OTT deal structuring.']
  ugc_rights_included boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the license grants the licensee rights to use or incorporate User-Generated Content (UGC) associated with the licensed assets (e.g., fan footage, social clips). True = UGC rights included; False = excluded.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to the license record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit compliance.']
  usage_rights_granted varchar [note: 'Classification of the media usage rights conveyed to the vendor under this license agreement. Determines which distribution channels and use cases the vendor is permitted to exercise.']
  usage_type varchar [note: 'Permitted exploitation category for the licensed content: broadcast (linear TV/radio), streaming_ott (Over-The-Top Streaming platforms), social_media (social channel posting), editorial (news/journalism), commercial (advertising/promotional), print (physical/digital publication), digital_display (website/app display). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: broadcast|streaming_ott|social_media|editorial|commercial|print|digital_display|ppv|dtc|iptv — promote to reference product]']
  watermark_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the licensee is contractually required to apply a visible or forensic watermark to distributed content for IP tracking and anti-piracy enforcement. True = watermark mandatory; False = not required.']

  Note: 'Master record for all outbound content commercialization agreements — covering individual asset licenses, bulk syndication deals (ongoing content feeds to media partners), third-party media outlet arrangements, social platform partnerships, broadcast partner feeds, and commercial licensees. Captures licensee/partner identity, licensed scope (asset, collection, sport, league), deal type (one-off license, ongoing syndication, revenue-share partnership), territory, usage type, fee structure (flat fee, royalty, revenue share), delivery format and schedule, content feed frequency, start/end dates, auto-renewal terms, and compliance status. SSOT for all outbound content monetization distinct from inbound rights_clearance.'
