Table content.content_drm_policy {
  content_drm_policy_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for a DRM enforcement policy record within the content protection framework. Primary key for this reference entity.']
  approved_by_employee_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: DRM policy governance requires tracking the approving employee for compliance audits, policy change management, and regulatory accountability. The existing \'approved_by\' plain string is a denormalized']
  superseded_by_policy_content_drm_policy_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the content_drm_policy_id of the newer policy that replaces this one when status is \'deprecated\'. Enables policy lineage tracking and ensures content operations teams can identify the current active replacement policy.']
  allowed_device_types varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of device categories permitted for playback under this DRM policy (e.g., \'mobile,tablet,smart_tv,web,stb,gaming_console\'). Null indicates all device types are permitted. Enforces device-level access restrictions per rights agreements and platform licensing terms.']
  allowed_territory_codes varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where content playback is permitted under this DRM policy (e.g., \'USA,CAN,GBR\'). Null indicates no territory allowlist (use blocked_territory_codes instead). Enforces broadcast rights territorial boundaries for RSN, OTT, and international distribution.']
  anti_piracy_level varchar [note: 'Tiered classification of the anti-piracy enforcement intensity applied under this DRM policy. \'standard\' = baseline DRM encryption; \'enhanced\' = DRM + watermarking + CDN token auth; \'maximum\' = all protections including forensic watermarking, screen capture blocking, and real-time piracy monitoring. Aligns with content value and rights holder requirements.']
  approved_date date [note: 'Date on which this DRM policy was formally approved for production use by the authorized rights administrator or legal team. Required for compliance audit trails under SOX and rights governance frameworks.']
  blackout_rule_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether local market blackout rules are enforced under this DRM policy. When True, content is blocked in the home market of the competing teams or venue to protect local broadcast rights. Applies primarily to RSN and league-mandated blackout policies for NFL, NBA, MLB, and NHL.']
  blocked_territory_codes varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where content playback is explicitly blocked under this DRM policy (e.g., \'CHN,PRK\'). Used as a denylist when most territories are permitted but specific markets are excluded due to rights restrictions or regulatory requirements.']
  cdn_token_auth_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether CDN-level token authentication is required for content delivery under this DRM policy. When True, signed URL tokens are required to access content from the CDN, providing an additional security layer beyond DRM license enforcement.']
  concurrent_stream_limit varchar [note: 'Maximum number of simultaneous active streams permitted per subscriber or license token under this DRM policy. Enforced at the license server level to prevent credential sharing and unauthorized multi-device access. Directly impacts OTT subscriber experience and revenue protection.']
  content_rating_restriction varchar [note: 'Minimum content rating classification that this DRM policy is authorized to protect and distribute. Ensures age-appropriate access controls are enforced alongside DRM protections. Aligns with FCC content rating standards for broadcast and OTT platforms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: G|PG|PG-13|R|NC-17|TV-Y|TV-G|TV-PG|TV-14|TV-MA — promote to reference product]']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this DRM policy record was first created in the system. Populated automatically at record insertion. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  drm_system varchar [note: 'The DRM technology system used to enforce license-based playback protection. \'Widevine\' = Google/Android/Chrome; \'PlayReady\' = Microsoft/Xbox; \'FairPlay\' = Apple/iOS/tvOS; \'multi_drm\' = simultaneous multi-system packaging for cross-platform OTT distribution.']
  effective_from date [note: 'Date from which this DRM policy becomes active and can be applied to content packaging workflows. Aligns with the start of the underlying rights agreement period. Used by Dalet Galaxy DAM to determine applicable policies at content publish time.']
  effective_until date [note: 'Date after which this DRM policy expires and can no longer be applied to new content packages. Null for open-ended policies with no defined expiry. Triggers policy review workflows in Dalet Galaxy DAM when approaching expiry.']
  encryption_scheme varchar [note: 'Cryptographic encryption standard applied to content packages under this DRM policy. \'CENC\' (Common Encryption) and \'CBCS\' are ISO 23001-7 standards used for multi-DRM packaging across Widevine, PlayReady, and FairPlay systems. Governs how content is encrypted at the CDN packaging layer.']
  geo_blocking_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether geographic access restrictions are enforced under this DRM policy. When True, the allowed_territory_codes and blocked_territory_codes fields define the geographic enforcement scope. Critical for RSN blackout rules, international broadcast rights, and FIFA/IOC territorial licensing.']
  license_duration_seconds varchar [note: 'Maximum duration in seconds for which a DRM license issued under this policy remains valid for playback. Controls license renewal frequency and session persistence. A value of 0 indicates a persistent license with no expiry. Critical for PPV and live event access control.']
  license_renewal_type varchar [note: 'Defines the license persistence and renewal behavior for content playback under this DRM policy. \'persistent\' = license stored on device across sessions; \'session\' = license valid only for current playback session; \'renewable\' = license auto-renews before expiry; \'non_renewable\' = single-use license.']
  max_resolution varchar [note: 'Maximum video resolution permitted for playback under this DRM policy. \'SD\' = Standard Definition (up to 480p); \'HD\' = High Definition (720p); \'FHD\' = Full HD (1080p); \'UHD_4K\' = Ultra HD 4K (2160p); \'UHD_8K\' = Ultra HD 8K. Enforces resolution caps based on subscription tier and device security level.']
  offline_download_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this DRM policy permits subscribers to download content for offline playback on authorized devices. When True, offline_download_expiry_hours governs the download window. Governed by rights agreements and CBA terms for league content.']
  offline_download_expiry_hours varchar [note: 'Number of hours after which an offline downloaded content license expires and the content becomes unplayable without re-authentication. Null when offline_download_enabled is False. Enforces time-limited offline access per rights agreements.']
  output_protection_level varchar [note: 'Hardware output protection standard required on playback devices under this DRM policy. \'hdcp_1x\' / \'hdcp_2x\' = High-bandwidth Digital Content Protection for HDMI/DisplayPort; \'cgms_a\' = Copy Generation Management System for analog outputs; \'macrovision\' = legacy analog copy protection. Governs content security on connected TV and set-top box devices.']
  policy_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the DRM policy, used in content packaging workflows, API calls, and CDN configuration references (e.g., DRM-OTT-LIVE-001). Sourced from Dalet Galaxy DAM policy registry.']
  policy_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative describing the business intent, scope, and enforcement rules of this DRM policy. Used by rights clearance teams, legal, and broadcast operations for governance documentation.']
  policy_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable label for the DRM policy used by content operations teams and rights administrators (e.g., \'NFL Sunday Ticket OTT Premium\', \'UFC PPV Geo-Restricted LATAM\'). Displayed in Dalet Galaxy DAM and Adobe Experience Platform configuration UIs.']
  policy_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the DRM policy governing whether it can be applied to new content packages. \'draft\' = under review; \'active\' = in production use; \'suspended\' = temporarily disabled; \'deprecated\' = superseded by newer policy; \'archived\' = retired from use.']
  policy_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the DRM policy by content delivery modality. \'live_stream\' = real-time OTT streaming; \'vod\' = video-on-demand; \'ppv\' = Pay-Per-View (PPV) event; \'download\' = offline download; \'broadcast\' = linear broadcast; \'ugc\' = User-Generated Content (UGC) protection.']
  purchase_window_hours varchar [note: 'Number of hours from license issuance within which the subscriber must initiate first playback before the license expires unused. Null for subscription-based policies. Enforces time-to-first-play restrictions on transactional DTC content purchases.']
  rental_window_hours varchar [note: 'Number of hours from first playback initiation during which the content remains accessible under a rental or PPV license. Null for subscription-based or permanent access policies. Applies to PPV event replays and transactional VOD content.']
  rights_clearance_reference varchar [note: 'Reference number or identifier linking this DRM policy to the underlying rights clearance agreement or contract in the rights management system. Enables audit traceability between DRM enforcement rules and the legal rights instruments that authorize them. Confidential business data.']
  rights_owner varchar [note: 'Name of the entity that holds the intellectual property (IP) and distribution rights governing this DRM policy (e.g., \'NFL Media\', \'UFC/TKO Group\', \'FIFA Media Rights\'). Used for rights clearance audit trails and DRM policy attribution in Dalet Galaxy DAM.']
  screen_capture_blocked boolean [note: 'Indicates whether screen capture and screen recording are blocked on devices playing content under this DRM policy. Enforced via OS-level DRM APIs (e.g., Android FLAG_SECURE, iOS DRM restrictions). Critical for PPV and premium live event content protection.']
  source_system_reference varchar [note: 'Identifier of the originating system record for this DRM policy (e.g., Dalet Galaxy DAM policy object ID). Enables traceability from the Databricks Silver Layer back to the operational system of record for reconciliation and lineage purposes.']
  subscriber_tier_restriction varchar [note: 'Minimum subscription tier required to receive a DRM license under this policy. \'all\' = no tier restriction; \'basic\' = entry-level subscription; \'standard\' = mid-tier; \'premium\' = top-tier subscription; \'vip\' = VIP/exclusive access; \'ppv_only\' = Pay-Per-View (PPV) purchase required. Enforced at license issuance by the entitlement system.']
  token_expiry_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration in seconds for which a CDN signed URL token remains valid under this DRM policy. Null when cdn_token_auth_enabled is False. Short expiry windows (e.g., 300 seconds) reduce the risk of URL sharing for premium live events.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this DRM policy record was last modified. Updated automatically on any field change. Used for change detection, incremental processing in the Databricks lakehouse pipeline, and compliance audit trails.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Semantic version number of this DRM policy definition (e.g., \'1.0\', \'2.3.1\'). Incremented when policy parameters are updated. Enables content packages to reference the specific policy version applied at packaging time for audit and compliance traceability.']
  watermark_type varchar [note: 'Type of watermarking applied to content under this DRM policy. \'forensic\' = invisible session-level watermark for piracy tracing; \'visible\' = on-screen branding/logo overlay; \'session\' = per-viewer session identifier embedded in stream; \'broadcast\' = Nielsen/Kantar audience measurement watermark; \'none\' = no watermarking applied.']
  watermarking_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether forensic or visible watermarking is applied to content distributed under this DRM policy. Watermarking enables source tracing for piracy detection and leak attribution. Critical for PPV events, premium OTT content, and broadcast feeds.']

  Note: 'Reference entity defining DRM enforcement policies applied during content packaging and distribution — specifying encryption scheme, playback device restrictions, offline download rules, concurrent stream limits, geo-blocking rules, and watermarking requirements. Applied at publish time to govern content protection across OTT and digital platforms.'

  signed_date date [note: 'The date on which all parties executed the syndication agreement. May differ from contract_start_date for pre-signed or retroactive agreements. Used for legal audit trails and SOX compliance.']
  sport_discipline varchar [note: 'The sport or sports discipline whose content is covered by this syndication deal (e.g., \'American Football\', \'Basketball\', \'Soccer\', \'Ice Hockey\', \'Mixed Martial Arts\'). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: american_football|basketball|soccer|ice_hockey|baseball|tennis|mma|golf|motorsport|multi_sport — promote to reference product]']
  sublicensing_permitted boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the syndication partner is contractually permitted to sublicense the received content to downstream third parties. Critical for IP protection and rights chain integrity.']
  syndication_fee_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The fixed periodic fee charged to the syndication partner for access to the content feed, expressed in the deal currency.   termination_date date [note: 'The actual date on which the syndication deal was terminated early, if applicable. Null if the deal expired naturally at contract_end_date or is still active. Distinct from contract_end_date which is the planned expiry.']

  Note: 'Master record for content syndication agreements with third-party media partners — capturing partner identity reference, syndicated content scope (sport, league, asset type), territory, syndication fee, revenue share terms, delivery format, delivery schedule, and contract period. Distinct from content_license in that syndication deals govern ongoing bulk content feeds rather than individual asset licenses.'
}

Table content.license {
  license_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for license']
  asset_id varchar [note: 'Auto-generated FK linking siloed license to asset']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Contract between a digital content asset and an external vendor (broadcaster, OTT platform, RSN, or distributor). It captures the formal licensing agreement under which Sports Entertainment grants a vendor the right to use a specific asset within defined territorial, exclusivity, and temporal boundaries. Each record links one asset to one vendor and carries the financial, geographic, and rights-scope attributes that exist only in the context of that specific license grant — not on the asset master or the vendor master alone.. Existence Justification: In sports-entertainment rights management, a single digital content asset (e.g., an NFL highlight reel) is simultaneously licensed to multiple vendors — a broadcast partner, an OTT platform, and a regional sports network — each under distinct territorial, exclusivity, and financial terms. Conversely, a single vendor (e.g., ESPN) holds active licenses to thousands of assets across multiple sports disciplines. The business actively creates, negotiates, renews, and terminates these license agreements as a core rights-management process, and each agreement carries its own fee, territory scope, exclusivity flag, and validity window that cannot reside on either the asset or vendor record alone.'
}

  territory_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to content.territory. Business justification: Revenue attribution tracks revenue by territory. Currently has territory_code STRING which should be normalized to territory.territory_id FK for referential integrity. Territory is the master referenc']
  platform_type varchar [note: 'The distribution platform or channel through which this asset generates revenue under the associated stream (e.g., broadcast, OTT, PPV). Determines the applicable rights terms and revenue recognition method for this specific attribution record.']
  revenue_amount decimal [note: 'The monetary amount of revenue allocated to this specific asset under this revenue stream for the defined window and territory. Used for rights valuation, royalty calculation, and segment P&L reporting. Denominated in the currency of the parent revenue stream.']
  window_end date [note: 'The calendar date on which the monetisation window for this asset under this revenue stream concludes. After this date, the asset is no longer eligible for revenue attribution under this stream unless a new record is created.']
  window_start date [note: 'The calendar date on which the monetisation window for this asset under this revenue stream begins. Defines the start of the period during which revenue can be recognised for this asset-stream-territory combination.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Contract between asset and revenue_stream. It captures the operational record of how a specific digital content asset is monetised under a specific revenue stream, including the geographic territory, distribution platform, monetisation window, and allocated revenue amount. Each record links one asset to one revenue_stream with attributes that exist only in the context of this rights-window attribution relationship, supporting rights valuation, royalty calculation, and segment P&L reporting.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment, a single digital content asset (e.g., a broadcast highlight reel) genuinely generates revenue across multiple simultaneous streams — broadcast rights, OTT subscription, and PPV — while each revenue stream (e.g., \'Broadcast Rights\') contains revenue attributable to many distinct assets. Finance actively manages this relationship for rights valuation, royalty calculation, and P&L attribution, making it an operationally managed entity, not a derived analytical correlation. The relationship carries its own data (territory, platform, window dates, allocated revenue amounts) that belongs to neither the asset nor the revenue stream alone.'
}

Table content.channel_jurisdiction_authorization {
  channel_jurisdiction_authorization_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the channel_jurisdiction_authorization association']
  jurisdiction_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking this authorization record to the specific gaming regulatory jurisdiction governing the channel\'s operation.']
  platform_channel_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking this authorization record to the specific distribution platform channel being authorized in the jurisdiction.']
  content_rights_status varchar [note: 'Current status of content rights clearance for this platform channel within this jurisdiction. Reflects whether rights have been cleared, are pending review, or have been denied for this channel-jurisdiction combination.']
  effective_from_date date [note: 'Date on which the platform channel\'s regulatory authorization to distribute wagering-related content in this jurisdiction became effective. Belongs to the authorization record, not to either the channel or the jurisdiction alone.']
  effective_until_date date [note: 'Date on which the platform channel\'s regulatory authorization in this jurisdiction expires or is scheduled to expire. Null if the authorization is open-ended or tied to the jurisdiction license expiry.']
  regulatory_approval_reference varchar [note: 'Reference identifier for the specific regulatory filing, approval document, or compliance submission that authorizes this platform channel to operate in this jurisdiction. Serves as the audit trail link to the regulatory body\'s records.']
  wagering_permitted_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether wagering-related content (odds, live betting, DFS) is permitted for distribution on this specific platform channel within this specific jurisdiction. A channel may be authorized in a jurisdiction but restricted from wagering content specifically.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the regulatory Authorization contract between a platform_channel and a gaming_jurisdiction. It captures the per-channel, per-jurisdiction compliance record that governs whether and how a distribution platform channel is permitted to deliver wagering-related content within a specific gaming regulatory jurisdiction. Each record links one platform_channel to one gaming_jurisdiction and carries the authorization status, effective dates, and regulatory approval reference that exist only in the context of this specific channel-jurisdiction pairing.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment, a streaming or broadcast platform channel (e.g., an OTT app or DTC streaming service) must obtain regulatory authorization to operate in each gaming jurisdiction where it distributes wagering-related content. A single platform channel operates across many jurisdictions (e.g., a national OTT app active in 15 licensed US states), and each jurisdiction governs multiple platform channels (e.g., New Jersey authorizes ESPN+, FanDuel TV, and a DTC app). The business actively manages this relationship as a named compliance process — tracking per-jurisdiction authorization status, effective dates, and regulatory approval references for each platform-channel/jurisdiction combination.'
}

  division_name varchar [note: 'Official full name of the division as designated by the governing league body (e.g., \'NFC East\', \'AL Central\', \'Atlantic Division\', \'Pacific Division\'). Used in standings displays, broadcast graphics, and official publications.']

  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for league administrators to record significant contextual notes about the season (e.g., rule changes, format modifications, special circumstances). Used for governance documentation and historical reference.']
  officiating_system varchar [note: 'The video review and officiating technology system in use for this season: VAR (Video Assistant Referee) for soccer/football, TMO (Television Match Official) for rugby, challenge_system for MLB/NFL, or standard for traditional officiating without video review. Governs officiating assignment and incident review workflows.']
  playoff_format varchar [note: 'The bracket format used for the postseason: single_elimination (one loss ends participation), best_of_series (series of games, e.g., best-of-7), double_elimination, round_robin, or hybrid. Governs bracket structure, scheduling, and broadcast rights for postseason.']
  playoff_rounds varchar [note: 'Total number of rounds in the postseason bracket from first round through championship (e.g., 4 rounds for NBA: First Round, Semifinals, Conference Finals, Finals). Drives bracket position assignments and series scheduling.']
  playoff_teams varchar [note: 'Total number of franchises/teams that qualify for the postseason bracket (e.g., 12 for NFL, 16 for NBA, 16 for NHL). Determines seeding slots, bracket size, and bye eligibility.']
  postseason_end_date date [note: 'Official last date of the postseason including the championship event. Marks the close of the competitive season for all governance and compliance purposes.']
  postseason_start_date date [note: 'Official start date of the postseason/playoff bracket. Triggers playoff ticketing, broadcast rights escalation, and championship merchandise activation.']
  regular_season_end_date date [note: 'Official last date of the regular season schedule before postseason begins. Used to finalize standings, seeding, and playoff bracket assignments.']
  regular_season_start_date date [note: 'Official start date of the regular season competitive schedule, distinct from preseason. Used to trigger standings calculations, fantasy sports activations, and broadcast rights windows.']
  roster_freeze_date date [note: 'The date by which all franchise rosters must be finalized and submitted to the league for the season. Triggers eligibility locks for regular season and postseason participation.']
  salary_cap_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The maximum total player salary expenditure permitted per franchise for this season as set by the CBA. Expressed in USD. Anchors all salary cap compliance checks, contract valuations, and trade deadline calculations.']
  salary_cap_currency varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the salary cap amount (e.g., USD, CAD). Required for multi-national leagues such as NHL and MLS where franchises operate in different currency jurisdictions.']
  salary_cap_year_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this season constitutes a salary cap year for compliance and roster management purposes. When true, salary cap rules, luxury tax thresholds, and CBA roster limits apply to all franchises for this season.']
  season_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the season across systems (e.g., \'NFL-2024-REG\', \'NBA-2024-25\'). Used as the business key in scheduling, ticketing, and broadcast rights systems.']
  season_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable display name for the season (e.g., \'2024-25 NBA Regular Season\', \'2024 NFL Season\'). Used in fan-facing platforms, broadcast graphics, and reporting dashboards.']
  season_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the season: upcoming (scheduled but not started), active (currently in progress), suspended (temporarily halted, e.g., due to labor dispute or force majeure), completed (all games concluded), or cancelled (season voided). Drives downstream scheduling, ticketing, and broadcast activation.']
  season_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the season phase: preseason (training/exhibition games), regular (standard competitive schedule), postseason (playoff/championship bracket), allstar (mid-season showcase event), or exhibition (non-competitive friendly). Drives scheduling, standings, and broadcast rights logic.']
  seeding_methodology varchar [note: 'Description of the method used to assign playoff seeding positions to qualifying franchises (e.g., \'Conference record then division winner priority\', \'Overall league record\', \'Win percentage with tiebreaker rules\'). Governs bracket position assignments and home-court/field advantage.']
  series_games_format varchar [note: 'The number of games in each playoff series (e.g., best_of_7 for NBA/NHL Finals, best_of_5 for early rounds, single_game for NFL playoff rounds). Drives game scheduling, broadcast rights windows, and venue booking.']
  shortened_season_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this season was shortened from the standard games_per_team count due to labor disputes, pandemic, or other force majeure events. When true, prorated salary cap and adjusted standings rules apply.']
  start_date date [note: 'Official first date of the season as declared by the league governing body. Anchors all scheduling, ticket on-sale windows, and broadcast rights activation.']
  theme varchar [note: 'Official marketing theme or campaign name for the season as defined by the league (e.g., \'NBA 75th Anniversary Season\', \'NFL 100\'). Used in fan engagement, merchandise, and content production campaigns.']
  trade_deadline_date date [note: 'The last date on which franchises may execute player trades during the regular season. After this date, rosters are locked for playoff eligibility. Critical for roster management, salary cap compliance, and fan engagement.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this season record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.']
  wada_compliance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this season is subject to WADA (World Anti-Doping Agency) anti-doping testing protocols and reporting requirements. When true, all PED (Performance Enhancing Drug) testing, suspension, and reporting obligations apply.']
  year varchar [note: 'The primary calendar year associated with the season (e.g., 2024). For multi-year seasons (e.g., NBA 2024-25), this represents the start year. Used as the anchor year for salary cap, CBA compliance, and draft calculations.']

  Note: 'Defines a competitive season calendar and postseason structure for a league. Captures season year, season type (regular, preseason, postseason), official start and end dates, number of scheduled games per team, salary cap year flag, CBA governing version, and season status (upcoming, active, completed). Includes playoff/postseason bracket definition: bracket format (single elimination, best-of-series), number of rounds, seeding methodology, bye rules, home-court/field advantage rules, bracket position assignments per franchise, advancement status, and series results through each round to championship. Anchors all scheduling, standings, draft, and compliance calculations.'
}

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regular_season|playoff|exhibition|neutral_site|all_star|championship|play_in|wild_card — promote to reference product]']
  gate_revenue_split_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'The contractually agreed percentage of gate revenue allocated to the visiting (away) franchise for this game, as defined in the league\'s revenue sharing agreement. Confidential financial term used by SAP S/4HANA (SD/FI modules) for revenue recognition and intercompany settlement.']
  international_broadcast_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this game has international broadcast rights activated beyond the domestic market. Triggers GDPR-compliant geo-restriction logic for OTT/DTC streaming platforms and international media rights window management in Dalet Galaxy.']
  is_home_away_reversed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the standard home/away designation has been reversed for this game (e.g., a team plays a \'home\' game at the opponent\'s venue due to facility unavailability or international series). Used for scheduling balance audits and CBA home game count compliance.']
  is_neutral_site boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the game is played at a neutral venue not affiliated with either franchise (e.g., Super Bowl, NBA Finals, FIFA World Cup Final, international series games). Affects home/away revenue allocation, venue selection logic, and scheduling balance calculations.']
  matchday_label varchar [note: 'Human-readable label for the scheduling period as published by the league (e.g., \'Matchday 12\', \'Week 7\', \'Round of 16\', \'Wild Card Weekend\', \'Opening Day\'). Used in fan-facing communications, broadcast graphics, and digital content distribution.']
  original_scheduled_date date [note: 'The initially published league calendar date for this game before any postponement or rescheduling. Retained for audit trail, rescheduling impact analysis, and CBA transaction window compliance verification. Null if the game has never been rescheduled.']

  postponement_reason varchar [note: 'Categorized reason for a game postponement or cancellation. Required for league governance reporting, insurance claims, broadcast rights force majeure provisions, and ISO 20121 event sustainability documentation. Null when scheduling_status is \'confirmed\'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weather|facility_issue|public_safety|broadcast_conflict|force_majeure|covid_protocol|labor_dispute|bereavement|other — promote to reference product]']
  ppv_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this game is designated as a Pay-Per-View (PPV) broadcast event, requiring separate consumer purchase beyond standard subscription. Affects OTT/DTC revenue recognition, broadcast rights activation, and FCC PPV reporting requirements.']

  round_number varchar [note: 'The round or matchday number within the season or tournament phase (e.g., FIFA Matchday 12, MLB Series Game 3, NBA Playoff Round 2). Used for bracket progression, standings, and competition governance. Null for week-based league formats.']
  salary_cap_window_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this game date falls within a salary cap compliance reporting window as defined by the applicable CBA. Used by league finance and compliance teams to trigger cap audit checkpoints aligned to the competitive calendar.']
  scheduled_date date [note: 'The official league-published calendar date on which the game is scheduled to be played (yyyy-MM-dd). Used as the primary planning date for event operations, venue staffing, and broadcast scheduling. Represents the current confirmed date (may differ from original_scheduled_date if rescheduled).']
  scheduled_start_time timestamp [note: 'The precise date and timestamp (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX) at which the game is scheduled to begin, including timezone offset. Used for broadcast slot coordination, gate opening logistics, and fan notification via Adobe Experience Platform.']
  scheduling_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the scheduled game. Drives downstream event operations, broadcast slot management, ticketing refund workflows (Ticketmaster/AXS), and standings calculation eligibility. Confirmed = league-approved and published; Postponed = delayed with new date TBD; Cancelled = permanently removed; Rescheduled = new date assigned; Pending = awaiting league confirmation; Suspended = mid-game stoppage requiring resumption.']
  season_phase varchar [note: 'The phase of the competitive season in which this game falls. Drives CBA transaction window rules (e.g., trade deadlines, roster eligibility), salary cap compliance windows, and broadcast rights tier activation.']
  series_game_number varchar [note: 'The sequential game number within a playoff or regular-season series between the same two franchises (e.g., Game 3 of 7 in an NBA Playoff series, Game 2 of 3 in an MLB series). Null for non-series single-game matchups.']
  series_game_total varchar [note: 'The maximum number of games in the series to which this game belongs (e.g., best-of-7 = 7, best-of-5 = 5, two-game series = 2). Used alongside series_game_number for bracket progression logic and playoff scheduling management.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the operational system of record from which this schedule record originated (e.g., TICKETMASTER, AXS, SAP_SD, ARCHTICS, LEAGUE_API). Required for data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer and cross-system reconciliation.']
  ticket_on_sale_date date [note: 'The date on which tickets for this game become available for public purchase via Ticketmaster/AXS and DTC (Direct-To-Consumer) channels. Drives fan engagement campaign scheduling in Adobe Experience Platform and Salesforce CRM outreach workflows.']
  timezone varchar [note: 'IANA timezone identifier for the venue location where the game is played (e.g., \'America/New_York\', \'Europe/London\', \'Asia/Tokyo\'). Required for accurate broadcast scheduling, fan notification timing, and international rights window management.']
  transaction_window_compliant boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this game falls within a CBA-defined transaction window (e.g., trade deadline, waiver period, roster freeze). Critical for league compliance officers to validate that no prohibited roster moves occurred in the window surrounding this game.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and timestamp when this schedule record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver layer, downstream broadcast and ticketing system synchronization, and audit trail compliance.']
  var_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Video Assistant Referee (VAR) or equivalent video review technology (e.g., TMO in rugby, instant replay in NFL/NBA/MLB) is activated for this game. Drives broadcast production requirements (OB truck setup) and officiating crew composition.']
  weather_condition varchar [note: 'Categorized weather condition at game time for outdoor or open-air venues. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|cloudy|rain|snow|fog|extreme_heat|wind_advisory|indoor — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']

Used for standings calculations, bye week tracking, and scheduling balance analysis. Applicable primarily to weekly-format leagues (NFL, NHL, NBA). Null for round-based or matchday-based competitions.']

  Note: 'Official league-published game schedule record linking two franchises to a specific date, time, venue, and season week/round/matchday. Table league.standing {
  standing_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for a competitive standing snapshot record within the league data domain.']
  conference_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the conference (e.g., AFC, NFC, Eastern, Western) within which the franchise competes for this standing snapshot.']
  division_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the division within which the franchise competes and is ranked for this standing snapshot.']
  franchise_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the team franchise whose competitive standing is captured in this record.']
  league_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the professional league (e.g., NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA) under whose governance this standing is recorded.']
  playoff_bracket_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to league.playoff_bracket. Business justification: Standings determine playoff seeding and bracket placement. Adding playoff_bracket_id to standing links a franchise\'s standing snapshot to the playoff bracket it feeds into, enabling seed-to-bracket ma']
  season_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the competitive season (e.g., 2024-25 NBA season) for which this standing snapshot applies.']
  away_losses varchar [note: 'Total number of losses recorded in away (road) games as of the snapshot date.']
  away_ties varchar [note: 'Total number of ties or draws recorded in away (road) games. Applicable in MLS, FIFA, and NFL regular season formats.']
  away_wins varchar [note: 'Total number of wins recorded in away (road) games as of the snapshot date. Used in tiebreaker resolution.']
  clinch_indicator varchar [note: 'Standard league clinch/elimination indicator code displayed in standings: x = clinched playoff berth, y = clinched division title, z = clinched best record in conference, e = eliminated from playoff contention, w = clinched best overall record, p = clinched home-field advantage. Null if no clinch or elimination status applies.']
  conference_losses varchar [note: 'Total number of losses recorded against conference opponents as of the snapshot date.']
  conference_rank varchar [note: 'Ordinal rank of the franchise within its conference as of the snapshot date. Used for playoff seeding and wild card qualification.']
  conference_wins varchar [note: 'Total number of wins recorded against conference opponents as of the snapshot date. Used as a tiebreaker criterion in NFL, NBA, and NHL standings.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this standing snapshot record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.']
  current_streak_count varchar [note: 'Number of consecutive games in the current streak of the same result type (wins, losses, or ties). Combined with current_streak_type to express the full streak.']
  current_streak_type varchar [note: 'Type of the franchise\'s current consecutive result streak: W (Win), L (Loss), T (Tie), or D (Draw). Combined with current_streak_count to express the full streak (e.g., W5 = five consecutive wins).']
  division_losses varchar [note: 'Total number of losses recorded against divisional opponents as of the snapshot date.']
  division_rank varchar [note: 'Ordinal rank of the franchise within its division as of the snapshot date. Rank 1 indicates the division leader. Used for playoff seeding and tiebreaker resolution.']
  division_wins varchar [note: 'Total number of wins recorded against divisional opponents as of the snapshot date. A primary tiebreaker criterion in NFL, NBA, MLB, and NHL standings.']
  elimination_number varchar [note: 'Combined number of losses by the trailing team and wins by the leading competitor that would result in mathematical elimination from playoff contention. Null when already eliminated or clinched.']
  games_behind decimal(5,1) [note: 'Number of games the franchise trails the division or conference leader in the standings. A value of 0.0 indicates the franchise is tied for or holds the lead. Calculated as ((leader_wins - team_wins) + (team_losses - leader_losses)) / 2.']
  games_played varchar [note: 'Total number of official regular season or applicable competition games played by the franchise as of the snapshot date.']
  home_losses varchar [note: 'Total number of losses recorded in home venue games as of the snapshot date.']
  home_ties varchar [note: 'Total number of ties or draws recorded in home venue games. Applicable in MLS, FIFA, and NFL regular season formats.']
  home_wins varchar [note: 'Total number of wins recorded in home venue games as of the snapshot date. Used in tiebreaker resolution and home-field advantage analysis.']
  last10_losses varchar [note: 'Number of losses in the franchise\'s most recent 10 official games. Combined with last10_wins to express the last-10 record (e.g., 7-3).']
  last10_wins varchar [note: 'Number of wins in the franchise\'s most recent 10 official games. Used as a recent form indicator in standings displays and playoff race analysis.']
  league_rank varchar [note: 'Ordinal rank of the franchise across the entire league as of the snapshot date. Used for draft order determination and overall competitive positioning.']
  losses varchar [note: 'Total number of official games lost by the franchise in regulation, overtime, or shootout as of the snapshot date.']
  magic_number varchar [note: 'Combined number of wins by the leading team and losses by the closest competitor needed to clinch a division title or playoff berth. Null when not applicable or when already clinched/eliminated.']
  overtime_losses varchar [note: 'Total number of games lost in overtime or shootout. Used primarily in NHL standings where an overtime loss earns one point. Null or zero for leagues without overtime loss distinction.']
  playoff_seed varchar [note: 'Projected or confirmed playoff seeding position for the franchise based on current standings. Determines bracket placement, home-field advantage, and first-round matchups. Null if the franchise is eliminated or the playoff field is not yet determined.']
  points varchar [note: 'Total standings points accumulated by the franchise. Used in NHL (2 pts per win, 1 pt per OTL), MLS, and FIFA competition formats. Null for leagues using winning percentage as the primary ranking metric.']
  run_differential varchar [note: 'Net difference between total runs/goals/points scored and total runs/goals/points allowed across all games. Positive values indicate the franchise scores more than it concedes. Used as a tiebreaker and competitive health indicator across MLB (runs), NHL/MLS/FIFA (goals), and NBA (points).']
  runs_allowed varchar [note: 'Total runs (MLB), goals (NHL/MLS/FIFA), or points (NBA/NFL) allowed by the franchise across all applicable games as of the snapshot date.']
  runs_scored varchar [note: 'Total runs (MLB), goals (NHL/MLS/FIFA), or points (NBA/NFL) scored by the franchise across all applicable games as of the snapshot date.']
  snapshot_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which this standings snapshot was captured, typically updated after each official game result is processed.']
  standing_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this standing record: active (season in progress), clinched (playoff berth secured), eliminated (mathematically eliminated from playoff contention), pending (awaiting game result), or final (season concluded).']
  standings_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the standings context: regular season, postseason, preseason, tournament group stage, or playoff bracket. Determines which game results are included in the standing calculation.']
  strength_of_schedule decimal(5,4) [note: 'Composite metric representing the combined winning percentage of all opponents faced by the franchise as of the snapshot date. Used as a tiebreaker criterion in NFL standings and for playoff seeding analysis.']
  ties varchar [note: 'Total number of official games ending in a tie or draw (applicable in MLS, FIFA, and NFL regular season). Null or zero for leagues that do not permit ties.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this standing snapshot record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated after each official game result is processed and standings are recalculated.']
  wild_card_rank varchar [note: 'Ordinal rank of the franchise among wild card contenders within its conference or league. Null if the franchise has clinched a division title or is eliminated from wild card contention.']
  win_pct decimal(5,4) [note: 'Winning percentage calculated as wins divided by games played (ties count as half a win in applicable leagues). Primary ranking metric in MLB and NBA standings.']
  wins varchar [note: 'Total number of official games won by the franchise in regulation, overtime, or shootout as of the snapshot date.']

  Note: 'Periodic snapshot of competitive standings for a franchise within a division, conference, and league for a given season. Tracks wins, losses, ties/draws, overtime losses, points (hockey/soccer), winning percentage, games behind leader, home/away/divisional/conference records, goal/run/point differential, current streak, last-10 record, strength of schedule, clinch/elimination status, and standings rank. Updated after each official game result. Drives playoff qualification logic and tiebreaker resolution.'
}

Table league.playoff_bracket {
  playoff_bracket_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the playoff bracket record. Primary key for the playoff_bracket data product in the league domain.']

  league_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the professional league (e.g., NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA) that owns and governs this playoff bracket.']
  media_rights_deal_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the broadcast and media rights package governing playoff coverage, including OTT, RSN, PPV, and DTC distribution rights for this bracket\'s games.']
  mvp_athlete_athlete_profile_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the athlete awarded the Most Valuable Player (MVP) honor for the playoff bracket/championship series. Populated upon bracket completion. Drives NIL, sponsorship, and award management processes.']
  primary_playoff_champion_franchise_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the franchise that won the championship in this playoff bracket. Populated only upon bracket completion. Used for historical records, trophy management, and league governance reporting.']
  season_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the league season for which this playoff bracket is defined. Links the bracket to the regular-season standings and schedule that determine seeding.']
  ada_compliance_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether all venues hosting games in this playoff bracket must meet ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) accessibility standards. Mandatory for all US-based professional league events.']
  bracket_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this playoff bracket within the league and season (e.g., \'NFL-2024-PLAYOFFS\', \'NBA-2024-EAST\'). Used in broadcast, ticketing, and fan-facing systems.']
  bracket_end_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the final championship game is scheduled or was completed. Used for season close-out, financial reporting, and broadcast rights expiry.']
  bracket_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the playoff bracket (e.g., \'NFL 2024 AFC Playoffs\', \'NBA 2024 Eastern Conference Bracket\'). Used in fan-facing platforms, broadcast graphics, and reporting.']
  bracket_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for league administrators to record special circumstances, rule exceptions, force-majeure events, or governance decisions affecting this playoff bracket (e.g., COVID-19 bubble format, relocated games).']
  bracket_region varchar [note: 'Geographic or organizational region label for the bracket (e.g., \'AFC\', \'NFC\', \'Eastern Conference\', \'Western Conference\', \'Americas\', \'Europe\'). Used for multi-region league structures and broadcast rights segmentation.']
  bracket_start_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the first playoff game in this bracket is scheduled to be played. Used for scheduling, ticketing, and broadcast rights activation.']
  bracket_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the playoff bracket. \'draft\' indicates the bracket is being configured; \'published\' means seeding is finalized and publicly released; \'in_progress\' means competition is underway; \'completed\' means a champion has been crowned; \'cancelled\' covers force-majeure scenarios.']
  bracket_type varchar [note: 'Format of the playoff bracket structure governing how teams advance. Determines match scheduling logic and advancement rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single_elimination|double_elimination|best_of_series|round_robin|seeded_bracket — promote to reference product if additional formats are needed]']
  bye_rounds_count varchar [note: 'Number of first-round byes awarded to top-seeded teams. A value of 0 indicates no byes are granted. Bye rules are defined in the league\'s CBA and playoff format documentation.']
  championship_game_name varchar [note: 'Official branded name of the final championship game or series in this bracket (e.g., \'Super Bowl\', \'NBA Finals\', \'Stanley Cup Finals\', \'World Series\'). Used in broadcast, sponsorship, and fan engagement contexts.']
  conference_division_scope varchar [note: 'Organizational scope of the bracket indicating whether it covers the full league, a single conference, a division, or a wild-card pool. Drives seeding and matchup logic.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this playoff bracket record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.']
  current_round varchar [note: 'The round number currently in progress within the bracket (1 = first round, incrementing through to the championship). Null if the bracket has not yet started or has been completed.']
  disciplinary_review_body varchar [note: 'Name of the governing body or panel responsible for adjudicating disciplinary actions, appeals, and rule enforcement during this playoff bracket (e.g., \'NFL Commissioner\'s Office\', \'NBA Basketball Operations\', \'CAS\').']
  governing_body_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the sports governing body that oversees the rules and competitive integrity of this playoff bracket (e.g., NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA, IOC). Drives regulatory compliance and officiating standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NFL|NBA|MLB|NHL|MLS|FIFA|IOC|UFC|ATP — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  home_advantage_rule varchar [note: 'Rule governing which team hosts home games in a series. \'higher_seed\' awards home games to the better-seeded team; \'predetermined\' uses a fixed schedule; \'neutral_site\' applies to championship games; \'alternating\' rotates home games.']
  iso_20121_certified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the playoff bracket events are managed under ISO 20121 Event Sustainability Management System certification, reflecting the league\'s commitment to sustainable event operations.']
  neutral_site_final boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the championship game/series final is played at a pre-selected neutral venue rather than the higher seed\'s home venue. True for events like the Super Bowl, FIFA World Cup Final, and NBA All-Star Game.']
  ppv_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether any games in this playoff bracket are distributed under a Pay-Per-View (PPV) model. Drives revenue recognition, fan access controls, and broadcast rights activation.']
  published_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the playoff bracket seeding and structure were officially published and made available to teams, media, and fans. Represents the principal real-world business event timestamp for this entity.']
  reseeding_rule varchar [note: 'Defines whether teams are reseeded after each round based on remaining seeds or whether the bracket is fixed at the start. \'fixed_bracket\' locks matchups at bracket publication; \'reseed_each_round\' re-ranks remaining teams each round.']
  salary_cap_compliance_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether participating franchises must be in salary cap compliance at the time of bracket entry. True if the league enforces cap compliance as a condition of playoff eligibility, per CBA terms.']
  season_year varchar [note: 'The calendar year (or starting year for cross-year seasons) of the league season associated with this playoff bracket (e.g., 2024 for the 2024-25 NBA season). Used for partitioning, reporting, and historical analysis.']
  seeding_methodology varchar [note: 'The rule set used to assign seed positions to franchises entering the bracket (e.g., win-loss record, points percentage, division winner priority). Governs competitive integrity and is defined in the CBA and league rulebook.']
  series_games_per_round varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of maximum games per series for each round in order (e.g., \'7,7,7,7\' for NBA best-of-7 throughout, or \'1,1,1,1\' for NFL single-elimination). Null for single-elimination formats where each round is one game.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the operational system of record from which this playoff bracket record originated or is mastered (e.g., SAP S/4HANA league operations module, Salesforce CRM, or manual league office entry).']
  ticket_sales_open_date date [note: 'Date on which general public ticket sales for playoff games in this bracket open. Used by Ticketmaster/AXS and Archtics for inventory release and revenue management.']
  tiebreaker_rule varchar [note: 'Description of the tiebreaker criteria applied when two or more teams have identical records for seeding purposes (e.g., head-to-head record, division record, strength of schedule, point differential). Defined in the league rulebook and CBA.']
  total_rounds varchar [note: 'Total number of competitive rounds in the bracket from first round through championship (e.g., 4 for NFL: Wild Card, Divisional, Conference Championship, Super Bowl).']
  total_teams varchar [note: 'Total number of franchises/teams that qualify and enter the playoff bracket. Determines bracket size and bye-round eligibility.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this playoff bracket record. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and downstream ETL incremental loads.']
  var_tmo_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Video Assistant Referee (VAR) or Television Match Official (TMO) technology is mandated for officiating decisions in all games within this playoff bracket. Relevant for FIFA, MLS, and rugby-governed competitions.']
  wada_compliance_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether WADA anti-doping protocols and PED (Performance Enhancing Drug) testing are mandated for all athletes competing in this playoff bracket. Relevant for international and Olympic-affiliated competitions.']

  Note: 'Defines the postseason bracket structure for a league season, including bracket format (single elimination, best-of-series), number of rounds, seeding methodology, bye rules, home-court/field advantage rules, and bracket position assignments per franchise. Tracks advancement status and series results through each round to championship.'
}

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NFL|NBA|MLB|NHL|MLS|FIFA|IOC|UFC|ATP — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  official_attendance varchar [note: 'Officially certified number of spectators in attendance at the venue as reported to the league office. Used for franchise reporting, venue capacity compliance, and fan engagement analytics.']
  overtime_periods_played varchar [note: 'Number of overtime or extra-time periods played beyond regulation. Zero if the game was decided in regulation. Used for game duration analytics and broadcast scheduling.']
  protest_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a formal protest has been filed against this game result by either participating franchise (True) or not (False). Triggers league disciplinary and review workflows.']

  result_type varchar [note: 'Classification of how the game result was determined. \'regulation\' indicates decided within standard playing time. \'overtime\' indicates decided in extra time/OT periods. \'shootout\' indicates decided by penalty shootout or shootout format (NHL/MLS/FIFA). \'forfeit\' indicates awarded due to a team\'s failure to compete. \'no_contest\' indicates the game was declared void without a winner.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the operational system of record from which this game result was ingested (e.g., SportsCode/Hudl performance analytics platform, manual league entry, or third-party stats provider). Supports data lineage and audit traceability.']
  temperature_celsius decimal(5,2) [note: 'Ambient temperature in degrees Celsius recorded at the venue at game time. Applicable to outdoor venues. Used for performance analytics, player safety reporting, and broadcast metadata.']
  tmo_intervention_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a Television Match Official (TMO) review was invoked during the game (True) or not (False). Applicable to rugby and other sports using TMO protocols. Supports officiating quality review.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when this game result record was last modified. Tracks result amendments, certification updates, and protest resolutions for audit compliance.']
  var_intervention_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a Video Assistant Referee (VAR) intervention occurred during the game (True) or not (False). Applicable to sports using VAR technology such as FIFA, MLS, and NFL replay review. Supports officiating quality review and competitive integrity reporting.']
  venue_capacity varchar [note: 'Total certified seating and standing capacity of the venue at the time of the game. Used to calculate attendance utilization rate and for regulatory compliance reporting.']
  weather_condition varchar [note: 'Prevailing weather condition at the venue during the game. Applicable to outdoor venues only; \'dome\' or \'indoor\' used for enclosed facilities. Impacts game analytics, broadcast commentary, and insurance claims. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|cloudy|rain|snow|fog|wind|dome|indoor — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  wind_speed_kmh decimal(5,2) [note: 'Wind speed in kilometres per hour recorded at the venue at game time. Applicable to outdoor venues. Used for performance analytics and broadcast metadata.']

  Note: 'Official final result record for a completed scheduled game. Captures final score by team, overtime periods played, winning/losing franchise, result type (regulation, OT, SO, forfeit), official attendance, weather conditions (outdoor venues), VAR/TMO intervention flag, protest flag, and result certification status. SSOT for official game outcomes used in standings calculations.'
}

  officiating_body varchar [note: 'Name of the governing officiating bureau or association that certifies and employs this official (e.g., NFL Officiating Bureau, NBA Referee Operations, FIFA Referee Department, NHL Officiating, MLB Umpire Development). Determines the certification framework and disciplinary jurisdiction.']
  performance_rating decimal(4,2) [note: 'Most recent composite performance rating assigned by the officiating bureau\'s evaluators, typically on a 0–10 or 0–100 scale depending on the governing body. Drives assignment priority, certification tier reviews, and playoff eligibility determinations.']
  performance_rating_season varchar [note: 'The league season identifier (e.g., \'2024-25\') for which the current performance rating applies. Ensures ratings are interpreted in the correct seasonal context for year-over-year trend analysis.']

  compliance_status varchar [note: 'Current compliance state of the franchise against the applicable salary cap rules for the cap year.   created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this salary cap record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary cap amounts are denominated (e.g., USD for US Dollar, CAD for Canadian Dollar for NHL franchises).']
  dead_cap_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total cap charges attributed to players no longer on the active roster (released, traded, or retired) whose guaranteed money or signing bonus proration still counts against the franchise\'s cap. Expressed in USD.']
  draft_pick_penalty_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the franchise has been assessed a draft pick forfeiture as a penalty for a salary cap violation in this cap year.']
  escrow_percentage decimal(5,4) [note: 'The percentage of player salaries withheld in escrow during the season to ensure the players\' share of revenue does not exceed the CBA-defined threshold. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1000 = 10%). Reconciled at season end.']
  first_apron_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The first apron threshold above the luxury tax line, above which franchises face initial CBA restrictions on roster moves (e.g., reduced MLE, no sign-and-trade as acquiring team). Expressed in USD.']
  franchise_tag_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The one-year tender value applied when a franchise designates a player with the franchise tag, preventing free agency. Calculated as the average of the top-N salaries at the player\'s position or a percentage of the cap, per CBA rules. Expressed in USD.']
  hard_cap_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The absolute maximum total player payroll permitted under the league\'s hard cap rule for the cap year. Franchises may not exceed this amount under any circumstance. Expressed in USD.']
  injured_reserve_credit decimal(18,2) [note: 'Cap relief credit granted to a franchise when a player is placed on the injured reserve list, allowing a replacement signing above the normal cap threshold. Expressed in USD. Governed by CBA injured reserve rules.']
  last_transaction_date date [note: 'The date of the most recent roster transaction (signing, release, trade, IR placement) that triggered an update to this franchise\'s cap compliance snapshot.']
  luxury_tax_liability decimal(18,2) [note: 'The calculated luxury tax dollar amount owed by the franchise based on the amount by which total payroll exceeds the luxury tax threshold, multiplied by the applicable CBA tax rate. Expressed in USD. Zero if payroll is below threshold.']
  luxury_tax_repeater_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the franchise qualifies as a luxury tax repeater under CBA rules, triggering higher incremental tax rates for franchises that have been taxpayers in multiple seasons within a defined lookback window.']
  luxury_tax_threshold decimal(18,2) [note: 'The payroll level above which a franchise incurs luxury tax penalties. Franchises exceeding this threshold pay a tax rate per dollar over the threshold as defined in the CBA. Expressed in USD.']
  mid_level_exception_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The dollar value of the mid-level exception available to franchises for the cap year, allowing teams over the soft cap to sign players up to this amount. Expressed in USD. Applicable in NBA-style soft cap leagues.']
  penalty_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The financial penalty assessed against the franchise for a salary cap violation, as determined by the league office. Expressed in USD. Zero if no violation exists.']
  player_share_percentage decimal(5,4) [note: 'The CBA-defined percentage of total league revenue allocated to player salaries and benefits for the cap year. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5100 = 51%). Drives cap calculation methodology.']
  practice_squad_charges decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total salary cap charges attributable to players on the practice squad roster for the cap year. Expressed in USD. Governed by CBA practice squad rules.']
  record_type varchar [note: 'Discriminator indicating whether this record is a league-wide cap rule definition or a per-franchise compliance snapshot. Drives downstream processing logic.']
  snapshot_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The exact date and time at which the franchise-level compliance snapshot was captured. Enables point-in-time cap analysis and audit trail for roster transactions.']
  soft_cap_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The baseline salary cap ceiling above which teams may still sign players using defined CBA exceptions (e.g., mid-level exception, Bird rights). Expressed in USD. Applicable primarily in NBA-style cap structures.']
  total_league_revenue_basis decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total league-wide revenue figure used as the basis for calculating the salary cap for the cap year, as defined in the CBA. Typically derived from broadcast rights, gate receipts, and other shared revenue streams. Expressed in USD.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this salary cap record was last modified. Updated on every roster transaction, contract signing, or league adjustment that affects cap figures.']
  violation_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the nature of any salary cap violation identified for this franchise in the cap year. Populated only when compliance_status is \'violation\' or \'under_review\'.']

  Note: 'Annual salary cap definition and franchise compliance tracking per league and season. Defines hard cap, soft cap, luxury tax threshold, cap floor, and applicable exceptions (mid-level, bi-annual, franchise tag). Tracks cap year, total league revenue basis, escrow percentage, cap calculation methodology, and official announcement date. Also captures per-franchise compliance snapshots: total active payroll, cap space remaining, dead cap, injured reserve credits, practice squad charges, cap holds, luxury tax liability, and compliance status (compliant, warning, violation). Updated on roster transactions and contract signings. SSOT for salary cap rules AND franchise-level cap compliance.'
}

Table league.cap_compliance {
  cap_compliance_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each salary cap compliance snapshot record. Primary key for the cap_compliance data product in the league domain.']
  cba_agreement_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to league.cba_agreement. Business justification: cap_compliance tracks a franchise\'s compliance position against CBA-defined rules (luxury tax thresholds, cap exceptions, cap types). Adding cba_agreement_id directly links each compliance snapshot to']
  franchise_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the team franchise whose salary cap compliance position is being tracked. Links to the franchise master record in the league domain.']
  league_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the professional sports league (e.g., NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS) governing the salary cap rules applicable to this compliance record.']
  salary_cap_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to league.salary_cap. Business justification: cap_compliance snapshots a franchise\'s compliance position against the governing salary cap definition. Adding salary_cap_id links each compliance record to the specific salary_cap rule set it is meas']
  season_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the league season for which this cap compliance record applies. Salary cap rules and limits are defined per season.']
  active_payroll_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total salary cap charges attributable to players on the active roster at the time of this snapshot. Represents the primary component of the franchise\'s cap utilization, sourced from contract records in SAP S/4HANA SD/FI modules.']
  audit_date date [note: 'Date on which the cap compliance record was formally audited by the league office or designated compliance authority. Distinct from the snapshot date and submission date.']
  audited_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the league official, compliance officer, or external auditor who reviewed and validated this cap compliance record. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX and CBA governance.']
  cap_exception_amount_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Dollar value of the salary cap exception being utilized by the franchise. Represents the maximum contract value that can be offered under the active exception type. Zero if no exception is in use.']
  cap_exception_type varchar [note: 'Type of salary cap exception being utilized by the franchise in this snapshot period. Exceptions allow teams to exceed the soft cap under specific CBA-defined conditions (e.g., NBA Mid-Level Exception, Bi-Annual Exception, Disabled Player Exception). \'none\' if no exception is active.']
  cap_hold_amount_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total cap holds applied to the franchise for unsigned draft picks, restricted free agents, and franchise-tagged players whose contracts have not yet been finalized. Cap holds reserve cap space until contracts are executed or players are released.']
  cap_penalty_amount_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total cap penalties assessed against the franchise by the league for CBA violations, tampering, or other disciplinary actions that result in cap charges. Distinct from dead cap and luxury tax.']
  cap_rollover_amount_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Unused cap space from the prior season that has been rolled over and added to the current season\'s cap limit, where permitted by the applicable CBA. Increases the effective cap ceiling for the franchise.']
  cap_space_remaining_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'The amount of salary cap space available to the franchise at the time of this snapshot, calculated as the season cap limit minus all cap charges (active payroll, dead cap, cap holds, IR credits, practice squad charges). A negative value indicates a cap violation.']
  cap_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the salary cap structure applicable to this franchise and league. \'hard_cap\' enforces an absolute ceiling; \'soft_cap\' allows exceptions; \'salary_floor\' enforces a minimum spend; \'tax_apron\' is a secondary hard limit above the luxury tax threshold (e.g., NBA second apron).']
  compliance_record_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for this cap compliance snapshot, formatted as CAP-{LEAGUE}-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}. Used in league submissions, audit trails, and CBA compliance reporting.']
  compliance_status varchar [note: 'Current compliance state of the franchise relative to the salary cap. \'compliant\' indicates the franchise is within all cap limits; \'warning\' indicates approaching a threshold; \'violation\' indicates a breach requiring league action; \'under_review\' indicates a pending league audit; \'exempt\' indicates a league-approved exception applies.']
  consecutive_tax_years varchar [note: 'Number of consecutive seasons the franchise has been a luxury tax payer. Used to determine escalating repeat-offender luxury tax rates under the NBA CBA, where franchises paying tax in multiple consecutive years face higher tax rates.']
  corrective_action_deadline date [note: 'The date by which the franchise must resolve a cap compliance violation or warning. Set by the league office upon identification of a violation. Null if no corrective action is required.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this cap compliance record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.']
  dead_cap_amount_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total salary cap charges attributable to players no longer on the roster (released, traded, or retired) whose guaranteed money or signing bonus prorations still count against the cap. Dead cap reduces available cap space without active roster benefit.']
  franchise_tag_charge_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total salary cap charges attributable to players designated with a franchise tag. Franchise tag values are set by the league based on position averages and count against the cap until a long-term contract is signed.']
  injured_reserve_credit_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total salary cap credits granted to the franchise for players placed on the Injured Reserve (IR) list. IR credits reduce the effective cap charge for injured players per league rules, providing partial cap relief.']
  is_luxury_tax_payer boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the franchise\'s total payroll exceeds the luxury tax threshold, making them a luxury tax payer for the current season. Drives luxury tax liability calculations and repeat-offender tax rate escalations.']
  is_over_cap boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the franchise\'s total cap charges exceed the season cap limit at the time of this snapshot. True signals a cap violation requiring immediate league review and potential corrective action.']
  league_submission_date date [note: 'Date on which this cap compliance record was formally submitted to the league office for review and approval. Required for CBA compliance audit trails.']
  league_submission_status varchar [note: 'Status of this cap compliance record\'s submission to the league office. \'pending\' means not yet submitted; \'submitted\' means sent to the league; \'acknowledged\' means receipt confirmed; \'approved\' means league has validated compliance; \'disputed\' means the league has raised a question or objection.']
  luxury_tax_liability_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'The dollar amount of luxury tax owed by the franchise if total payroll exceeds the luxury tax threshold defined in the CBA. Applicable in leagues with soft cap structures (e.g., NBA). Zero if the franchise is below the luxury tax line or if the league uses a hard cap.']
  luxury_tax_threshold_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'The payroll level above which the franchise incurs luxury tax penalties for the current season, as defined by the applicable CBA. Distinct from the hard cap limit; used to calculate luxury tax liability.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional context, league correspondence references, or compliance officer annotations related to this cap compliance snapshot. Used for exception documentation and league communication tracking.']
  performance_incentive_charge_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total likely and unlikely performance incentive amounts counting against the cap in the current season. Likely incentives (LTBE) count in the current year; unlikely incentives (NLTBE) may roll to the following year per CBA rules.']
  practice_squad_charge_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total salary cap charges attributable to players on the practice squad roster. Practice squad salaries count against the cap at league-mandated minimum rates per the applicable CBA.']
  roster_count_active varchar [note: 'Number of players on the active roster at the time of this cap compliance snapshot. Used to validate roster size compliance against league-mandated minimum and maximum roster limits.']
  roster_count_ir varchar [note: 'Number of players designated on the Injured Reserve (IR) list at the time of this snapshot. Drives IR cap credit calculations and roster exception eligibility.']
  roster_count_practice_squad varchar [note: 'Number of players on the practice squad at the time of this snapshot. Used to validate practice squad size compliance and calculate practice squad cap charges.']
  season_cap_limit_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total salary cap ceiling (in USD) allocated to the franchise for the current season as defined by the applicable CBA. This is the hard or soft cap maximum against which all payroll charges are measured.']
  signing_bonus_proration_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total prorated signing bonus amounts counting against the cap in the current season. Signing bonuses are spread over the life of the contract (up to 5 years per CBA rules), and the annual proration is a distinct cap charge component.']
  snapshot_date date [note: 'Calendar date of the cap compliance snapshot. Used for day-level reporting, standings, and league-submitted compliance filings distinct from the precise timestamp.']
  snapshot_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time at which this cap compliance position was captured. Compliance positions are updated on roster transactions and contract signings, making the snapshot time critical for point-in-time reporting.']
  source_system_reference varchar [note: 'The originating system transaction or document reference number from which this cap compliance record was derived (e.g., SAP S/4HANA contract document number or Workday Adaptive Planning budget reference). Enables traceability back to the system of record.']
  trigger_event_type varchar [note: 'The type of business event that triggered this cap compliance snapshot update. Captures whether the record was generated by a contract signing, roster move, trade, waiver claim, injury designation, practice squad change, or a scheduled cap adjustment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: contract_signing|roster_transaction|trade|waiver|injury_designation|practice_squad_change|cap_adjustment|season_open|season_close — promote to reference product]']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this cap compliance record was last modified in the data platform. Updated on every roster transaction, contract signing, or league adjustment that changes the franchise\'s cap position.']
  violation_description varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the nature of any cap compliance violation identified in this snapshot. Populated only when compliance_status is \'violation\' or \'under_review\'. Documents the specific CBA rule breached and the circumstances.']

  Note: 'Transactional record tracking a franchise\'s salary cap compliance position at a point in time within a season. Captures total active payroll, cap space remaining, dead cap amount, injured reserve credits, practice squad charges, cap holds, luxury tax liability, and compliance status (compliant, warning, violation). Updated on roster transactions and contract signings.'
}

Adding cba_agreement_id formalizes whi']

Draft event budget vs. actuals reporting and opex allocati']

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lottery|inverse_standings|coin_flip|predetermined|compensatory — promote to reference product]']
  ott_streaming_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the draft event is available for live streaming via OTT/DTC digital platforms in addition to or instead of traditional broadcast, supporting digital fan engagement.']
