  jurisdiction varchar [note: 'The primary jurisdiction (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code) in which the violation occurred or the sanction is enforceable. Relevant for cross-border enforcement and mutual recognition obligations.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp at which this sanction record was most recently modified in the compliance system. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking for regulatory reporting.']
  league_or_competition varchar [note: 'The specific league, competition, or tournament context in which the violation occurred or to which the sanction applies (e.g., NFL Regular Season, UEFA Champions League, NBA Season 2024-25).']
  mitigating_factors varchar [note: 'Documented mitigating circumstances considered by the adjudicating authority in determining the sanction, such as no significant fault or negligence, substantial assistance, or prompt admission. May result in a reduced sanction period.']
  notification_date date [note: 'The date on which the sanctioned entity was formally notified of the charge, adverse finding, or enforcement action by the issuing authority. Triggers the provisional suspension window and appeal deadlines.']
  points_deduction varchar [note: 'The number of competition points deducted from the sanctioned team or entity as part of the enforcement action. Null if the sanction type does not include a points deduction.']
  prohibited_substance varchar [note: 'The name of the prohibited substance or method identified in an Anti-Doping Rule Violation (ADRV). Null for non-doping sanctions. Aligns with the WADA Prohibited List classification.']
  prohibited_substance_category varchar [note: 'The WADA Prohibited List category of the substance or method involved in an Anti-Doping Rule Violation (ADRV). Examples: S0 (Non-Approved Substances), S1 (Anabolic Agents), S2 (Peptide Hormones), S3 (Beta-2 Agonists), S4 (Hormone Modulators), S5 (Diuretics). Null for non-doping sanctions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: S0|S1|S2|S3|S4|S5|S6|S7|S8|S9|M1|M2|M3|P1 — promote to reference product]']
  provisional_suspension_date date [note: 'The date on which a provisional suspension was imposed on the sanctioned entity pending the outcome of the formal hearing or investigation. Null if no provisional suspension was applied.']
  public_disclosure_date date [note: 'The date on which the sanction was publicly disclosed or published by the issuing governing body. Null if the sanction has not yet been publicly disclosed or is subject to confidentiality restrictions.']
  reference_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known unique reference number or case number assigned to this sanction by the issuing governing body or internal compliance authority (e.g., WADA case number, league disciplinary case ID).']
  regulatory_basis varchar [note: 'The specific rule, article, code, or regulation under which the sanction is issued (e.g., \'WADA Code Article 2.1\', \'FIFA Disciplinary Code Article 12\', \'NFL Personal Conduct Policy Section 3\'). Provides the legal foundation for the enforcement action.']
  reinstatement_eligibility_date date [note: 'The earliest date on which the sanctioned entity may apply for or be granted reinstatement to full participation rights. May differ from sanction_end_date if reinstatement conditions (e.g., education programs, return-to-competition testing) must be satisfied.']
  sanction_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the enforcement action imposed. Covers the full spectrum of disciplinary measures including suspensions, fines, points deductions, disqualifications, warnings, and license revocations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: suspension|fine|points_deduction|disqualification|warning|license_revocation|reprimand|ban|probation|forfeiture — promote to reference product]']
  sanctioned_entity_name varchar [note: 'The full legal name or registered name of the sanctioned party (athlete, official, team, or organization) at the time the sanction was issued. Retained for historical accuracy independent of master record changes.']
  sanctioned_entity_reference varchar [note: 'Identifier of the primary entity subject to the sanction. May reference an athlete, official, team, or the organization depending on sanctioned_entity_type.']
  sanctioned_entity_type varchar [note: 'Categorizes the type of party subject to the sanction, enabling polymorphic resolution of the sanctioned_entity_id reference.']
  sport_discipline varchar [note: 'The sport or competitive discipline in which the sanctioned entity participates and to which this sanction applies (e.g., Football, Basketball, Athletics, Tennis, Mixed Martial Arts). Enables cross-sport compliance reporting.']
  start_date date [note: 'The date on which the sanction period formally commences. For suspensions, this is the first day the sanctioned entity is ineligible to participate. May be backdated to the provisional suspension date per governing body rules.']
  violation_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative description of the specific violation, circumstances, and factual basis for the sanction as documented by the issuing authority. Provides the qualitative context required for legal, compliance, and audit purposes.']
  violation_type varchar [note: 'The specific category of rule violation that gave rise to this sanction. Examples include Anti-Doping Rule Violation (ADRV) — adverse analytical finding, atypical finding, whereabouts failure, tampering, possession, trafficking, administration; or non-doping violations such as match-fixing, misconduct, financial fair play breach, or data privacy violation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: adrv_adverse_analytical_finding|adrv_atypical_finding|adrv_whereabouts_failure|adrv_tampering|adrv_possession|adrv_trafficking|adrv_administration|match_fixing|misconduct|financial_fair_play|data_privacy|other — promote to reference product]']

  Note: 'Unified enforcement action and disciplinary sanction record issued by governing bodies or internal compliance authorities against athletes, officials, teams, or the organization. Covers all sanction types including Anti-Doping Rule Violations (ADRVs from adverse/atypical findings and non-analytical violations such as whereabouts failures and tampering), suspensions, fines, points deductions, disqualifications, license revocations, and warnings. Captures sanction type, sanctioned entity, issuing authority, regulatory basis, violation type and details, linked doping test or investigation, notification and provisional suspension dates, hearing date, sanction period, fine amount, WADA ADAMS reference, appeal status and window, CAS arbitration reference, reinstatement eligibility date, and enforcement status. Single Source of Truth for all penalties, violations, and enforcement actions across all governing bodies.'
}

  data_retention_period varchar [note: 'Defined retention period for personal data processed under this activity, e.g., \'2 years post-event\', \'7 years for financial records\'. Must be justified as part of necessity and proportionality assessment under GDPR Article 5(1)(e).']

  data_volume_estimate varchar [note: 'Estimated number of data subjects or records affected by the processing activity, e.g., \'50,000 fans per event\', \'500 athletes globally\'. Large-scale processing is a key trigger for mandatory DPIA under GDPR Article 35(3)(b).']
  dpo_advice varchar [note: 'Summary of the DPO\'s formal advice and recommendations provided during consultation, including any conditions or additional safeguards recommended. Must be documented per GDPR Article 35(2).']
  dpo_consultation_date date [note: 'Date on which the Data Protection Officer (DPO) was formally consulted regarding this assessment. Required to be documented under GDPR Article 35(2) when DPO consultation is mandatory.']
  dpo_consultation_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether formal consultation with the Data Protection Officer (DPO) is required for this assessment based on risk level and processing nature. Mandatory for high-risk processing under GDPR Article 35(2).']
  identified_risks varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the specific privacy and data protection risks identified during the assessment, including risks of unauthorized access, data breach, re-identification, discriminatory profiling, and rights violations for data subjects.']
  involves_cross_border_transfer boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the processing activity involves transfer of personal data to third countries outside the EEA. Triggers Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA) requirements under GDPR Chapter V.']
  involves_minors boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the processing activity involves personal data of minors (under 16 in EU, under 13 under COPPA). Triggers additional safeguards and parental consent requirements.']
  involves_special_category_data boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the processing activity involves special category personal data as defined under GDPR Article 9, including biometric data, health data, or genetic data. Triggers mandatory DPIA requirement.']
  jurisdiction varchar [note: 'Primary legal jurisdiction(s) under which the assessment is conducted, e.g., EU (GDPR), USA-CA (CCPA), GBR (UK GDPR). Determines applicable regulatory framework and supervisory authority.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to the PIA/DPIA assessment record. Supports audit trail requirements and tracks assessment lifecycle changes including DPO advice updates and outcome revisions.']
  lawful_basis varchar [note: 'The GDPR Article 6 lawful basis under which the processing activity is conducted. For special category data (e.g., athlete health, biometrics), an Article 9 condition must also be documented in the assessment narrative.']
  mitigation_measures varchar [note: 'Description of technical and organizational measures proposed or implemented to address identified risks, such as pseudonymization, encryption, access controls, data minimization, consent management, and DRM policies. Required under GDPR Article 35(7)(d).']
  necessity_proportionality_assessment varchar [note: 'Documented evaluation of whether the processing is necessary and proportionate to the stated purpose, as required by GDPR Article 35(7)(b). Includes data minimization analysis and retention justification.']
  next_review_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next periodic review of the PIA/DPIA assessment. GDPR requires reassessment when processing changes materially or at regular intervals. Typically annual for high-risk processing.']
  outcome_conditions varchar [note: 'Specific conditions, restrictions, or additional safeguards that must be implemented before or during processing when the assessment outcome is \'approved_with_conditions\'. Includes implementation deadlines.']
  processing_activity_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative of the data processing activity under assessment, including the nature, scope, context, and purposes of the processing as required by GDPR Article 35(7)(a).']
  processing_activity_name varchar [note: 'Name of the data processing activity being assessed, such as \'Biometric Ticketing System\', \'Fan Engagement Personalization Platform\', or \'Athlete Health Data Analytics\'. Corresponds to the Record of Processing Activities (RoPA) entry.']
  processing_commenced_date date [note: 'Actual date on which the assessed processing activity commenced operations. Must be on or after the approval date for mandatory DPIAs. Used for compliance audit trail and regulatory reporting.']
  processing_purpose varchar [note: 'The stated business purpose for which personal data is being processed, e.g., fan engagement analytics, athlete health monitoring, biometric access control, or broadcast audience profiling. Required under GDPR Article 35(7)(a).']
  regulatory_framework varchar [note: 'Primary data protection regulatory framework governing this assessment. Determines specific procedural requirements, mandatory consultation thresholds, and documentation obligations.']
  residual_risk_level varchar [note: 'Residual risk classification after all identified mitigation measures have been applied. If residual risk remains high or very high, supervisory authority consultation is mandatory under GDPR Article 36.']
  review_cycle_months varchar [note: 'Frequency in months at which the PIA/DPIA must be reviewed and updated, e.g., 12 for annual review, 6 for semi-annual. Determined by risk level and regulatory requirements under GDPR Article 35(11).']
  risk_level varchar [note: 'Overall inherent risk classification of the processing activity prior to mitigation, determined by the assessment team based on data sensitivity, volume, and processing nature. Drives DPO consultation and supervisory authority notification requirements.']
  supervisory_authority_consultation_date date [note: 'Date on which the competent supervisory authority was formally consulted under GDPR Article 36. The authority has up to 8 weeks to respond; processing must be suspended pending response.']
  supervisory_authority_consultation_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether prior consultation with the competent supervisory authority (e.g., national Data Protection Authority) is required because residual risk remains high after mitigation, per GDPR Article 36.']
  supervisory_authority_name varchar [note: 'Name of the competent data protection supervisory authority consulted or notified, e.g., ICO (UK), CNIL (France), BfDI (Germany), or the lead supervisory authority under GDPR one-stop-shop mechanism.']
  system_or_platform_name varchar [note: 'Name of the information system, platform, or application that performs the processing activity, e.g., Adobe Experience Platform, Ticketmaster Biometric Access, SAP SuccessFactors, or a custom fan engagement platform.']
  third_party_processors varchar [note: 'Names of external data processors or sub-processors involved in the processing activity, e.g., cloud providers, analytics vendors, ticketing platforms. Relevant for Article 28 processor agreements and transfer impact assessments.']

  Note: 'Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) / Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) record conducted for high-risk data processing activities as required by GDPR Article 35. Captures assessment reference, processing activity assessed, assessment type (DPIA/PIA), risk level, identified risks, risk mitigation measures, DPO consultation date, supervisory authority consultation requirement, assessment outcome, approval date, and review schedule. Mandatory for new fan engagement platforms, biometric ticketing, and athlete health data systems.'
}

Table compliance.accreditation {
  accreditation_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the accreditation association']
  governing_body_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the governing body or regulatory authority that issued or recognizes this accreditation.']
  vendor_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the vendor that holds or is subject to this accreditation.']
  applicable_framework varchar [note: 'The specific regulatory framework, standard, or statute under which this accreditation was issued (e.g., WADA Code 2021, ISO/IEC 17025, FCC Part 15). Belongs to the accreditation pair — a vendor may be accredited under different frameworks by different bodies.']
  certification_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this vendor\'s accreditation with the governing body. Belongs to the accreditation pair — a vendor may be active with one body and suspended with another simultaneously.']
  compliance_scope varchar [note: 'Specific activities, services, or product categories that this accreditation covers for the vendor (e.g., \'urine and blood sample analysis for prohibited substances\', \'broadcast transmission equipment for live sports\'). Scope is unique to each vendor-governing body pair.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Date on which this accreditation expires and must be renewed. Belongs to the accreditation pair — expiry terms are set by each governing body independently and differ per vendor-body combination.']
  last_verified_date date [note: 'Date on which this accreditation was most recently audited, verified, or confirmed as current by the governing body or internal compliance team. Belongs to the relationship — verification cadence differs per governing body.']
  recognition_date date [note: 'Date on which the governing body formally granted or recognized this accreditation for the vendor. Belongs to the relationship — the same vendor may have different recognition dates with different governing bodies.']
  reference_number varchar [note: 'Official reference or certificate number assigned by the governing body to uniquely identify this accreditation. Used for regulatory correspondence and audit trails.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the formal Accreditation relationship between a governing_body and a vendor. It captures the operational record of a governing body certifying or recognizing a vendor as qualified to operate within a specific regulatory framework or compliance scope. Each record links one governing_body to one vendor and carries accreditation-specific attributes — status, scope, applicable framework, and verification dates — that exist only in the context of this pairing and cannot reside on either the vendor or governing body master record alone.. Existence Justification: In sports entertainment, governing bodies such as WADA, national anti-doping organizations, and league offices formally accredit or certify specific vendors (e.g., anti-doping labs, broadcast technology providers, medical suppliers) to operate within their regulatory frameworks. A single vendor can hold accreditations from multiple governing bodies simultaneously (e.g., a lab accredited by both WADA and a national anti-doping authority), and a single governing body accredits many vendors across its jurisdiction. This is an actively managed operational relationship — compliance teams create, renew, suspend, and audit these accreditations as a core business process.'
}

  cdn_provider varchar [note: 'The name of the CDN (Content Delivery Network) provider used to deliver content and assets for this digital touchpoint (e.g., Akamai, Cloudflare, AWS CloudFront). Drives SLA monitoring, incident escalation routing, and broadcast streaming performance management.']
  channel_category varchar [note: 'Ownership classification of the digital touchpoint indicating whether the channel is directly owned and operated by Sports Entertainment (owned), operated by a third-party partner under agreement (partner), or distributed via a syndication arrangement (syndicated). Informs rights management and DRM policy assignment.']
  content_streaming_capable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this digital touchpoint supports live or on-demand video content streaming. True for OTT players and IPTV endpoints. Drives CDN (Content Delivery Network) routing, DRM enforcement, and broadcast rights compliance checks.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this digital touchpoint record was first created in the Sports Entertainment platform registry. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record age analytics.']
  current_version varchar [note: 'The currently deployed semantic version of the digital touchpoint application or platform (e.g., 4.2.1). Follows semantic versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). Used for version lifecycle management, feature flag targeting, and incident root-cause analysis.']
  deprecation_date date [note: 'The scheduled or actual date on which the digital touchpoint version or channel will be retired and no longer supported. Null if no deprecation is planned. Drives fan migration communications and SLA wind-down procedures.']
  drm_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Digital Rights Management (DRM) content protection is enforced on this digital touchpoint. True for OTT players and IPTV endpoints distributing broadcast content under media rights agreements. Drives content licensing compliance and broadcast rights enforcement.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'The date on which this specific IP usage license for this touchpoint expires. Distinct from the IP asset\'s own registration expiration date — this is the channel-specific grant expiry.']
  gdpr_consent_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this digital touchpoint is subject to GDPR consent collection requirements, applicable when the channel is accessible to fans in EU/EEA markets. Drives consent management platform (CMP) activation and data processing lawfulness checks.']
  geo_restriction_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether geographic content restrictions (blackout rules) are enforced on this digital touchpoint. True for RSN (Regional Sports Network) and broadcast-rights-restricted channels. Drives content availability logic in the distribution layer.']
  grant_date date [note: 'The date on which the IP usage license was formally granted for this specific touchpoint. Belongs to the individual grant record, not to the IP asset or the touchpoint globally.']
  launch_date date [note: 'The date on which the digital touchpoint was first made available to fans (initial go-live). Distinct from release_date which tracks the current version. Used for channel age analytics, anniversary campaigns, and LTV (Lifetime Value) baseline calculations.']
  loyalty_capable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this digital touchpoint supports fan loyalty program interactions including point earning, redemption, and tier status display. Drives Adobe Experience Platform personalization and Salesforce CRM loyalty event tracking.']
  ltv_baseline_usd decimal(10,2) [note: 'The established LTV (Lifetime Value) baseline in US Dollars representing the expected total revenue from a fan acquired through this digital touchpoint over their engagement lifetime. Used for channel investment justification, fan segmentation strategy, and Workday Adaptive Planning revenue modeling.']
  merchandise_capable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this digital touchpoint supports merchandise browsing and purchase via the Shopify Plus DTC (Direct-To-Consumer) e-commerce integration. Drives SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) catalog availability and POS (Point of Sale) routing.']
  minimum_supported_version varchar [note: 'The oldest version of the touchpoint application that is still officially supported and receives security patches. Fans on versions below this threshold are prompted to upgrade. Critical for PCI-DSS compliance and GDPR data security obligations.']
  nps_target decimal(5,2) [note: 'The target NPS (Net Promoter Score) for fan experience quality on this digital touchpoint, ranging from -100 to +100. Used as a KPI benchmark in Adobe Experience Platform fan satisfaction reporting and digital experience design reviews.']
  pci_scope boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this digital touchpoint is within PCI-DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) scope due to processing, storing, or transmitting cardholder data. True for channels with ticketing, merchandise, or PPV payment capabilities. Drives annual PCI audit scope and security control requirements.']
  personalization_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Adobe Experience Platform personalization engine is active for this digital touchpoint, enabling real-time fan experience customization, targeted content recommendations, and dynamic offer delivery.']
  platform_type varchar [note: 'Categorical classification of the digital channel by its delivery platform. Drives capability mapping, SLA tier assignment, and analytics segmentation. Values: mobile_ios, mobile_android, web_portal, ott_player (Over-The-Top Streaming), venue_kiosk, iptv_endpoint (Internet Protocol Television).']
  ppv_capable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this digital touchpoint supports Pay-Per-View (PPV) event purchases and streaming. Drives PPV product availability, payment flow routing, and PCI-DSS scope determination for the channel.']
  primary_market varchar [note: 'The primary geographic market for which this digital touchpoint is designed and operated, expressed as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Drives regulatory compliance applicability (GDPR, CCPA), content geo-restriction rules, and localization configuration.']
  release_date date [note: 'The date on which the current version of the digital touchpoint was publicly released or deployed to production. Used for version lifecycle tracking, deprecation scheduling, and release cadence analytics.']
  salesforce_channel_ref varchar [note: 'The channel reference identifier in Salesforce CRM used to attribute fan interactions, case origins, and engagement events to this digital touchpoint. Enables omnichannel fan journey tracking and CRM-based NPS (Net Promoter Score) attribution.']
  session_timeout_minutes varchar [note: 'The number of minutes of inactivity after which a fan session on this digital touchpoint is automatically terminated. Configurable per platform type and SLA tier. Drives security compliance and PCI-DSS session management requirements.']
  supported_languages varchar [note: 'Comma-delimited list of BCP-47 language codes supported by this digital touchpoint for UI localization (e.g., \'en-US, es-MX, fr-FR, pt-BR\'). Drives content localization workflows, fan experience personalization, and international market expansion planning.']
  supported_os_versions varchar [note: 'Comma-delimited list of operating system versions officially supported by this touchpoint (e.g., \'iOS 16+, iOS 17\' or \'Android 12, Android 13, Android 14\'). Null for non-mobile/non-OS-dependent platforms. Used for compatibility testing and fan support triage.']
  territory_scope varchar [note: 'Comma-delimited list of ISO 3166-1 country or region codes defining the geographic markets in which this IP asset is licensed for display on this touchpoint. Supports geo-restriction enforcement at the channel level.']
  ticketing_capable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this digital touchpoint supports ticket browsing, purchase, and mobile ticket delivery. Drives integration with Ticketmaster/AXS ticketing systems and determines PCI-DSS payment scope for the channel.']
  touchpoint_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known, human-readable unique code assigned to the digital channel (e.g., TP-IOSAPP-001, TP-WEBPRT-002). Used as the business identifier across all domain attribution and reporting. Sourced from Adobe Experience Platform channel configuration.']
  touchpoint_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable display name of the digital channel (e.g., \'Sports Entertainment iOS App\', \'Fan Web Portal\', \'OTT Streaming Player — Roku\'). Used in dashboards, SLA reports, and omnichannel orchestration configurations.']
  touchpoint_status varchar [note: 'Current operational lifecycle state of the digital channel. \'active\' indicates the channel is live and serving fans; \'maintenance\' indicates scheduled downtime; \'deprecated\' indicates the channel is being sunset; \'pilot\' indicates limited-release testing. Drives SLA monitoring and omnichannel routing decisions.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this digital touchpoint record was most recently modified in the platform registry. Follows ISO 8601 format. Used for change detection in downstream ETL pipelines, audit compliance, and SLA configuration drift monitoring.']
  uptime_target_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'The contractually committed or operationally targeted uptime percentage for this digital touchpoint (e.g., 99.95). Expressed as a percentage. Used in SLA compliance reporting and infrastructure capacity planning.']
  usage_type varchar [note: 'Describes how the IP asset is used on the digital touchpoint — e.g., as a display brand mark, watermark, authentication screen logo, or in-content overlay. Belongs to the license grant, not to either entity alone.']

  Note: 'Master registry of all fan-facing digital channels operated by Sports Entertainment — mobile apps (iOS/Android), web portals, OTT streaming players, venue kiosk terminals, and IPTV endpoints. Each touchpoint has a unique identity, platform type, version lifecycle, supported capabilities (ticketing, merchandise, content, loyalty), SLA tier assignment, and operational status. SSOT for digital channel definitions referenced by all domains requiring channel-level attribution.'
}

Table platform.fan_account {
  fan_account_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the fan\'s digital platform account on Sports Entertainment properties. Primary key for this entity.']
  data_controller_corporate_entity_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to legal.corporate_entity. Business justification: Fan accounts are held with a specific corporate entity acting as GDPR data controller or CCPA business. Legal and privacy teams must identify the contracting corporate entity per fan account for data ']

Replacing it with preferred_franchise_id ena']

  account_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the fan account by the nature of the registrant. \'individual\' covers standard adult fans; \'corporate\' covers business/hospitality accounts; \'youth\' covers under-18 accounts subject to COPPA/GDPR-K restrictions; \'family\' covers linked household accounts.']

  cac_source varchar [note: 'The marketing channel or campaign source attributed to acquiring this fan account, used for Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) analysis and Return on Investment (ROI) reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: organic_search|paid_social|email_campaign|referral|event_activation|dtc_app_store|affiliate|direct — promote to reference product]']

Governs data activation in Adobe Experience Platform audience segments.']
  consent_marketing_email boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the fan has provided explicit opt-in consent to receive marketing email communications from Sports Entertainment. Required for GDPR Article 6 lawful basis and CAN-SPAM compliance. Drives Salesforce CRM email campaign eligibility.']
  consent_push_notification boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the fan has granted permission for push notifications on their registered mobile devices. Governs mobile app engagement campaigns, live event alerts, and personalized content recommendations via the Sports Entertainment mobile platform.']
  consent_recorded_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the fan\'s most recent consent preferences were captured or updated. Provides the audit trail required by GDPR Article 7(1) to demonstrate that consent was freely given, specific, informed, and unambiguous.']
  country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the fan\'s registered location. Used for geo-based broadcast rights enforcement (RSN blackouts, DRM geo-restrictions), GDPR/CCPA jurisdiction determination, and regional content licensing compliance.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise timestamp when the platform fan account record was first created in the system. Serves as the authoritative audit creation marker for data lineage, GDPR processing records, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the fan account\'s billing and revenue currency (e.g., \'USD\', \'GBP\', \'EUR\'). Supports multi-currency ARPU and LTV reporting across global markets.']
  device_limit varchar [note: 'Maximum number of concurrent devices permitted to stream or access content under this fan account, as defined by the account tier\'s entitlement policy. Enforced at the platform session management layer to comply with broadcast rights and DRM licensing terms.']
  display_name varchar [note: 'The fan-chosen display name or username shown across digital touchpoints including the mobile app, web portal, and fan engagement platform. May differ from the legal name held in the CRM.']
  dtc_channel_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this fan account was acquired or is primarily engaged through a Direct-To-Consumer (DTC) digital channel (e.g., Sports Entertainment\'s own app or web portal) as opposed to a third-party platform or RSN. Key segmentation flag for DTC strategy performance reporting.']
  email varchar [note: 'Primary email address associated with the fan\'s platform account. Used for authentication, transactional notifications, marketing communications, and identity resolution across Salesforce CRM and Adobe Experience Platform.']
  external_account_ref varchar [note: 'Externally-known account identifier surfaced to the fan across digital touchpoints (e.g., displayed in the fan portal, mobile app, and Adobe Experience Platform profile). Serves as the business-facing account number distinct from the internal surrogate key.']
  gdpr_data_subject_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this fan account is subject to GDPR regulations based on their registered country or detected location. When true, GDPR-specific data handling, consent management, and right-to-erasure workflows are enforced.']
  identity_provider varchar [note: 'The authentication identity provider (IdP) used to create or link this fan account. \'native\' — Sports Entertainment-managed credentials; \'google\'/\'apple\'/\'facebook\'/\'twitter\' — social login OAuth providers; \'sso_enterprise\' — corporate SSO for B2B/hospitality accounts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: native|google|apple|facebook|twitter|sso_enterprise|microsoft — promote to reference product if additional providers are onboarded]']
  is_email_verified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the fan has completed email address verification via a confirmation link or OTP. Unverified accounts may have restricted access to ticketing, payments, and premium content per platform policy.']
  is_mfa_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the fan has enrolled in Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for their platform account. MFA enrollment is required for VIP-tier accounts and recommended for all accounts with stored payment methods per PCI DSS requirements.']
  is_subscription_active boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the fan currently holds an active paid subscription (premium or VIP tier) on the Sports Entertainment platform. Drives content entitlement checks, OTT access gates, and Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) reporting.']
  last_login_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the fan\'s most recent successful authentication event on any Sports Entertainment digital property (web portal, mobile app, OTT platform). Key signal for churn prediction, re-engagement campaigns, and dormant account governance.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to any field on this platform fan account record. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trails, and data freshness monitoring in the Databricks Silver layer.']
  linked_season_ticket_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this platform fan account is linked to one or more season ticket accounts in the Archtics venue seating and inventory management system. Enables cross-domain fan identity resolution between the digital platform and ticketing systems.']
  ltv_score_bucket varchar [note: 'Categorical Lifetime Value (LTV) score bucket assigned to the fan account based on predictive modelling in Adobe Experience Platform. \'low\' — minimal engagement/spend; \'medium\' — moderate; \'high\' — strong recurring revenue; \'champion\' — top-tier fans with highest LTV and advocacy potential.   ppv_eligible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this fan account is eligible to purchase Pay-Per-View (PPV) events based on account tier, verified payment method, geographic rights, and age verification status. Drives PPV purchase flow gating on the OTT platform.']
  preferred_locale varchar [note: 'IETF BCP 47 locale code representing the fan\'s preferred language and regional format settings (e.g., \'en_US\', \'fr_FR\', \'es_MX\').   preferred_sport varchar [note: 'The fan\'s self-declared or algorithmically inferred primary sport preference (e.g., \'football\', \'basketball\', \'soccer\', \'baseball\'). Drives content personalization, event recommendations, and audience segmentation in Adobe Experience Platform for targeted sponsorship activations.']
  registration_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the fan completed account registration on the Sports Entertainment digital platform. Used for cohort analysis, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) attribution, and Lifetime Value (LTV) baseline calculations.']

  Note: 'Platform-layer account representing a registered fan\'s digital identity on Sports Entertainment properties. Distinct from the fan domain\'s CRM profile — this entity owns the digital access layer, commercial relationship metrics, and platform-level account governance.'

Table platform.auth_session {
  auth_session_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each authenticated fan session record across all digital touchpoints. Primary key for the auth_session data product.']
  digital_touchpoint_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to platform.digital_touchpoint. Business justification: Every authenticated session occurs on a specific digital touchpoint (mobile app, web portal, etc.). auth_session.touchpoint_channel is a denormalized STRING; replacing it with digital_touchpoint_id FK']
  fan_account_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific digital platform instance (e.g., NFL App, NBA League Pass, Sports Entertainment Fan Portal) through which the session was initiated. Supports multi-platform SLA monitoring and platform-level engagement analytics.']
  fan_fan_profile_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the authenticated fan (registered user) who initiated this session. Links to the fan master record in Salesforce CRM and Adobe Experience Platform fan profile.']
  fan_profile_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the authenticated fan (registered user) who initiated this session. Links to the fan master record in Salesforce CRM and Adobe Experience Platform fan profile.']
  platform_channel_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific digital platform instance (e.g., NFL App, NBA League Pass, Sports Entertainment Fan Portal) through which the session was initiated. Supports multi-platform SLA monitoring and platform-level engagement analytics.']
  privacy_request_id varchar [note: 'Reference identifier of a GDPR right-to-erasure or CCPA deletion request that triggered session invalidation or data suppression for this record. Null if no erasure request applies. Supports regulatory compliance audit trails.']
  app_version varchar [note: 'The version of the Sports Entertainment mobile app or web portal client used during the session (semantic versioning format, e.g., 4.2.1). Supports release impact analysis, bug triage, and forced-upgrade policy enforcement.']
  auth_method varchar [note: 'The mechanism used by the fan to authenticate at session initiation. Includes password-based login, Single Sign-On (SSO) via identity provider, biometric (fingerprint/face), social OAuth (Google, Apple, Facebook), magic link email, or passkey (FIDO2). Supports fraud analysis and authentication method adoption reporting.']
  ccpa_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether CCPA regulations apply to this session based on the fan\'s geolocation (California, USA). Drives downstream opt-out enforcement and consumer rights request workflows.']
  concurrent_session_count varchar [note: 'The number of active sessions for the same fan account at the time this session was initiated. Used to enforce concurrent session limits (e.g., OTT streaming entitlement enforcement), detect credential sharing, and support fraud investigation.']
  consent_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time (UTC) when the fan acknowledged the privacy consent notice during this session\'s login flow. Provides an immutable audit record for GDPR and CCPA compliance and right-to-erasure investigations.']
  consent_version varchar [note: 'The version identifier of the privacy consent notice (GDPR/CCPA) that the fan acknowledged at the time of login for this session (e.g., \'v3.2-GDPR\', \'v2.1-CCPA\'). Critical for GDPR right-to-erasure audit trails and regulatory compliance reporting.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time (UTC) when this auth_session record was first written to the Silver Layer data store. Distinct from session_start_timestamp which records the business event time. Used for data lineage, ETL audit, and SLA compliance on data freshness.']
  device_fingerprint varchar [note: 'A hashed composite identifier derived from device hardware and software attributes (OS, browser, screen resolution, etc.) used to recognize returning devices without persistent cookies. Supports fraud investigation and concurrent session detection. Stored as a one-way hash; not reversible to raw device attributes.']
  device_os varchar [note: 'The operating system of the device used during the session (e.g., iOS 17.2, Android 14, Windows 11, macOS 14). Supports platform compatibility analysis and security vulnerability tracking.']
  device_type varchar [note: 'Category of the physical device used to initiate the session. Supports device-level analytics, fraud pattern detection, and platform optimization for fan engagement across digital touchpoints.']
  entitlement_tier varchar [note: 'The fan\'s subscription or access entitlement tier active at the time of session initiation (e.g., free, basic, premium, VIP, enterprise). Determines feature access, content availability, and OTT streaming rights during the session. Supports ARPU segmentation and LTV analysis.']
  fraud_risk_score varchar [note: 'A numeric risk score (0–100) assigned at session initiation by the fraud detection engine based on device fingerprint, IP reputation, behavioral signals, and authentication anomalies. Higher scores indicate greater fraud risk. Supports fraud investigation and adaptive authentication policies.']
  gdpr_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether GDPR regulations apply to this session based on the fan\'s geolocation (geo_country_code within EU/EEA). Drives downstream data processing rules, right-to-erasure workflows, and data residency enforcement.']
  geo_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code derived from IP geolocation at session start (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Used for broadcast rights enforcement, GDPR/CCPA jurisdiction determination, and regional fan engagement analytics.']
  geo_region varchar [note: 'Sub-national region or state derived from IP geolocation (e.g., California, Ontario, Bavaria). Supports CCPA applicability determination, Regional Sports Network (RSN) rights enforcement, and regional fan engagement segmentation.']
  identity_provider_session_reference varchar [note: 'The session or correlation identifier issued by the external identity provider (SSO/OAuth) for this authentication event (e.g., Okta session ID, Azure AD correlation ID). Used to correlate Sports Entertainment sessions with IdP audit logs for security investigations.']
  ip_address varchar [note: 'The public IP address of the fan\'s device at session initiation. Used for geolocation derivation, fraud detection, and broadcast rights geo-restriction enforcement. May constitute personal data under GDPR in EU jurisdictions.']
  is_bot_suspected boolean [note: 'Indicates whether automated bot detection (e.g., CAPTCHA failure, behavioral anomaly scoring) flagged this session as potentially non-human at initiation. Used for fraud investigation, ticket scalping prevention, and platform abuse mitigation.']
  is_trusted_device boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the device used for this session was previously registered as a trusted device by the fan, enabling reduced friction authentication (e.g., MFA bypass). Supports adaptive authentication and fan experience personalization.']
  login_attempt_count varchar [note: 'The number of authentication attempts made before this session was successfully established. A value greater than 1 indicates prior failed attempts. Used for brute-force detection, account lockout policy enforcement, and security incident investigation.']
  mfa_method varchar [note: 'The specific second-factor method used when MFA was required. \'sms_otp\' is SMS one-time password; \'email_otp\' is email one-time password; \'totp_app\' is time-based OTP via authenticator app; \'push_notification\' is in-app push approval; \'none\' when MFA was not required or bypassed.']
  mfa_status varchar [note: 'Indicates whether Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) was required and the outcome at session initiation. \'not_required\' means MFA policy did not apply; \'passed\' means MFA challenge was successfully completed; \'failed\' means MFA challenge was not completed (session may have been blocked); \'bypassed\' means MFA was skipped via trusted device or admin override.']
  oauth_scope varchar [note: 'The permission scopes granted to the session token during OAuth-based authentication (e.g., \'openid profile email ticketing:read\'). Defines what resources and APIs the session is authorized to access. Supports least-privilege access auditing.']
  referrer_url varchar [note: 'The URL or deep-link from which the fan navigated to the authentication page (e.g., a promotional email link, a sponsor landing page, a social media post). Supports fan acquisition attribution, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) analysis, and campaign effectiveness reporting.']
  session_duration_seconds varchar [note: 'The total elapsed time in seconds between session_start_timestamp and session_end_timestamp. Null if the session is still active. Used for fan engagement depth analysis, SLA compliance reporting, and Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) correlation studies.']
  session_end_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time (UTC) when the session was closed, expired, or terminated. Null if the session is still active. Used to compute session duration and identify abnormally long or short sessions.']
  session_invalidation_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time (UTC) when the session token was explicitly invalidated by a security event (e.g., password reset, admin revocation, GDPR erasure request). Distinct from session_end_timestamp which records normal closure. Supports GDPR right-to-erasure audit trails and security incident timelines.']
  session_start_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time (UTC) when the fan successfully authenticated and the session was established. Principal business event timestamp for SLA measurement and session duration analytics.']
  session_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the authenticated session. \'active\' indicates an ongoing session; \'expired\' indicates timeout; \'terminated\' indicates explicit logout or forced closure; \'invalidated\' indicates security-triggered revocation; \'suspended\' indicates temporary hold pending re-authentication.']
  session_token varchar [note: 'Cryptographically generated bearer token issued at authentication that uniquely identifies the active session. Used for SLA monitoring, fraud investigation, and session continuity across digital touchpoints. Treated as a sensitive identifier per GDPR and CCPA.']
  sso_provider varchar [note: 'The identity provider used when auth_method is \'sso\' or \'social_oauth\' (e.g., Google, Apple, Facebook, Microsoft Azure AD, Okta). Null when direct password authentication is used. Supports SSO adoption analytics and identity provider SLA monitoring.']
  termination_reason varchar [note: 'The reason the session ended. \'logout\' indicates fan-initiated sign-out; \'timeout\' indicates inactivity expiry; \'forced\' indicates administrative or security-triggered closure; \'token_revoked\' indicates the token was invalidated (e.g., password change); \'concurrent_limit\' indicates session killed due to concurrent session policy enforcement.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time (UTC) when this auth_session record was last modified in the Silver Layer (e.g., when session_end_timestamp or termination_reason was populated upon session closure). Supports data lineage and change tracking.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of each authenticated fan session across digital touchpoints. Captures session token, authentication method (password, SSO, biometric, social OAuth), device fingerprint, IP geolocation, session start/end timestamps, touchpoint channel, MFA status, session termination reason (logout, timeout, forced), and GDPR/CCPA consent version acknowledged at login.   completion_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the interaction content or flow that the fan completed before exiting, expressed as a value between 0.00 and 100.00. Applicable to content plays, live streams, and quiz/poll flows. Null for non-sequential interactions.']
  consent_status varchar [note: 'Fan\'s data processing consent status at the time of this interaction, as recorded in the consent management platform. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance to determine whether this interaction record may be used for personalization and analytics.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Audit timestamp recording when this fan interaction record was first persisted to the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for data lineage, SLA monitoring, and pipeline audit trails.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the purchase_initiated_amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Populated when interaction_type is in_app_purchase_initiated. Supports multi-currency global market operations.']
  data_processing_basis varchar [note: 'The legal basis under GDPR Article 6 for processing this fan interaction record. Required for regulatory compliance documentation and data subject rights management across EU and global markets.']
  device_os varchar [note: 'Operating system of the fan\'s device at the time of interaction (e.g., \'iOS 17.2\', \'Android 14\', \'Windows 11\'). Used for platform compatibility monitoring and SLA incident triage.']
  device_type varchar [note: 'Category of the physical device used by the fan to perform the interaction. Used for UX optimization, feature entitlement decisions, and device-level engagement analytics.']
  error_code varchar [note: 'Platform-defined error code recorded when interaction_status is error. Used for SLA (Service Level Agreement) breach analysis, platform reliability monitoring, and incident triage. Null for successful interactions.']
  geo_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the fan\'s detected location at the time of interaction, derived from IP geolocation or device locale. Used for regional rights enforcement, GDPR/CCPA compliance scoping, and market-level engagement analytics.']
  interaction_duration_seconds varchar [note: 'Duration in seconds from interaction initiation to completion or abandonment. For content plays and live stream joins, this represents watch/listen time. Null for instantaneous interactions such as social shares or loyalty check-ins.']
  interaction_reference_code varchar [note: 'Externally-visible business identifier for this interaction record, used in customer support, analytics reporting, and Adobe Experience Platform event correlation. Format: INT- followed by 8-20 alphanumeric characters.']
  interaction_status varchar [note: 'Lifecycle outcome state of the interaction: completed (full engagement), abandoned (fan exited before completion), converted (resulted in a purchase or sign-up), in_progress (ongoing at capture time), or error (technical failure during interaction).']
  interaction_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time (UTC) when the fan interaction was initiated on the platform digital touchpoint. This is the principal business event time, distinct from record audit timestamps. Conforms to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  interaction_type varchar [note: 'Categorical discriminator identifying the kind of fan action recorded. Drives segmentation in the personalization engine and engagement analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: content_play|live_stream_join|in_app_purchase_initiated|loyalty_check_in|poll_participation|quiz_participation|social_share|push_notification_engagement|ab_test_exposure — promote to reference product]']
  is_authenticated boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the fan was authenticated (logged in) at the time of the interaction. Unauthenticated interactions are captured for anonymous analytics but cannot be linked to a fan account. Drives ARPU (Average Revenue Per User) and LTV (Lifetime Value) segmentation.']
  is_first_interaction boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this is the fan\'s first recorded interaction of this interaction_type on the platform. Used to measure new engagement acquisition, onboarding funnel entry, and CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) attribution.']
  loyalty_points_awarded varchar [note: 'Number of loyalty points credited to the fan\'s account as a result of this interaction. Populated for loyalty check-ins and qualifying engagement actions. Zero for non-qualifying interactions.']
  nps_score varchar [note: 'Fan\'s NPS (Net Promoter Score) rating submitted during or immediately following this interaction, on a scale of 0 to 10. Populated only when the interaction includes an in-app NPS survey prompt. Used for fan experience quality measurement.']
  platform_name varchar [note: 'Name of the specific digital platform or application where the interaction occurred (e.g., \'League Official App\', \'Fan Zone Web Portal\', \'OTT Streaming Service\'). Enables platform-level performance segmentation.']
  poll_response_value decimal(18,2) [note: 'The fan\'s selected answer or response text for a poll or quiz interaction. Populated when interaction_type is poll_participation or quiz_participation. Stored as a string to accommodate both option codes and free-text responses.']
  purchase_category varchar [note: 'Category of the in-app purchase initiated during this interaction. PPV (Pay-Per-View) refers to single-event streaming purchases. Populated when interaction_type is in_app_purchase_initiated.']
  purchase_initiated_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'Gross monetary value of the in-app purchase that was initiated during this interaction, in the transaction currency. Populated only when interaction_type is in_app_purchase_initiated. This is the initiated amount, not the confirmed transaction amount (which is owned by the ticketing or merchandise domain).']
  referral_source varchar [note: 'The originating source or campaign that directed the fan to the interaction touchpoint (e.g., \'email_campaign_q3\', \'organic_search\', \'sponsor_banner\', \'push_notification\'). Used for CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) and campaign attribution analysis.']
  social_share_platform varchar [note: 'The external social media platform to which the fan shared content. Populated when interaction_type is social_share. Used to measure social amplification and UGC (User Generated Content) reach by platform.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record that originated this fan interaction event (e.g., Adobe Experience Platform, Salesforce CRM, mobile SDK). Used for data lineage tracking and Silver Layer ingestion audit.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Audit timestamp recording when this fan interaction record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse, for example when the interaction_status is updated from in_progress to completed or abandoned.']
  utm_campaign varchar [note: 'Urchin Tracking Module (UTM) campaign parameter captured from the interaction URL or deep link. Used for digital marketing attribution, CPM (Cost Per Mille) analysis, and GRP (Gross Rating Point) measurement across digital channels.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of meaningful fan actions across platform digital touchpoints — content plays, live stream joins, in-app purchases initiated, loyalty check-ins, poll/quiz participations, social shares, push notification engagements, and A/B test variant exposures. Captures interaction type, touchpoint channel, fan account reference, event/content reference, timestamp, session context, and outcome (completion, abandonment, conversion). Primary behavioral data feed for the personalization engine and engagement analytics. Scoped to platform-initiated interactions only; content consumption metrics owned by the content domain.'
}

  utm_parameters varchar [note: 'URL tracking parameters appended to the deep link for campaign attribution in web analytics (e.g., \'utm_source=push&utm_medium=notification&utm_campaign=NBA_FINALS_2025\').   Note: 'Master record of platform-orchestrated omnichannel notification campaigns targeting fan segments — push notifications, in-app messages, SMS alerts, and email triggers for event reminders, ticket availability alerts, merchandise drops, loyalty milestones, and content recommendations. Distinct from sponsorship activation campaigns — this entity owns platform-to-fan direct communications only.'

  drm_scheme varchar [note: 'DRM technology scheme used to protect content on this device. Determines which encrypted content streams the device is authorized to decrypt and play back.']
  fraud_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this device has been flagged as potentially fraudulent by the platform\'s fraud detection engine or a manual review process. Flagged devices may have access suspended pending investigation.']

  fraud_risk_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Numeric risk score (0.00–100.00) assigned to this device by the platform\'s fraud detection engine based on behavioral signals, registration patterns, and device fingerprint analysis. Higher scores indicate elevated fraud risk and may trigger account review workflows.']
  is_primary_device boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this device is designated as the fan\'s primary device. The primary device may receive preferential DRM stream allocation and is used as the default target for critical account notifications.']
  is_trusted_device boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this device has been explicitly designated as a trusted device by the fan or by the platform\'s fraud detection engine. Trusted devices may bypass step-up authentication challenges and receive elevated session durations.']
  last_active_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent authenticated session or activity recorded on this device. Used to identify dormant devices for cleanup, enforce device limit policies, and support fan re-engagement campaigns.']
  last_login_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent successful authentication event on this device. Distinct from last_active_timestamp which captures any activity; this captures explicit login events for security audit and session management.']
  mfa_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether multi-factor authentication is enabled for this device. Devices with MFA enabled receive elevated trust scores and may bypass additional step-up challenges for high-value transactions such as ticket purchases.']
  notification_opt_in boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the fan has granted permission for the platform to send push notifications to this device. Governs push notification delivery eligibility for event alerts, promotional offers, and fan engagement campaigns.']
  notification_opt_in_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the fan granted or last updated push notification consent for this device. Required for GDPR and CCPA consent audit trails.']
  os_platform varchar [note: 'Operating system platform running on the registered device. Used for push notification routing, DRM certificate compatibility checks, and platform-specific feature entitlement enforcement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: iOS|Android|tvOS|watchOS|Windows|macOS|Tizen|webOS|PlayStation|Xbox — promote to reference product]']
  os_version varchar [note: 'Version string of the operating system installed on the registered device at the time of last check-in. Used to assess DRM compatibility, enforce minimum OS version policies, and target OS-specific feature rollouts.']
  push_notification_token varchar [note: 'Platform-issued push notification token (APNs token for iOS, FCM registration token for Android) used to deliver personalized push notifications for event alerts, ticket offers, and fan engagement campaigns via Adobe Experience Platform.']
  push_token_expiry_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp at which the push notification token expires and must be refreshed. Used by the notification delivery engine to proactively re-register tokens before expiry to prevent missed fan communications.']
  registration_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the geographic location from which the device was registered. Used for broadcast rights geo-enforcement, GDPR/CCPA jurisdiction determination, and regional content personalization.']
  registration_ip_address varchar [note: 'IP address from which the device registration request originated. Used for geolocation-based fraud detection, broadcast rights geo-enforcement, and security audit logging.']
  registration_reference varchar [note: 'Externally visible alphanumeric reference code assigned to this device registration at the time of enrollment. Used in support communications and audit trails.']
  registration_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the device registration. Active devices are permitted platform access; suspended devices are temporarily blocked; revoked devices are permanently removed from the fan\'s authorized device list.']
  registration_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the fan first registered this device with the digital platform. Serves as the effective start date for device authorization and is used in device limit enforcement and fraud detection analysis.']
  salesforce_contact_reference varchar [note: 'Salesforce CRM Contact record ID linked to the fan who owns this device registration. Enables bi-directional synchronization between the digital platform device registry and the Salesforce fan relationship management system.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this device registration record was last modified. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.']

  Note: 'Master record of fan-registered devices linked to a fan account for digital platform access — smartphones, tablets, smart TVs, gaming consoles, and connected wearables. Captures device type, OS platform and version, device fingerprint hash, push notification token, DRM device certificate, registration timestamp, last active timestamp, trusted device flag, and device limit enforcement status. Supports DRM concurrent stream enforcement, fraud detection, and personalized push notification delivery.'
}

Business justification: A/B test governance requires each experiment to reference a standardized KPI definition as its primary success metric. The primary_success_metric plain-text attribute is a denormalized KPI reference; ']
  ab_test_status varchar [note: 'Current state of the experiment in its lifecycle. \'draft\' = configured but not launched; \'active\' = running and collecting data; \'paused\' = temporarily halted; \'concluded\' = data collection complete, results available; \'archived\' = historical record only.']
  actual_end_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time when the experiment was concluded or stopped. Null if the experiment is still active. Used for duration analysis and post-experiment reporting.']
  actual_start_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time when the experiment was activated and began exposing fans to variants. Distinct from the scheduled start date; used for accurate duration and exposure calculations.']

  control_variant_key varchar [note: 'The key/code identifying the control (baseline) variant within this experiment (e.g., \'CONTROL\', \'A\'). Used to anchor statistical comparisons and causal inference analysis.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this experiment record was first created in the platform data product. Audit trail field for data lineage and governance.']

  early_stopping_reason varchar [note: 'Reason the experiment was stopped before the scheduled end date. \'significance_reached\' = primary metric crossed significance threshold early; \'guardrail_breach\' = a secondary guardrail metric degraded unacceptably; \'sample_ratio_mismatch\' = traffic allocation integrity failure detected. Null if experiment ran to full schedule.']
  exclusion_group_key varchar [note: 'Identifier of the mutual exclusion group this experiment belongs to. Experiments sharing the same exclusion group key will not overlap in fan assignment. Null if the experiment is not part of any exclusion group.']

  gdpr_article22_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this experiment involves automated decision-making that materially affects fan experience, triggering GDPR Article 22 transparency and documentation obligations. True = GDPR Article 22 disclosure required; False = standard experiment.']
  hypothesis varchar [note: 'Formal statement of the causal hypothesis being tested (e.g., \'Changing the CTA button from grey to orange will increase ticket purchase conversion by 5% among mobile fans\'). Required for experiment governance and causal inference documentation.']
  is_mutually_exclusive boolean [note: 'Indicates whether fans enrolled in this experiment are excluded from all other concurrent experiments on the same touchpoint. True = mutually exclusive (prevents interaction effects); False = fan may be in multiple experiments simultaneously.']
  minimum_detectable_effect decimal(10,6) [note: 'The smallest relative or absolute change in the primary success metric that the experiment is powered to detect (e.g., 0.050000 = 5% relative lift). Used in sample size calculation and experiment power analysis.']
  owner_team varchar [note: 'Name of the business or product team responsible for designing, running, and acting on this experiment (e.g., \'Fan Engagement Product\', \'Ticketing UX\', \'Digital Personalization\'). Used for experiment governance accountability.']
  personalization_algorithm_code varchar [note: 'Reference to the Adobe Experience Platform personalization algorithm or model being tested as a variant in this experiment. Populated only for personalization_algorithm test category experiments.']
  required_sample_size varchar [note: 'Minimum number of unique fan exposures required per variant to achieve the pre-registered statistical power and significance threshold. Calculated at experiment design time.']
  rollout_decision varchar [note: 'Post-experiment business decision on what to do with the winning variant. \'ship\' = deploy to 100% of audience; \'iterate\' = run follow-up experiment; \'abandon\' = discard the variant; \'hold\' = defer decision pending further review.']
  salesforce_campaign_reference varchar [note: 'The Salesforce CRM Campaign record ID linked to this experiment when the test is associated with a fan engagement or sponsor campaign. Enables experiment-to-campaign attribution in Salesforce reporting.']
  scheduled_end_date date [note: 'The planned calendar date on which the experiment is scheduled to conclude data collection. Used for experiment roadmap planning and resource allocation.']
  scheduled_start_date date [note: 'The planned calendar date on which the experiment is scheduled to begin collecting data. Used for experiment roadmap planning and conflict detection.']
  secondary_success_metrics varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of secondary KPIs monitored alongside the primary metric (e.g., \'session_duration, bounce_rate, nps_score\'). NPS = Net Promoter Score. Used for guardrail monitoring and holistic experiment evaluation.']
  statistical_power decimal(5,4) [note: 'Pre-registered statistical power (1 - beta) for the experiment design (e.g., 0.8000 = 80% power). Determines the probability of detecting a true effect of the minimum detectable effect size.']
  statistical_significance_threshold decimal(5,4) [note: 'Pre-registered p-value threshold below which the experiment result is considered statistically significant (e.g., 0.0500 for 95% confidence). Enforces rigorous experiment governance and prevents premature conclusions.']
  target_segment_definition varchar [note: 'JSON-serialised or plain-text description of the audience segment criteria used to qualify fans for inclusion in the experiment (e.g., \'Season ticket holders in North America, age 18-35, active in last 30 days\'). Sourced from Adobe Experience Platform segment builder.']
  test_category varchar [note: 'Business domain category of the experiment. Classifies the area of the digital platform being tested to enable portfolio-level experiment governance and conflict detection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ui_ux|pricing_display|notification_copy|personalization_algorithm|feature_rollout|content_recommendation|checkout_flow|onboarding — promote to reference product]']
  test_key varchar [note: 'Externally-known, human-readable unique code identifying the experiment across systems (e.g., \'CHECKOUT_CTA_V2_2024Q3\'). Used as the stable business identifier referenced in Adobe Experience Platform experiment configurations and Salesforce CRM campaign linkages.']
  test_name varchar [note: 'Descriptive human-readable name of the experiment (e.g., \'Checkout Button Color Test – Mobile App Q3 2024\'). Used in experiment governance dashboards and stakeholder reporting.']
  test_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the experiment methodology. \'ab\' = classic two-variant test; \'multivariate\' = multiple element combinations; \'split_url\' = separate page URL variants; \'feature_flag\' = binary feature rollout gate; \'personalization\' = Adobe Experience Platform personalization algorithm variant.']
  traffic_allocation_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the qualifying audience segment that is enrolled into this experiment (0.00–100.00). The remainder of the segment is excluded from the test entirely. Enables gradual rollout and risk management.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this experiment record was most recently modified. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  variant_count varchar [note: 'Total number of variants in the experiment including the control group (e.g., 2 for a classic A/B test, 3+ for multivariate). Drives traffic allocation validation logic.']
  winning_variant_key varchar [note: 'The key/code of the variant declared as the winner upon experiment conclusion. Null if the experiment is still active, inconclusive, or resulted in no statistically significant winner.']

  Note: 'Master record of A/B and multivariate experiments running across platform digital touchpoints — UI/UX layout tests, personalization algorithm variants, pricing display experiments, notification copy tests, and feature rollout gates. Captures test hypothesis, target segment, variant definitions with traffic allocation percentages, success metrics and statistical significance thresholds, test lifecycle dates (draft/active/concluded/archived), and per-fan variant assignment records with exposure timestamps. Supports experiment governance, causal inference analysis, and GDPR Article 22 transparency for automated decision-making affecting fan experience.'
}

  recommendation_reference varchar [note: 'Externally referenceable business identifier for this recommendation record, used in downstream analytics, A/B testing, and audit trails.']
  recommendation_set_size varchar [note: 'Total number of content items included in the recommendation set delivered to the fan in this session. Provides context for interpreting rank position and coverage metrics.']
  recommendation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the recommendation record. \'generated\' = produced by engine but not yet delivered; \'served\' = displayed to fan; \'clicked\' = fan engaged; \'dismissed\' = fan explicitly dismissed; \'expired\' = TTL elapsed before serving; \'suppressed\' = blocked by business rule or frequency cap.']
  recommendation_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) at which the recommendation engine produced this recommendation record. This is the principal business event timestamp.']
  recommendation_type varchar [note: 'The surface or placement context where this recommendation was generated for delivery. Drives channel-specific performance analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: homepage_feed|post_view|in_game|email|push_notification|in_app_banner|search_results|live_event_overlay — promote to reference product]']
  served_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which this recommendation was actually displayed/delivered to the fan\'s device. Distinct from recommendation_timestamp (generation time). Null if recommendation was generated but never served.']
  sport_type varchar [note: 'The sport category associated with the recommended content (e.g., NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, UFC, FIFA). Enables sport-affinity performance analysis and personalization tuning.']
  suppression_reason varchar [note: 'If recommendation_status is \'suppressed\', this field captures the business reason for suppression. Supports compliance audit (e.g., GDPR opt-out suppression) and editorial override tracking.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this recommendation record, typically reflecting engagement outcome capture or status transitions.']
  user_context_type varchar [note: 'The behavioral context of the fan at the time of recommendation generation. Captures the fan\'s intent signal used as input to the recommendation engine (e.g., browsing, watching live event, post-event, onboarding).']

  Note: 'Platform content recommendation engine output records — recommended content items, recommendation algorithm, confidence score, user context, and engagement outcome tracking.'

High priority notifications (e.g., live score updates, breaking news) are delivered immediately and may wake a sleeping device. Normal and low priority notifications are batched by the OS to conserve battery.']
  push_token varchar [note: 'The device-specific push notification token (APNs device token or FCM registration token) used to route this notification to the target device. Classified as confidential PII as it can be used to identify and track a specific device and its associated fan.']
  rich_media_included boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this push notification includes rich media content (image, video thumbnail, or animated GIF) beyond plain text. Rich media notifications typically achieve higher open rates and are tracked separately for creative performance benchmarking.']
  scheduled_send_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which this push notification was scheduled to be dispatched. For real-time triggered notifications this equals the trigger event time. Used for send-time optimization analysis and SLA measurement.']
  send_time_optimized boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the send time for this notification was determined by the platform\'s send-time optimization algorithm (Adobe Journey Optimizer or equivalent) rather than a fixed scheduled time. True when AI-optimized delivery was applied.']
  sent_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The actual date and time at which the push notification was dispatched from the platform to the push gateway (APNs or FCM). Distinct from scheduled_send_timestamp; the delta measures dispatch latency.']
  sound_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether an audible alert sound was included with this push notification delivery. Sound-enabled notifications are used for high-priority alerts such as live score updates and breaking news.']
  trigger_source varchar [note: 'The originating system or business event that triggered this push notification send. Enables root-cause analysis of notification volume spikes and supports SLA monitoring per trigger type. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: live_score_engine|editorial_cms|campaign_scheduler|loyalty_engine|ticketing_system|personalization_engine|manual_operator|broadcast_event|merchandise_system — promote to reference product]']
  ttl_seconds varchar [note: 'The time-to-live duration in seconds for this push notification. If the device is offline and the notification cannot be delivered within this window, the push gateway discards it. Critical for time-sensitive notifications such as live score updates.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which this push notification record was last modified, typically reflecting a delivery status update or fan action capture. Supports incremental data processing in the Databricks Silver layer.']
  utm_campaign varchar [note: 'The UTM campaign tracking parameter appended to the deep link URL for this notification. Enables attribution of downstream web and app conversions to specific push notification campaigns in analytics platforms.']
  utm_content varchar [note: 'The UTM content parameter identifying the specific creative variant or A/B test arm for attribution purposes. Complements utm_campaign to enable granular creative performance analysis.']

  Note: 'Individual push notification delivery records — message content, target device, delivery status, open/dismiss action, deep link destination, and send trigger (real-time score, breaking news, promotion).'
}

  platform_type varchar [note: 'Target operating platform or device category for this release. Determines the distribution channel and applicable app store submission requirements.']

  release_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known semantic version number of the release following major.minor.patch convention (e.g., 4.12.3). Used as the primary business identifier for the release across app stores and internal communications.']
  release_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the release from initial draft through app store review, staged rollout, full live deployment, and eventual deprecation or rollback. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_review|approved|in_rollout|live|rolled_back|deprecated — promote to reference product]']
  release_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the release was deployed or made live on the target platform. Supports SLA measurement and incident correlation.']
  release_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the release by scope of change: major (breaking changes or significant new features), minor (backward-compatible new features), patch (bug fixes), hotfix (emergency production fix), or rollback (reverting to a prior version).']
  rollout_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the eligible user base currently receiving this release as part of a staged or phased rollout strategy (0.00 to 100.00). Enables controlled deployment and risk mitigation for high-traffic fan-facing platforms.']

  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this release record. Used for change tracking and incremental data pipeline processing.']

  Note: 'Mobile and web application release management records — version number, release date, platform (iOS/Android/Web), feature changelog, rollout percentage, and crash rate monitoring.'
