  claim_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the insurance claim by the nature of the loss or liability event. Drives routing to the appropriate insurer coverage line and in-house legal team. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: property_damage|bodily_injury|workers_compensation|general_liability|media_liability|event_cancellation|directors_officers|cyber — promote to reference product]']
  claimant_name varchar [note: 'Full legal name of the individual or organization that filed or is the subject of the insurance claim. Required for claim correspondence, legal documentation, and regulatory reporting. Classified as restricted PII per GDPR and CCPA.']
  claimant_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the claimant by their relationship to Sports Entertainment. Determines applicable legal frameworks, CBA provisions, and insurance coverage lines. Values: athlete, employee, fan, vendor, third_party, organization.']
  claimed_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Gross monetary amount initially claimed by the claimant or filed against the insurer at the time of submission. Represents the gross-base amount in the MONETARY_TRIPLET for this transaction. Used for reserve setting and exposure assessment.']
  coverage_confirmed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the insurer has formally confirmed that the claim falls within the scope of the applicable policy coverage. True when coverage is confirmed; False when coverage is disputed or pending determination.']
  coverage_line varchar [note: 'Insurance coverage layer applicable to this claim. Indicates whether the claim falls under the primary policy, excess layer, umbrella policy, or reinsurance arrangement. Drives financial recovery routing and reserve allocation.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the insurance claim record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for audit trail and data lineage purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary amounts on this claim (claimed_amount, reserve_amount, settlement_amount, deductible_amount). Supports multi-currency operations across global markets.']
  deductible_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Policy deductible amount applicable to this specific claim as defined in the governing insurance policy. Represents the portion of the loss retained by Sports Entertainment before insurer coverage applies. Critical for net recovery calculation.']
  denial_reason varchar [note: 'Narrative explanation provided by the insurer for denying the claim. Populated only when claim_status is \'denied\'. Used for dispute resolution, coverage gap analysis, and future policy negotiation.']
  filing_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the insurance claim was formally submitted to the insurer. Used to measure claim reporting timeliness against policy notice requirements and SLA obligations.']
  incident_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction where the incident occurred. Determines applicable law, regulatory reporting requirements (GDPR, CCPA, OSHA), and governing body jurisdiction (FIFA, IOC, NFL, etc.).']
  incident_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the underlying loss event, injury, property damage, or liability-triggering incident occurred. Serves as the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) for this claim. Critical for determining policy period applicability and statute of limitations.']
  incident_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative description of the loss event, injury, property damage, or liability-triggering incident that gave rise to the insurance claim. Provides context for claim investigation, legal review, and insurer assessment.']
  incident_location varchar [note: 'Physical location or venue where the incident occurred (e.g., stadium name, arena section, broadcast facility, training facility). Used for venue operations risk analysis, OSHA compliance reporting, and ADA accommodation tracking.']
  insurer_claim_handler varchar [note: 'Full name of the claims adjuster or handler assigned by the insurer to manage and investigate this specific claim. Used for direct communication, escalation tracking, and SLA monitoring with the insurer.']
  insurer_handler_email varchar [note: 'Email address of the insurer-assigned claim handler for direct correspondence and document exchange. Classified as confidential as it is a business contact at an external organization.']
  investigation_close_date date [note: 'Date on which the claim investigation was formally concluded. Used alongside investigation_start_date to calculate investigation duration for risk management KPI reporting.']
  investigation_start_date date [note: 'Date on which the formal claim investigation was initiated by the insurer or internal risk management team. Used to measure investigation cycle time and SLA compliance.']
  is_subrogation_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Sports Entertainment or the insurer has the right to pursue subrogation (recovery from a liable third party) in connection with this claim. True when subrogation rights exist; False otherwise. Relevant for recovery strategy and legal action planning.']
  legal_hold_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a legal hold has been placed on documents and data related to this insurance claim due to anticipated or active litigation. True when a legal hold is active; False otherwise. Triggers data preservation obligations under SOX and litigation management protocols.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional commentary, internal observations, or supplementary information recorded by the risk management or legal team during the claim lifecycle. Not intended for structured data; used for qualitative context.']
  payment_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the settlement payment was received from the insurer or disbursed to the claimant. Used for cash flow reporting, accounts receivable reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA FI, and insurance recovery tracking.']
  recovery_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Actual monetary amount recovered from the insurer following claim resolution. May differ from settlement_amount due to deductibles, coverage sub-limits, or co-insurance provisions. Key metric for insurance recovery monitoring and ROI analysis.']
  regulatory_report_date date [note: 'Date on which the required regulatory report was submitted to the applicable governing body. Populated only when regulatory_report_required is True. Used for compliance tracking and audit evidence.']
  regulatory_report_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this claim requires mandatory regulatory reporting to a governing body (e.g., OSHA incident report, WADA notification, SEC disclosure for material claims, FCC notification for broadcast-related incidents). True when regulatory reporting is mandated.']
  reserve_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Actuarial reserve amount set aside by the insurer or internal risk management to cover the estimated ultimate cost of the claim. Represents the adjustment/estimate component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Subject to periodic re-evaluation as the claim progresses.']
  settlement_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Final agreed monetary amount paid to resolve the insurance claim. Represents the net total in the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Populated only upon claim settlement or closure; null for open or denied claims.']
  subrogation_recovery_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Monetary amount recovered through subrogation proceedings against a liable third party. Populated only when is_subrogation_applicable is True and recovery has been obtained. Reduces the net cost of the claim to Sports Entertainment.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to the insurance claim record. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for change tracking and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of every insurance claim filed by or against Sports Entertainment under a corporate insurance policy. Captures claim number, policy reference, claim type, incident date, claim filing date, claimant identity, claim description, claimed amount, reserve amount, insurer claim handler, assigned in-house counsel, litigation case reference (if claim escalates), current claim status (open, under investigation, settled, closed, denied), settlement amount, and payment date. Enables risk management tracking and insurance recovery monitoring.'
}

Table legal.board_resolution {
  board_resolution_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each board resolution record in the Sports Entertainment corporate governance system. Primary key for the board_resolution data product.']
  amends_board_resolution_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on board_resolution (amends_board_resolution_id)']
  corporate_entity_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Sports Entertainment corporate legal entity (e.g., parent company, subsidiary, joint venture) that passed this resolution. Links to the corporate entity master.']
  outside_counsel_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the external law firm or outside counsel who advised on or drafted this resolution, if applicable. Links to the outside counsel relationship master in the legal domain.']
  authorized_signatories varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of individuals (by name or title) authorized by this resolution to execute agreements, sign documents, or take actions on behalf of the corporate entity. Central to authorized signatory management and contract execution workflows.']
  board_committee varchar [note: 'The board committee or body that passed this resolution. \'full_board\' indicates the entire board of directors; other values indicate a standing committee acting within its delegated authority. Audit and compensation committee resolutions have specific SOX disclosure implications.']
  chairperson_name varchar [note: 'The full name of the board chairperson or committee chair who presided over the meeting at which this resolution was passed. Required for governance documentation and board minutes authentication.']
  confidentiality_level varchar [note: 'The data classification level assigned to this resolution record, governing access controls and disclosure permissions. Aligns with Sports Entertainment\'s data classification framework. \'restricted\' applies to resolutions involving M&A, executive compensation, or litigation strategy.']
  corporate_secretary_name varchar [note: 'The full name of the corporate secretary who certified and recorded this resolution in the official minute book. The corporate secretary\'s certification is the legal attestation of the resolution\'s authenticity.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this board resolution record was first created in the governance system. Provides the audit trail entry point for data lineage and SOX compliance purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to any monetary authority or limit granted by this resolution (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required when signing_authority_limit is populated.']
  dissenting_directors varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of director names or identifiers who voted against or formally dissented from the resolution. Required for governance documentation and potential SEC disclosure. Classified as confidential due to sensitivity of individual director voting positions.']
  document_storage_reference varchar [note: 'The unique path, URI, or identifier pointing to the executed resolution document stored in the corporate document management system (e.g., SharePoint, OpenText, or DAM system path). Enables direct retrieval of the signed original for legal and audit purposes.']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date on which the resolution becomes legally operative and binding. May differ from resolution_date when the board specifies a future effective date or when regulatory approval is required before the resolution takes effect.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'The date on which the authority or action granted by this resolution automatically lapses, if applicable. Null for resolutions with indefinite effect. Commonly used for time-limited authorizations such as capital raises, signing authorities, or event-specific approvals.']
  fiscal_year varchar [note: 'The Sports Entertainment fiscal year in which this resolution was passed. Used for annual governance reporting, SOX compliance documentation, and board activity analytics.']
  governing_jurisdiction varchar [note: 'The legal jurisdiction (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country/state code) whose corporate law governs the validity and interpretation of this resolution (e.g., US-DE for Delaware, GBR for United Kingdom). Determines applicable corporate law requirements.']
  is_material_event boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this resolution constitutes a material event requiring public disclosure under SEC reporting obligations (e.g., Form 8-K). Drives the regulatory filing workflow and investor relations notification process.']
  is_written_consent boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this resolution was passed via unanimous written consent of the board without a physical or virtual meeting, as permitted under applicable corporate law. Written consent resolutions have specific execution and record-keeping requirements.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this board resolution record was most recently modified in the governance system. Supports change tracking, audit trails, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  meeting_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the board meeting was held. For written consent resolutions, this is the date the last required signature was obtained. May differ from resolution_date if the resolution was formally recorded on a different date.']
  meeting_reference_number varchar [note: 'The unique identifier assigned to the board meeting at which this resolution was considered. Used to cross-reference board minutes, agenda items, and other resolutions passed at the same meeting.']
  meeting_type varchar [note: 'The type of board meeting or process through which the resolution was passed. \'regular\' is a scheduled board meeting; \'special\' is a called meeting for specific matters; \'annual\' is the annual general meeting; \'written_consent\' is a resolution passed without a physical meeting via unanimous written consent; \'emergency\' is an expedited meeting for urgent matters.']
  minutes_document_reference varchar [note: 'The unique path, URI, or identifier pointing to the official board meeting minutes document in which this resolution is recorded. Distinct from document_storage_reference which points to the standalone resolution document.']
  quorum_achieved boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the required quorum of board members was present or represented at the time of the vote, as defined in the entity\'s articles of incorporation or bylaws. A resolution passed without quorum is legally invalid.']
  quorum_threshold_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'The minimum percentage of board members required to be present or represented to constitute a valid quorum for this meeting, as specified in the entity\'s governing documents. Typically 50% or 51% but may vary by entity and resolution type.']
  recused_directors varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of director names or identifiers who recused themselves from the vote due to a declared conflict of interest. Required for conflict-of-interest governance documentation and audit trail.']
  regulatory_filing_reference varchar [note: 'The reference number or identifier of the regulatory filing submitted as a result of this resolution (e.g., SEC Form 8-K accession number, FCC filing ID). Populated only when regulatory_filing_required is True and the filing has been submitted.']
  regulatory_filing_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this resolution triggers a mandatory regulatory filing obligation (e.g., SEC Form 8-K material event disclosure, FCC license transfer notification, FIFA/league governance notification). Drives compliance workflow routing.']
  related_resolution_number varchar [note: 'The resolution_number of a prior resolution that this resolution amends, ratifies, supersedes, or is otherwise directly related to. Enables governance lineage tracking across the resolution lifecycle.']
  resolution_category varchar [note: 'High-level business category classifying the subject matter of the resolution. Supports governance reporting and analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: financial|legal|operational|governance|personnel|regulatory|strategic|ip_licensing|media_rights|venue|sponsorship — promote to reference product]']
  resolution_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the board formally voted on and passed (or failed) this resolution. This is the principal business event date used in legal filings, regulatory submissions, and governance records.']
  resolution_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier assigned to the resolution by the corporate secretary. Follows the entity-year-sequence format (e.g., SE-RES-2024-000123). Used in legal filings, board minutes, and regulatory submissions.']
  resolution_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the board resolution. \'draft\' indicates preparation; \'pending_vote\' indicates scheduled for vote; \'passed\' indicates approved by required majority; \'failed\' indicates rejected; \'withdrawn\' indicates removed before vote; \'superseded\' indicates replaced by a subsequent resolution.']
  resolution_summary varchar [note: 'A concise plain-language summary of the resolution\'s purpose and key provisions, suitable for governance dashboards, board portals, and non-legal stakeholder reporting. Distinct from resolution_text which contains the full legal language.']
  resolution_text varchar [note: 'The complete verbatim text of the resolution as formally adopted by the board, including all WHEREAS recitals and RESOLVED clauses. This is the authoritative legal text of the resolution. Classified as confidential due to sensitive business and legal content.']
  resolution_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the formal action taken by the board. \'approval\' confirms a proposed action; \'authorization\' grants authority to act; \'ratification\' retrospectively validates a prior action; \'amendment\' modifies an existing resolution; \'rescission\' revokes a prior resolution; \'adoption\' formally enacts a policy or plan.']
  signing_authority_limit decimal(18,2) [note: 'The maximum monetary value (in the entity\'s functional currency) that the authorized signatories named in this resolution are empowered to commit on behalf of the entity. Null if the resolution grants unlimited signing authority or is non-monetary in nature.']
  subject_matter varchar [note: 'A concise, plain-language description of the business matter addressed by the resolution (e.g., \'Authorization of $50M credit facility with JPMorgan Chase\', \'Approval of FIFA partnership agreement\', \'Ratification of CEO employment contract\'). Used for search, reporting, and governance audit trails.']
  total_eligible_voters varchar [note: 'The total number of board members eligible to vote on this resolution at the time of the meeting. Used to calculate quorum compliance and majority thresholds for governance audit purposes.']
  vote_outcome varchar [note: 'The result of the board vote on this resolution. \'unanimous\' means all voting members approved; \'majority\' means more than half approved; \'split\' means a non-majority result; \'tied\' means equal votes for and against; \'no_vote\' means the resolution was tabled or withdrawn before a vote was taken.']
  votes_abstained varchar [note: 'The count of board members who were present but formally abstained from voting on the resolution, typically due to a declared conflict of interest or recusal.']
  votes_against varchar [note: 'The count of board member votes cast against the resolution. A non-zero value triggers documentation of dissenting director positions per governance best practices.']
  votes_for varchar [note: 'The count of board member votes cast in favor of the resolution. Used to document the precise vote tally in board minutes and governance records.']

  Note: 'Master record for all formal board of directors and member resolutions passed by Sports Entertainment corporate entities. Captures resolution number, entity reference, resolution type (approval, authorization, ratification, amendment), resolution date, meeting type (regular, special, written consent), quorum achieved flag, vote outcome (unanimous, majority, dissenting votes count), resolution subject matter, authorized signatories, effective date, and document storage reference. Supports corporate governance documentation and authorized signatory management.'
}

  is_completed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the required legal action associated with this deadline has been completed. True when the action is fully executed and documented.']

  is_critical boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this deadline is classified as critical, meaning that missing it would result in irreversible legal consequences such as loss of IP rights, default judgment, or regulatory sanction.']

  Note: 'Master record for all settlement agreements resolving litigation cases, IP disputes, employment claims, and regulatory enforcement actions. Captures settlement date, settling parties, matter or case reference, settlement type (monetary, injunctive, consent decree, confidential), settlement amount, payment schedule, non-monetary terms (injunction scope, behavioral commitments), confidentiality clause flag, non-disparagement clause flag, governing law, execution date, and compliance monitoring requirements. Distinct from litigation_case (which tracks the full matter lifecycle) — this record captures the binding resolution instrument.'
}
